AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless workflow using AWS Step Functions that emits custom events to an Amazon EventBridge custom event bus with a rule forwarding events to CloudWatch Logs for debugging.

Parameters:
  EventBusName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-workflow-event-bus
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge Event Bus.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365]
    Description: Number of days to retain logs in CloudWatch Logs.

Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref EventBusName

  EventBusLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${EventBusName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EventBusName}-EventBridgeToCloudWatchPolicy'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "EventBridgeLogGroupAccess",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${EventBusLogGroup.Arn}:*",
              "Condition": {
                "ArnEquals": {
                  "aws:SourceArn": "${AllEventsRule.Arn}"
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }

  AllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EventBusName}-catch-all-to-logs'
      Description: Forwards all events on the custom bus to CloudWatch Logs for testing and debugging.
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      EventPattern:
        account:
          - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt EventBusLogGroup.Arn
          Id: TargetCloudWatchLogGroup

  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToCustomBusPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  WorkflowStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Serverless workflow emitting custom events to a custom EventBridge bus",
            "StartAt": "PrepareEventData",
            "States": {
              "PrepareEventData": {
                "Type": "Pass",
                "Parameters": {
                  "workflowId.$": "$$.Execution.Id",
                  "timestamp.$": "$$.Execution.StartTime",
                  "input.$": "$"
                },
                "ResultPath": "$.eventPayload",
                "Next": "PublishCustomEvent"
              },
              "PublishCustomEvent": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents",
                "Parameters": {
                  "Entries": [
                    {
                      "EventBusName": "${BusArn}",
                      "Source": "custom.stepfunctions.workflow",
                      "DetailType": "WorkflowExecutionStarted",
                      "Detail.$": "$.eventPayload"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "ResultPath": "$.publishResult",
                "Next": "WorkflowSuccess"
              },
              "WorkflowSuccess": {
                "Type": "Succeed"
              }
            }
          }
        - BusArn: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

Outputs:
  CustomEventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge Event Bus.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
  CustomEventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge Event Bus.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus
  LogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Log Group capturing events.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBusLogGroup.Arn
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions State Machine.
    Value: !Ref WorkflowStateMachine

    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region identifier (e.g., us-west-2).

    Type: Number
    Description: BGP ASN for Primary Region Core Network Edge (RFC 6996 private ASN).
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534

  SecondaryRegionAsn:
    Type: Number
    Description: BGP ASN for Secondary Region Core Network Edge (RFC 6996 private ASN).
    Default: 64513
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534

            - location: !Ref PrimaryRegion

          - action: send-via

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template to deploy an SSM parameter, an IAM role with least-privilege permissions, and a Python Lambda function to read the parameter.

Parameters:
  DBUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: alice
    Description: Database username to be stored in the SSM Parameter Store.

Resources:
  DBUsernameSSMParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: dbUsername
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref DBUsername
      Description: SSM Parameter storing the database username.

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMGetParameterPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${DBUsernameSSMParameter}'
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasicLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:*:*'

  SSMReaderLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ssm-reader'
      Runtime: python3.8
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SSM_PARAMETER_NAME: !Ref DBUsernameSSMParameter
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          ssm_client = boto3.client('ssm')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              parameter_name = os.environ.get('SSM_PARAMETER_NAME', 'dbUsername')
              response = ssm_client.get_parameter(
                  Name=parameter_name,
                  WithDecryption=False
              )
              username = response['Parameter']['Value']
              print(f"Retrieved username: {username}")
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'dbUsername': username})
              }

  SSMParameterName:

  ECSService:

            - !Ref PublicSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ECSSecurityGroup

  TerminateLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'TerminateLambdaRole-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerminateEC2InstancePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'

  CheckHealthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'CheckHealthLambdaRole-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CheckECSAndPublishSNSPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                  - ecs:ListTasks
                  - ecs:DescribeTasks
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref ResilienceAlertTopic

  # --- Lambda Functions ---
  TerminateEC2Lambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'chaos-terminate-instance-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt TerminateLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              instance_id = event.get('InstanceId')
              if not instance_id:
                  raise ValueError("InstanceId is required in input event")

              logger.info(f"Terminating EC2 Instance: {instance_id}")
              response = ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              terminating_instances = response.get('TerminatingInstances', [])
              
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'instanceId': instance_id,
                  'terminatingInstances': terminating_instances
              }

  CheckHealthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'chaos-check-ecs-health-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt CheckHealthLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
          sns = boto3.client('sns')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              cluster = event.get('Cluster')
              service = event.get('Service')
              topic_arn = event.get('TopicArn')

              if not cluster or not service or not topic_arn:
                  raise ValueError("Cluster, Service, and TopicArn are required")

              response = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service])
              services = response.get('services', [])
              
              if not services:
                  is_healthy = False
                  reason = f"Service {service} not found in cluster {cluster}."
              else:
                  svc = services[0]
                  status = svc.get('status')
                  desired_count = svc.get('desiredCount', 0)
                  running_count = svc.get('runningCount', 0)

                  logger.info(f"Service status: {status}, Desired: {desired_count}, Running: {running_count}")
                  if status == 'ACTIVE' and running_count >= desired_count and desired_count > 0:
                      is_healthy = True
                      reason = f"Service is ACTIVE with {running_count}/{desired_count} running tasks."
                  else:
                      is_healthy = False
                      reason = f"Service unhealthy. Status: {status}, Desired: {desired_count}, Running: {running_count}."

              if not is_healthy:
                  subject = f"ALERT: ECS Service {service} Unhealthy After Chaos Event"
                  message = (
                      f"Chaos Engineering Alert!\n\n"
                      f"Cluster: {cluster}\n"
                      f"Service: {service}\n"
                      f"Health Status: UNHEALTHY\n"
                      f"Details: {reason}\n"
                  )
                  logger.warning(f"Publishing alert to SNS: {subject}")
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=topic_arn,
                      Subject=subject,
                      Message=message
                  )

              return {
                  'cluster': cluster,
                  'service': service,
                  'isHealthy': is_healthy,
                  'reason': reason
              }

  # --- Step Functions State Machine ---
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ChaosStateMachineRole-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeChaosLambdasPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateEC2Lambda.Arn
                  - !GetAtt CheckHealthLambda.Arn

  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub 'ecs-resilience-chaos-workflow-${AWS::StackName}'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Chaos Engineering: Terminate EC2 instance, wait 300 seconds, and verify ECS service health.",
          "StartAt": "TerminateEC2Instance",
          "States": {
            "TerminateEC2Instance": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${TerminateEC2Lambda.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "InstanceId": "${TargetEC2Instance}"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.terminationResult",
              "Next": "WaitForStabilization"
            },
            "WaitForStabilization": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": 300,
              "Next": "CheckECSHealthAndAlert"
            },
            "CheckECSHealthAndAlert": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${CheckHealthLambda.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "Cluster": "${ECSCluster}",
                "Service": "${ECSService.Name}",
                "TopicArn": "${ResilienceAlertTopic}"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.healthCheckResult",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions Chaos Engineering State Machine
    Value: !Ref ChaosStateMachine

  TargetInstanceId:
    Description: Instance ID of the EC2 target created for the chaos test
    Value: !Ref TargetEC2Instance

  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the created ECS Cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

  ECSServiceName:
    Description: Name of the created ECS Service
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name

  SNSTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS Alert Topic
    Value: !Ref ResilienceAlertTopic

  TerminateLambdaArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function that terminates the EC2 instance
    Value: !GetAtt TerminateEC2Lambda.Arn

  CheckHealthLambdaArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function that evaluates ECS health and sends alert
    Value: !GetAtt CheckHealthLambda.Arn

        - !Ref AgentServiceManagedPolicyArn

        - PolicyName: DevOpsAgentCreateServiceLinkedRolePolicy

Description: CloudFormation template that provisions SSM parameters, a Secrets Manager secret with a dynamically generated password, and a Python 3.12 Lambda function to retrieve and display them.

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameters
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/app/api_url'
      Type: String
      Value: 'https://api.example.com/v1'
      Description: 'API URL endpoint for demo application'

  EnvironmentParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/app/environment'
      Type: String
      Value: 'production'
      Description: 'Deployment environment for demo application'

  DbMaxConnectionsParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/database/max_connections'
      Type: String
      Value: '100'
      Description: 'Maximum database connections'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Secrets Manager Secret
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  DatabaseSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/app/db_credentials'

      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "dbadmin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: 'password'
        PasswordLength: 24
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

                          secret_info = {

                              'Value': secret_string
                          }
                          secrets_found.append(secret_info)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template to deploy an SSM Document and Association for collecting custom inventory of database and caching processes on Linux and Windows EC2 instances.

Parameters:
  LinuxProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: 'CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
    Description: Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Linux instances.

  WindowsProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: 'sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
    Description: Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Windows instances.

  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'rate(30 days)'
    Description: Schedule expression (cron or rate) for inventory collection.

Resources:
  CustomProcessInventoryDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      TargetType: '/AWS::EC2::Instance'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: Collect database and caching processes inventory on Linux and Windows instances.
        parameters:
          LinuxProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of process keywords to search on Linux.
            default: 'CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
          WindowsProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of process keywords to search on Windows.
            default: 'sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: collectLinuxProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - '#!/usr/bin/env bash'
                - 'set -e'
                - ''
                - '# 1. Query instance metadata for Instance ID'
                - 'IMDS_TOKEN=$(curl -s -S -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600" || true)'
                - 'if [ -n "$IMDS_TOKEN" ]; then'
                - '  INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -S -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $IMDS_TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id || true)'
                - 'else'
                - '  INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -S http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id || true)'
                - 'fi'
                - 'if [ -z "$INSTANCE_ID" ]; then'
                - '  INSTANCE_ID="unknown-instance-id"'
                - 'fi'
                - ''
                - '# 2. Prepare custom inventory directory'
                - 'INVENTORY_DIR="/var/lib/amazon/ssm/inventory/custom"'
                - 'mkdir -p "$INVENTORY_DIR"'
                - 'CAPTURE_TIME=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")'
                - ''
                - '# 3. Search target processes'
                - 'KEYWORDS="{{LinuxProcessKeywords}}"'
                - 'IFS="," read -r -a KEYWORD_ARRAY <<< "$KEYWORDS"'
                - 'ENTRIES=()'
                - ''
                - 'for KW in "${KEYWORD_ARRAY[@]}"; do'
                - '  CLEAN_KW="$(echo "$KW" | xargs)"'
                - '  if [ -n "$CLEAN_KW" ]; then'
                - '    while read -r PID USER CMD; do'
                - '      if [ -n "$PID" ]; then'
                - '        ESCAPED_CMD=$(echo "$CMD" | sed ''s/"/\\"/g'')'
                - '        ENTRIES+=("{\"InstanceId\":\"$INSTANCE_ID\",\"Keyword\":\"$CLEAN_KW\",\"ProcessId\":\"$PID\",\"UserName\":\"$USER\",\"CommandLine\":\"$ESCAPED_CMD\"}")'
                - '      fi'
                - '    done < <(ps -eo pid=,user=,args= | grep -F "$CLEAN_KW" | grep -v grep || true)'
                - '  fi'
                - 'done'
                - ''
                - '# 4. Format and write Custom Inventory JSON'
                - 'JSON_CONTENT=$(IFS=,; echo "${ENTRIES[*]}")'
                - 'cat <<EOF > "$INVENTORY_DIR/CustomProcesses.json"'
                - '{'
                - '  "TypeName": "Custom:Processes",'
                - '  "SchemaVersion": "1.0",'
                - '  "CaptureTime": "$CAPTURE_TIME",'
                - '  "Content": [$JSON_CONTENT]'
                - '}'
                - 'EOF'
                - 'echo "Successfully generated custom process inventory at $INVENTORY_DIR/CustomProcesses.json"'

          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: collectWindowsProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - '$ErrorActionPreference = "SilentlyContinue"'
                - ''
                - '# 1. Query instance metadata for Instance ID'
                - '$token = $null'
                - 'try {'
                - '    $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds"="21600"} -Method PUT -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -TimeoutSec 5'
                - '} catch {}'
                - '$instanceId = "unknown-instance-id"'
                - 'try {'
                - '    if ($token) {'
                - '        $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token"=$token} -Method GET -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -TimeoutSec 5'
                - '    } else {'
                - '        $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Method GET -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -TimeoutSec 5'
                - '    }'
                - '} catch {}'
                - ''
                - '# 2. Prepare custom inventory directory'
                - '$inventoryDir = "C:\ProgramData\Amazon\SSM\InstanceData\$instanceId\inventory\custom"'
                - 'if (-not (Test-Path -Path $inventoryDir)) {'
                - '    New-Item -Path $inventoryDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null'
                - '}'
                - '$captureTime = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")'
                - ''
                - '# 3. Search target processes'
                - '$keywordsRaw = "{{WindowsProcessKeywords}}"'
                - '$keywords = $keywordsRaw.Split(",") | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne "" }'
                - '$processes = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process'
                - '$content = @()'
                - ''
                - 'foreach ($kw in $keywords) {'
                - '    $matches = $processes | Where-Object {'
                - '        ($_.Name -like "*$kw*") -or ($_.CommandLine -like "*$kw*")'
                - '    }'
                - '    foreach ($proc in $matches) {'
                - '        $content += [PSCustomObject]@{'
                - '            InstanceId  = $instanceId'
                - '            Keyword     = $kw'
                - '            ProcessId   = [string]$proc.ProcessId'
                - '            ProcessName = [string]$proc.Name'
                - '            CommandLine = [string]$proc.CommandLine'
                - '        }'
                - '    }'
                - '}'
                - ''
                - '# 4. Format and write Custom Inventory JSON'
                - '$inventoryObject = [PSCustomObject]@{'
                - '    TypeName      = "Custom:Processes"'
                - '    SchemaVersion = "1.0"'
                - '    CaptureTime   = $captureTime'
                - '    Content       = $content'
                - '}'
                - '$jsonOutput = $inventoryObject | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5'
                - '$filePath = Join-Path -Path $inventoryDir -ChildPath "CustomProcesses.json"'
                - 'Set-Content -Path $filePath -Value $jsonOutput -Encoding UTF8'
                - 'Write-Host "Successfully generated custom process inventory at $filePath"'

  CustomInventoryAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      AssociationName: Custom-Inventory-Processes
      Name: !Ref CustomProcessInventoryDocument
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      Targets:
        - Key: InstanceIds
          Values:
            - '*'
      Parameters:
        LinuxProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        WindowsProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords

Outputs:
  DocumentName:
    Description: Name of the created SSM Command Document.
    Value: !Ref CustomProcessInventoryDocument

  AssociationId:
    Description: ID of the SSM Association.
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryAssociation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS App Mesh setup for colorteller demo service with virtual gateway, virtual router, virtual service, and blue/green virtual nodes.

Resources:
  Mesh:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Spec:
        EgressFilter:
          Type: ALLOW_ALL

    Properties:

      VirtualGatewayName: colorgateway

        Listeners:

              Port: 9080

              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000

  VirtualNodeBlue:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-blue-node
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              Port: 9080
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AwsCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}.local
            ServiceName: colorteller

  VirtualNodeGreen:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-green-node
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              Port: 9080
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AwsCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}.local
            ServiceName: colorteller

  VirtualRouter:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualRouter
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualRouterName: colorteller-router

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automatically disables IMDSv1 on EC2 instances when they transition to the running state by invoking the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata SSM automation document via EventBridge.

Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: The desired HTTP PUT response hop limit for instance metadata requests. Valid values are between 1 and 64.

Resources:
  SSMAutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by Systems Manager Automation to describe and modify EC2 instance metadata options.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2ModifyMetadataPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: '*'

  EventBridgeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role assumed by EventBridge to trigger the SSM automation document and pass the automation execution role.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomationExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:$DEFAULT'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn

  EC2InstanceStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Triggers AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata SSM Automation when an EC2 instance enters the running state to enforce IMDSv2.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
      Targets:
        - Id: DisableIMDSv1Target
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:$DEFAULT'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              instanceId: $.detail.instance-id
            InputTemplate: !Sub |
              {
                "InstanceId": ["<instanceId>"],
                "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"],
                "HttpTokens": ["required"],
                "HttpPutResponseHopLimit": ["${HttpPutResponseHopLimit}"]
              }

Outputs:
  EventRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Rule triggering IMDSv2 enforcement.
    Value: !GetAtt EC2InstanceStateChangeRule.Arn

  EventRuleName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge Rule triggering IMDSv2 enforcement.
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceStateChangeRule

  SSMAutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by SSM Automation to modify EC2 instance metadata.
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn

  EventBridgeAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by EventBridge to trigger the SSM automation document.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeAutomationRole.Arn

      Policies:

          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${TableName}'

  CleanupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      RetentionInDays: 30

  DynamoDBCleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - CleanupLogGroup
      - CleanupLambdaRole
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt CleanupLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import logging
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ.get('TABLE_NAME', 'throttle')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Starting cleanup for table: {table_name}")
              current_epoch_sec = int(time.time())
              current_epoch_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)

              try:
                  key_schema = table.key_schema
                  partition_key = next((k['AttributeName'] for k in key_schema if k['KeyType'] == 'HASH'), None)
                  range_key = next((k['AttributeName'] for k in key_schema if k['KeyType'] == 'RANGE'), None)

                  if not range_key:
                      logger.warning(f"Table {table_name} does not have a range/sort key defined. Exiting cleanup.")
                      return {"status": "skipped", "reason": "No range key found"}

                  deleted_count = 0
                  scan_kwargs = {
                      'ProjectionExpression': f"#{partition_key}, #{range_key}",
                      'ExpressionAttributeNames': {
                          f"#{partition_key}": partition_key,
                          f"#{range_key}": range_key
                      }
                  }

                  done = False
                  start_key = None

                  with table.batch_writer() as batch:
                      while not done:
                          if start_key:
                              scan_kwargs['ExclusiveStartKey'] = start_key

                          response = table.scan(**scan_kwargs)
                          items = response.get('Items', [])

                          for item in items:
                              range_val = item.get(range_key)
                              is_expired = False

                              if isinstance(range_val, (int, float)):
                                  # Detect if seconds or milliseconds
                                  if range_val > 10000000000:
                                      is_expired = range_val < current_epoch_ms
                                  else:
                                      is_expired = range_val < current_epoch_sec
                              elif isinstance(range_val, str):
                                  try:
                                      val_num = float(range_val)
                                      if val_num > 10000000000:
                                          is_expired = val_num < current_epoch_ms
                                      else:
                                          is_expired = val_num < current_epoch_sec
                                  except ValueError:
                                      pass

                              if is_expired:
                                  batch.delete_item(
                                      Key={
                                          partition_key: item[partition_key],
                                          range_key: item[range_key]
                                      }
                                  )
                                  deleted_count += 1

                          start_key = response.get('LastEvaluatedKey', None)
                          done = start_key is None

                  logger.info(f"Cleanup completed. Deleted {deleted_count} expired records.")
                  return {"status": "success", "deleted_count": deleted_count}

              except ClientError as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error during DynamoDB cleanup: {e}")

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS IoT SiteWise asset models for a wind farm demo, including a Turbine Asset Model and a Wind Farm Asset Model with hierarchies and rollup metrics.

Resources:
  TurbineAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: Wind Turbine Asset Model
      AssetModelDescription: Asset model representing individual wind turbines with measurements, transforms, and metrics.
      AssetModelProperties:
        # Attributes
        - LogicalId: TurbineCapacityAttribute
          Name: Capacity
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: '2000'
        - LogicalId: TurbineManufacturerAttribute
          Name: Manufacturer
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: 'Generic WindPower Corp'

        # Measurements
        - LogicalId: WindSpeedMeasurement
          Name: WindSpeed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: TorqueMeasurement
          Name: Torque
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kN*m
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: PowerMeasurement
          Name: Power
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement

        # Transforms
        - LogicalId: OverdriveStateTransform
          Name: OverdriveState
          DataType: INTEGER
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: if(torque > 3, 1, 0)
              Variables:
                - Name: torque
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: TorqueMeasurement

        # Metrics (5-minute tumbling window)
        - LogicalId: AverageWindSpeedMetric
          Name: AverageWindSpeed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(wind_speed)
              Variables:
                - Name: wind_speed
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: WindSpeedMeasurement
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: OverdriveStateTimeMetric
          Name: OverdriveStateTime
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: statetime(overdrive_state, 1)
              Variables:
                - Name: overdrive_state
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: OverdriveStateTransform
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: AveragePowerMetric
          Name: AveragePower
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(power)
              Variables:
                - Name: power
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: PowerMeasurement
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m

  WindFarmAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: Wind Farm Asset Model
      AssetModelDescription: Asset model representing the wind farm hierarchy and aggregated turbine metrics.
      AssetModelHierarchies:
        - LogicalId: TurbineHierarchyLogicalId
          Name: Turbines
          ChildAssetModelId: !Ref TurbineAssetModel
      AssetModelProperties:
        # Attributes
        - LogicalId: RegionAttribute
          Name: Region
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: North America
        - LogicalId: OperatorAttribute
          Name: Operator
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: Wind Farm Operations

        # Rollup Metrics (5-minute tumbling window)
        - LogicalId: TotalAveragePowerMetric
          Name: TotalAveragePower
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: sum(avg_power)
              Variables:
                - Name: avg_power
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: AveragePowerMetric
                    HierarchyLogicalId: TurbineHierarchyLogicalId
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: TotalOverdriveStateTimeMetric
          Name: TotalOverdriveStateTime
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: sum(overdrive_time)
              Variables:
                - Name: overdrive_time
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: OverdriveStateTimeMetric
                    HierarchyLogicalId: TurbineHierarchyLogicalId
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m

Outputs:
  TurbineAssetModelId:
    Description: The ID of the Turbine Asset Model
    Value: !Ref TurbineAssetModel
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TurbineAssetModelId

  TurbineAssetModelArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Turbine Asset Model
    Value: !GetAtt TurbineAssetModel.AssetModelArn

  WindFarmAssetModelId:
    Description: The ID of the Wind Farm Asset Model
    Value: !Ref WindFarmAssetModel
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WindFarmAssetModelId

  WindFarmAssetModelArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Wind Farm Asset Model
    Value: !GetAtt WindFarmAssetModel.AssetModelArn

  WindFarmToTurbineHierarchyId:
    Description: The Logical ID of the hierarchy linking Wind Farm to Turbines
    Value: TurbineHierarchyLogicalId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WindFarmToTurbineHierarchyId

Resources:

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cognito-lambda-unauthenticated-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref LambdaCognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaExecutionAndLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

            Version: '2012-10-17'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a secure S3 bucket infrastructure with access logging, same-region replication, and strict security controls.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    Description: Application name used for resource naming and tagging.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

Resources:
  AccessLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-logs'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ReplicaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn: AccessLogBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: replica-bucket-logs/
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-replica'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  ReplicaBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ReplicaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-s3-replication-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3ReplicationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SourceBucketPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ApplicationName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
              - Sid: SourceObjectPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionAcl
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionTagging
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ApplicationName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*'
              - Sid: DestinationObjectPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ReplicateObject
                  - s3:ReplicateDelete
                  - s3:ReplicateTags
                Resource: !Sub '${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-s3-replication-role'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn:
      - AccessLogBucketPolicy
      - ReplicationRole
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: primary-bucket-logs/
      ReplicationConfiguration:
        Role: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn
        Rules:
          - Id: EntireBucketReplication
            Status: Enabled
            Priority: 1
            Filter: {}
            DeleteMarkerReplication:
              Status: Enabled
            Destination:
              Bucket: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-primary'
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  PrimaryBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PrimaryBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PrimaryBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${PrimaryBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${PrimaryBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

Outputs:
  PrimaryBucketName:
    Description: Name of the primary S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref PrimaryBucket
  PrimaryBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the primary S3 bucket
    Value: !GetAtt PrimaryBucket.Arn
  ReplicaBucketName:
    Description: Name of the replica S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref ReplicaBucket
  ReplicaBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the replica S3 bucket
    Value: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
  AccessLogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the access log S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref AccessLogBucket
  AccessLogBucketArn:

    Value: !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
  ReplicationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM replication role
    Value: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Aurora Global Database automated failover using SSM Automation, Route 53 ARC, and AWS Lambda.

Parameters:
  GlobalClusterIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: 'my-aurora-global-cluster'
    Description: The identifier of the Aurora Global Database cluster to failover.
  PrimaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: 'us-east-1'
    Description: The primary AWS region for the Aurora Global Database.
  SecondaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: 'us-west-2'
    Description: The secondary (target) AWS region for the Aurora Global Database.
  ArcClusterEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: 'https://recovery-control.us-east-1.amazonaws.com'
    Description: Endpoint URL for Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) data plane.
  ArcRoutingControlArnPrimary:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:route53-recovery-control::123456789012:control/primary-control'
    Description: Routing control ARN for the primary region in Route 53 ARC.
  ArcRoutingControlArnSecondary:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:route53-recovery-control::123456789012:control/secondary-control'
    Description: Routing control ARN for the secondary region in Route 53 ARC.
  SecretArnOrName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'aurora/database/credentials'
    Description: Secrets Manager secret name or ARN storing database connection info and writer endpoint.

Resources:
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SSMAutomationRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AuroraFailoverAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:FailoverGlobalCluster
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                  - rds:ModifyGlobalCluster
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeRoutingControl
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListRoutingControls
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:GetRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlStates
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TriggerFailoverLambdaRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaSSMExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:StopAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'SSM Automation document to execute Aurora Global Database failover and update Route 53 ARC and Secrets Manager'
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: '(Required) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.'
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          GlobalClusterIdentifier:
            type: String
            description: '(Required) The identifier of the Global Database to failover.'
            default: !Ref GlobalClusterIdentifier
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: '(Required) The primary AWS region.'
            default: !Ref PrimaryRegion
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: '(Required) The secondary AWS region to promote as the new primary.'
            default: !Ref SecondaryRegion
          ArcEndpoint:
            type: String
            description: '(Required) The Route 53 ARC cluster endpoint.'
            default: !Ref ArcClusterEndpoint
          ArcPrimaryControlArn:
            type: String
            description: '(Required) ARC Routing Control ARN for Primary Region.'
            default: !Ref ArcRoutingControlArnPrimary
          ArcSecondaryControlArn:
            type: String
            description: '(Required) ARC Routing Control ARN for Secondary Region.'
            default: !Ref ArcRoutingControlArnSecondary
          SecretNameOrArn:
            type: String
            description: '(Required) The Secrets Manager Secret containing database endpoint information.'
            default: !Ref SecretArnOrName
        mainSteps:
          - name: determineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Step 1: Determine the current active region by reading ARC routing control states.'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                arc_endpoint: '{{ ArcEndpoint }}'
                primary_control_arn: '{{ ArcPrimaryControlArn }}'
                secondary_control_arn: '{{ ArcSecondaryControlArn }}'
                primary_region: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                secondary_region: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    arc_endpoint = events["arc_endpoint"]
                    primary_arn = events["primary_control_arn"]
                    secondary_arn = events["secondary_control_arn"]
                    primary_region = events["primary_region"]
                    secondary_region = events["secondary_region"]

                    client = boto3.client("route53-recovery-cluster", endpoint_url=arc_endpoint)
                    
                    primary_resp = client.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=primary_arn)
                    secondary_resp = client.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=secondary_arn)

                    primary_state = primary_resp.get("RoutingControlState", "Off")
                    secondary_state = secondary_resp.get("RoutingControlState", "Off")

                    if primary_state == "On":
                        current_active = primary_region
                        target_region = secondary_region
                    else:
                        current_active = secondary_region
                        target_region = primary_region

                    return {
                        "CurrentActiveRegion": current_active,
                        "TargetFailoverRegion": target_region,
                        "PrimaryState": primary_state,
                        "SecondaryState": secondary_state
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: CurrentActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.CurrentActiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: TargetFailoverRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.TargetFailoverRegion
                Type: String

          - name: failoverAuroraGlobalCluster
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Step 2: Perform the global cluster failover to the target secondary region.'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                global_cluster_id: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
                target_region: '{{ determineActiveRegion.TargetFailoverRegion }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    global_cluster_id = events["global_cluster_id"]
                    target_region = events["target_region"]

                    rds_client = boto3.client("rds", region_name=target_region)

                    response = rds_client.describe_global_clusters(GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id)
                    global_cluster = response["GlobalClusters"][0]

                    target_cluster_arn = None
                    for member in global_cluster["GlobalClusterMembers"]:
                        if target_region in member["DBClusterArn"]:
                            target_cluster_arn = member["DBClusterArn"]
                            break

                    if not target_cluster_arn:
                        raise ValueError(f"No DB cluster found in target region {target_region} for global cluster {global_cluster_id}")

                    failover_response = rds_client.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id,
                        TargetDbClusterIdentifier=target_cluster_arn,
                        AllowDataLoss=False
                    )

                    new_writer_endpoint = None
                    target_db_identifier = target_cluster_arn.split(":")[-1]
                    db_response = rds_client.describe_db_clusters(DBClusterIdentifier=target_db_identifier)
                    if db_response["DBClusters"]:
                        new_writer_endpoint = db_response["DBClusters"][0].get("Endpoint")

                    return {
                        "FailoverStatus": "Initiated",
                        "TargetDbClusterArn": target_cluster_arn,
                        "NewWriterEndpoint": new_writer_endpoint or ""
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: TargetDbClusterArn
                Selector: $.Payload.TargetDbClusterArn
                Type: String
              - Name: NewWriterEndpoint
                Selector: $.Payload.NewWriterEndpoint
                Type: String

          - name: flipRoutingControlsAndUpdateSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: 'Step 3: Flip ARC routing control states and update Secrets Manager secret.'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                arc_endpoint: '{{ ArcEndpoint }}'
                primary_control_arn: '{{ ArcPrimaryControlArn }}'
                secondary_control_arn: '{{ ArcSecondaryControlArn }}'
                target_region: '{{ determineActiveRegion.TargetFailoverRegion }}'
                primary_region: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                secret_id: '{{ SecretNameOrArn }}'
                new_writer_endpoint: '{{ failoverAuroraGlobalCluster.NewWriterEndpoint }}'
              Script: |-
                import json
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    arc_endpoint = events["arc_endpoint"]
                    primary_arn = events["primary_control_arn"]
                    secondary_arn = events["secondary_control_arn"]
                    target_region = events["target_region"]
                    primary_region = events["primary_region"]
                    secret_id = events["secret_id"]
                    new_endpoint = events.get("new_writer_endpoint", "")

                    arc_client = boto3.client("route53-recovery-cluster", endpoint_url=arc_endpoint)

                    if target_region == primary_region:
                        entries = [
                            {"RoutingControlArn": primary_arn, "RoutingControlState": "On"},
                            {"RoutingControlArn": secondary_arn, "RoutingControlState": "Off"}
                        ]
                    else:
                        entries = [
                            {"RoutingControlArn": primary_arn, "RoutingControlState": "Off"},
                            {"RoutingControlArn": secondary_arn, "RoutingControlState": "On"}
                        ]

                    arc_client.update_routing_control_states(RoutingControlStatesEntries=entries)

                    sm_client = boto3.client("secretsmanager", region_name=target_region)
                    secret_result = sm_client.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_id)
                    current_secret = {}
                    if "SecretString" in secret_result:
                        try:
                            current_secret = json.loads(secret_result["SecretString"])
                        except json.JSONDecodeError:
                            current_secret = {"raw": secret_result["SecretString"]}

                    current_secret["writer_endpoint"] = new_endpoint
                    current_secret["active_region"] = target_region

                    sm_client.put_secret_value(
                        SecretId=secret_id,
                        SecretString=json.dumps(current_secret)
                    )

                    return {
                        "RoutingControlsUpdated": True,
                        "SecretUpdated": True,
                        "ActiveRegion": target_region
                    }

  TriggerFailoverLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: TriggerFailover
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DOCUMENT_NAME: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
          GLOBAL_CLUSTER_ID: !Ref GlobalClusterIdentifier
          PRIMARY_REGION: !Ref PrimaryRegion
          SECONDARY_REGION: !Ref SecondaryRegion
          ARC_ENDPOINT: !Ref ArcClusterEndpoint
          ARC_PRIMARY_ARN: !Ref ArcRoutingControlArnPrimary
          ARC_SECONDARY_ARN: !Ref ArcRoutingControlArnSecondary
          SECRET_NAME: !Ref SecretArnOrName
          SSM_ROLE_ARN: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              document_name = os.environ.get('DOCUMENT_NAME', 'AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument')
              global_cluster_id = event.get('GlobalClusterIdentifier', os.environ.get('GLOBAL_CLUSTER_ID'))
              primary_region = event.get('PrimaryRegion', os.environ.get('PRIMARY_REGION'))
              secondary_region = event.get('SecondaryRegion', os.environ.get('SECONDARY_REGION'))
              arc_endpoint = event.get('ArcEndpoint', os.environ.get('ARC_ENDPOINT'))
              arc_primary_arn = event.get('ArcPrimaryControlArn', os.environ.get('ARC_PRIMARY_ARN'))
              arc_secondary_arn = event.get('ArcSecondaryControlArn', os.environ.get('ARC_SECONDARY_ARN'))
              secret_id = event.get('SecretNameOrArn', os.environ.get('SECRET_NAME'))
              ssm_role_arn = os.environ.get('SSM_ROLE_ARN')

              parameters = {
                  'AutomationAssumeRole': [ssm_role_arn],
                  'GlobalClusterIdentifier': [global_cluster_id],
                  'PrimaryRegion': [primary_region],
                  'SecondaryRegion': [secondary_region],
                  'ArcEndpoint': [arc_endpoint],
                  'ArcPrimaryControlArn': [arc_primary_arn],
                  'ArcSecondaryControlArn': [arc_secondary_arn],
                  'SecretNameOrArn': [secret_id]
              }

              response = ssm.start_automation_execution(
                  DocumentName=document_name,
                  Parameters=parameters
              )

              execution_id = response.get('AutomationExecutionId')
              print(f"Successfully initiated automation execution: {execution_id}")

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({
                      'message': 'Aurora Global Database failover automation triggered successfully.',
                      'automationExecutionId': execution_id
                  })
              }

Outputs:
  SSMAutomationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation Document for Aurora Global Database failover.
    Value: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument

  SSMAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM Role used by SSM Automation.
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

  TriggerFailoverLambdaArn:
    Description: ARN of the TriggerFailover Lambda Function.
    Value: !GetAtt TriggerFailoverLambda.Arn

  TriggerFailoverLambdaName:

Resources:

    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref RepositoryName
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      ImageTagMutability: MUTABLE
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Keep only the last 10 images",
                "selection": {

                  - ecr:DescribeImages

  AppRunnerInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightTenantProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateNamespace
                  - quicksight:DeleteNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:ListNamespaces
                  - quicksight:RegisterUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:DeleteUser
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:UpdateDataSet
                  - quicksight:DeleteDataSet
                  - quicksight:PassDataSet
                  - quicksight:PassDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:CreateTemplate
                  - quicksight:DescribeTemplate
                  - quicksight:CreateDashboard
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:UpdateDashboard
                  - quicksight:UpdateDashboardPermissions
                  - quicksight:GenerateEmbedUrlForRegisteredUser
                  - quicksight:GenerateEmbedUrlForAnonymousUser
                  - quicksight:GetDashboardEmbedUrl
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:DescribeTrusts
                  - ds:CheckAlias
                Resource: '*'

  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    DependsOn:
      - AppRunnerECRAccessRole
      - AppRunnerInstanceRole
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      SourceConfiguration:
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: true
        AuthenticationConfiguration:
          AccessRoleArn: !GetAtt AppRunnerECRAccessRole.Arn
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: !Sub '${ECRRepository.RepositoryUri}:${ImageTag}'
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: !Ref AppPort
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: 0.0.0.0/0
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref AWS::Region
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              - Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
                Value: !Ref AdminEmail
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME
                Value: !Ref AdminUserName
              - Name: QS_TEMPLATE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightTemplateId
              - Name: QS_DATASET_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSetId
              - Name: QS_DATASOURCE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSourceId
              - Name: QS_DATABASE_NAME
                Value: !Ref DatabaseName
              - Name: QS_TABLE_NAME
                Value: !Ref TableName
              - Name: QS_FILTER_COLUMN
                Value: !Ref FilterColumnName
      InstanceConfiguration:
        Cpu: !Ref Cpu
        Memory: !Ref Memory
        InstanceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppRunnerInstanceRole.Arn

Description: >
  AWS CloudFormation template for CIS-compliant VPC Flow Logs remediation. Creates
  a compliant CloudWatch Logs log group, dedicated IAM roles for flow logging and
  SSM automation execution, a direct remediation SSM Automation document utilizing
  Python to capture REJECT traffic, and a dependent Change Manager change template
  document that routes remediation through formal change approval workflows.

Parameters:
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    AllowedValues:
      - 90
      - 180
      - 365
      - 730
      - 1827
      - 3653
    Description: Retention period in days for the VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Logs log group (default 365 days for compliance).

  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/vpc/flow-logs-rejected
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for VPC Flow Logs.

Resources:

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Benchmark
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs-Reject-Traffic

  FlowLogsServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcFlowLogsRole'
      Description: IAM role assumed by VPC Flow Logs to deliver records to CloudWatch Logs and managed by automation.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action:

                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups

                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
        - PolicyName: EC2FlowLogManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole

        - Key: Compliance

        Statement:

            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAutomationExecutionPolicy

                Resource:

                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
