                  - ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Benchmark

  DirectEnableVpcFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DirectEnableVpcFlowLogs'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >
          Direct remediation runbook that enables VPC Flow Logs capturing REJECT traffic
          aligned with CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark controls.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which to enable flow logs.
            allowedPattern: '^vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: The CloudWatch Logs log group to receive the flow logs.
            default: !Ref LogGroupName
          DeliverLogsPermissionArn:
            type: String
            description: IAM role ARN with permissions to publish flow logs to CloudWatch Logs.
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsServiceRole.Arn
          TrafficType:
            type: String
            description: The type of traffic to log. CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark requires capturing rejected traffic.
            default: REJECT
            allowedValues:
              - REJECT
              - ALL
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableVpcFlowLogsWithRejectTraffic
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
                DeliverLogsPermissionArn: '{{ DeliverLogsPermissionArn }}'
                TrafficType: '{{ TrafficType }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import logging

                logger = logging.getLogger()
                logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    log_group_name = events['LogGroupName']
                    deliver_logs_arn = events['DeliverLogsPermissionArn']
                    traffic_type = events.get('TrafficType', 'REJECT')

                    ec2_client = boto3.client('ec2')

                    logger.info(f"Checking VPC existence for {vpc_id}")
                    vpcs_response = ec2_client.describe_vpcs(VpcIds=[vpc_id])
                    if not vpcs_response.get('Vpcs'):
                        raise ValueError(f"VPC {vpc_id} does not exist.")

                    logger.info(f"Checking existing flow logs for VPC {vpc_id}")
                    flow_logs_response = ec2_client.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[{'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]}]
                    )

                    existing_logs = flow_logs_response.get('FlowLogs', [])
                    for fl in existing_logs:
                        fl_status = fl.get('FlowLogStatus')
                        fl_traffic = fl.get('TrafficType')
                        if fl_status == 'ACTIVE' and fl_traffic in [traffic_type, 'ALL']:
                            msg = (
                                f"Active flow log {fl.get('FlowLogId')} already exists "
                                f"for VPC {vpc_id} with traffic type '{fl_traffic}'."
                            )
                            logger.info(msg)
                            return {
                                'Status': 'ALREADY_COMPLIANT',
                                'VpcId': vpc_id,
                                'FlowLogId': fl.get('FlowLogId'),
                                'Message': msg
                            }

                    logger.info(f"Enabling {traffic_type} flow logging on VPC {vpc_id}")
                    response = ec2_client.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType=traffic_type,
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=deliver_logs_arn,
                        TagSpecifications=[
                            {
                                'ResourceType': 'vpc-flow-log',
                                'Tags': [
                                    {'Key': 'Name', 'Value': f'{vpc_id}-flow-logs-{traffic_type.lower()}'},
                                    {'Key': 'Compliance', 'Value': 'CIS-AWS-Foundations-Benchmark'},
                                    {'Key': 'ManagedBy', 'Value': 'SSM-Automation'}
                                ]
                            }
                        ]
                    )

                    unsuccessful = response.get('Unsuccessful', [])
                    if unsuccessful:
                        error_msg = unsuccessful[0].get('Error', {}).get('Message', 'Unknown error')
                        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to create flow log for VPC {vpc_id}: {error_msg}")

                    flow_log_ids = response.get('FlowLogIds', [])
                    created_id = flow_log_ids[0] if flow_log_ids else 'UNKNOWN'
                    logger.info(f"Successfully created flow log {created_id} for VPC {vpc_id}")

                    return {
                        'Status': 'SUCCESS',
                        'VpcId': vpc_id,
                        'FlowLogId': created_id,
                        'TrafficType': traffic_type,
                        'LogGroupName': log_group_name,
                        'Message': f"Flow log {created_id} created successfully."
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: OutputPayload
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Benchmark

Description: Creates a Route53 Reusable Delegation Set using a Lambda-backed Custom Resource with IP resolution and exports.

          import json
          import socket
          import time
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          route53 = boto3.client('route53')

          def send_response(event, context, status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None, reason=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = {
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or f"See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or event.get('PhysicalResourceId', context.log_stream_name),
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }
              json_data = json.dumps(response_body).encode('utf-8')
              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(json_data))
              }
              req = urllib.request.Request(response_url, data=json_data, headers=headers, method='PUT')
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                      print(f"CloudFormation response status: {resp.status}")
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Failed sending response to CloudFormation: {e}")

          def resolve_ip(hostname, family):
              try:
                  addresses = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None, family)
                  for addr in addresses:
                      ip = addr[4][0]
                      if ip:
                          return ip
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error resolving {hostname} with family {family}: {e}")
              return "N/A"

          def get_nameserver_details(nameservers):
              data = {}
              for idx, ns in enumerate(nameservers, start=1):
                  clean_ns = ns.rstrip('.')
                  ipv4 = resolve_ip(clean_ns, socket.AF_INET)
                  ipv6 = resolve_ip(clean_ns, socket.AF_INET6)
                  data[f'NameServer{idx}'] = clean_ns
                  data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv4'] = ipv4
                  data[f'NameServer{idx}IPv6'] = ipv6
              return data

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              print(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              response_data = {}

              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      caller_ref = f"{event['StackId']}-{event['LogicalResourceId']}-{int(time.time())}"
                      response = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(
                          CallerReference=caller_ref
                      )
                      delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
                      ds_id = delegation_set['Id'].replace('/delegationset/', '')
                      nameservers = delegation_set.get('NameServers', [])
                      response_data = get_nameserver_details(nameservers)
                      response_data['DelegationSetId'] = ds_id
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', response_data, physical_resource_id=ds_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      try:
                          response = route53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_id)
                          delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
                          ds_id = delegation_set['Id'].replace('/delegationset/', '')
                          nameservers = delegation_set.get('NameServers', [])
                          response_data = get_nameserver_details(nameservers)
                          response_data['DelegationSetId'] = ds_id
                          send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', response_data, physical_resource_id=ds_id)
                      except ClientError as e:
                          if e.response['Error']['Code'] in ['NoSuchDelegationSet', 'DelegationSetNotReusable']:
                              caller_ref = f"{event['StackId']}-{event['LogicalResourceId']}-{int(time.time())}"
                              response = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(CallerReference=caller_ref)
                              delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
                              ds_id = delegation_set['Id'].replace('/delegationset/', '')
                              nameservers = delegation_set.get('NameServers', [])
                              response_data = get_nameserver_details(nameservers)
                              response_data['DelegationSetId'] = ds_id
                              send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', response_data, physical_resource_id=ds_id)
                          else:
                              raise e

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      if physical_id and not physical_id.startswith('arn:'):
                          try:
                              route53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_id)
                          except ClientError as e:
                              if e.response['Error']['Code'] not in ['NoSuchDelegationSet', 'DelegationSetNotReusable']:
                                  print(f"Warning during delete: {e}")
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_resource_id=physical_id)

              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"Exception encountered: {exc}")
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, physical_resource_id=physical_id, reason=str(exc))

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless WebSocket API that asynchronously triggers a Step Functions state machine and replies after a 5-second wait.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: The deployment stage name for the WebSocket API.

Resources:
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStepFunctionsExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayManagementAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                  - execute-api:Invoke
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*'

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-processor'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Asynchronously processes WebSocket request and replies after 5 seconds",
            "StartAt": "WaitForFiveSeconds",
            "States": {
              "WaitForFiveSeconds": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 5,
                "Next": "SendWebSocketResponse"
              },
              "SendWebSocketResponse": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::apigateway:invoke",
                "Parameters": {
                  "ApiEndpoint": "${ApiEndpoint}",
                  "Method": "POST",
                  "Stage": "${ApiStage}",
                  "Path.$": "States.Format('/@connections/{}', $.connectionId)",
                  "RequestBody": {
                    "message": "Response after 5 seconds",
                    "status": "COMPLETED",
                    "connectionId.$": "$.connectionId"
                  },
                  "AuthType": "IAM_ROLE"
                },
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - ApiEndpoint: !Sub '${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          ApiStage: !Ref StageName

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
      PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub
          - |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineArn}",
              "input": "{\"connectionId\":\"$context.connectionId\",\"message\":$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless API for image content moderation using Amazon Rekognition and API Gateway.

Parameters:
  MinConfidenceThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100
    Description: Minimum confidence level for Rekognition moderation labels.

Resources:
  ContentModerationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ContentModerationLambdaRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionDetectModerationLabelsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'

  ContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ContentModerationLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MIN_CONFIDENCE: !Ref MinConfidenceThreshold
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import boto3

          rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')
          MIN_CONFIDENCE = float(os.environ.get('MIN_CONFIDENCE', '60.0'))
          MAX_IMAGE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5 MB
          SUPPORTED_FORMATS = {'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png'}

          def build_response(status_code, body):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(body)
              }

          def is_valid_image_bytes(image_data):
              # Check magic bytes for JPEG and PNG
              if image_data.startswith(b'\xff\xd8\xff'):
                  return 'jpeg'
              if image_data.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'):
                  return 'png'
              return None

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if not event.get('body'):
                      return build_response(400, {'error': 'Missing request body'})
                  
                  body = event['body']
                  if isinstance(body, str):
                      try:
                          body = json.loads(body)
                      except json.JSONDecodeError:
                          return build_response(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON in request body'})
                  
                  image_url = body.get('url') or body.get('imageUrl')
                  if not image_url or not isinstance(image_url, str):
                      return build_response(400, {'error': 'Field "url" is required in request payload'})
                  
                  url_lower = image_url.lower().split('?')[0]
                  has_supported_ext = any(url_lower.endswith(f".{fmt}") for fmt in SUPPORTED_FORMATS)

                  # Fetch the image
                  req = urllib.request.Request(
                      image_url,
                      headers={'User-Agent': 'AWS-Lambda-ContentModeration/1.0'}
                  )

                  try:
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as response:
                          content_length = response.headers.get('Content-Length')
                          if content_length and int(content_length) > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE:
                              return build_response(400, {
                                  'error': 'Image size exceeds maximum limit of 5MB',
                                  'maxSizeBytes': MAX_IMAGE_SIZE
                              })

                          image_bytes = response.read(MAX_IMAGE_SIZE + 1)
                          if len(image_bytes) > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE:
                              return build_response(400, {
                                  'error': 'Image size exceeds maximum limit of 5MB',
                                  'maxSizeBytes': MAX_IMAGE_SIZE
                              })

                  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                      if e.code == 404:
                          return build_response(404, {'error': f'Image not found at provided URL: {image_url}'})
                      return build_response(400, {'error': f'Failed to fetch image: HTTP {e.code} - {e.reason}'})
                  except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                      return build_response(400, {'error': f'Unable to reach image URL: {str(e.reason)}'})
                  except Exception as e:
                      return build_response(400, {'error': f'Error retrieving image: {str(e)}'})

                  # Validate format using magic bytes and URL extension
                  detected_format = is_valid_image_bytes(image_bytes)
                  if not detected_format and not has_supported_ext:
                      return build_response(400, {
                          'error': 'Unsupported image format. Only JPEG (jpg, jpeg) and PNG formats are supported.'
                      })

                  # Call Amazon Rekognition
                  rekog_response = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={'Bytes': image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=MIN_CONFIDENCE
                  )

                  moderation_labels = rekog_response.get('ModerationLabels', [])
                  moderation_model_version = rekog_response.get('ModerationModelVersion', '')

                  return build_response(200, {
                      'url': image_url,
                      'moderationLabels': moderation_labels,
                      'labelCount': len(moderation_labels),
                      'moderationModelVersion': moderation_model_version
                  })

              except Exception as e:
                  return build_response(500, {'error': f'Internal server error: {str(e)}'})

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vendedlogs/states/account-closure-workflow-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub AccountClosureWorkflowRole-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResourceTaggingPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: OrganizationsPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/*/*
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLoggingPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub ${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*

  EventBridgeExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub AccountClosureEventBridgeRole-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeExpressWorkflow
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:account-closure-workflow-${AWS::StackName}

  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub account-closure-workflow-${AWS::StackName}
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !Sub ${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Hourly workflow to identify, describe, close, and acknowledge accounts requested for closure.",
          "StartAt": "GetTaggedAccountsInitial",
          "States": {
            "GetTaggedAccountsInitial": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:resourcegroupstaggingapi:getResources",
              "Parameters": {
                "ResourceTypeFilters": [
                  "organizations:account"
                ],
                "TagFilters": [
                  {
                    "Key": "${TagKey}",
                    "Values": [
                      "${TagRequestedValue}"
                    ]
                  }
                ]
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.GetResourcesResult",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.ThrottledException",
                    "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.TooManyRequestsException",
                    "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.InternalServiceException",
                    "ThrottlingException",
                    "TooManyRequestsException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 6,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                }
              ],
              "Next": "ProcessAccountsMap"
            },
            "ProcessAccountsMap": {
              "Type": "Map",
              "ItemsPath": "$.GetResourcesResult.ResourceTagMappingList",
              "ItemProcessor": {
                "ProcessorConfig": {
                  "Mode": "INLINE"
                },
                "StartAt": "ExtractAccountId",
                "States": {
                  "ExtractAccountId": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "States.ArrayGetItem(States.StringSplit($.ResourceARN, '/'), 2)",
                      "ResourceARN.$": "$.ResourceARN"
                    },
                    "Next": "DescribeAccount"
                  },
                  "DescribeAccount": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.AccountId"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.AccountDetails",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "ThrottlingException",
                          "TooManyRequestsException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 6,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.AccountNotFoundException",
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                        "Next": "AccountCompleted"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "CheckIfActive"
                  },
                  "CheckIfActive": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.AccountDetails.Account.Status",
                        "StringEquals": "ACTIVE",
                        "Next": "CloseAccount"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "AccountCompleted"
                  },
                  "CloseAccount": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.AccountId"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.CloseAccountResult",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "ThrottlingException",
                          "TooManyRequestsException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 3,
                        "MaxAttempts": 6,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.AccountAlreadyClosedException",
                          "Organizations.ConflictException"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                        "Next": "TagAccountAcknowledged"
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                        "Next": "AccountCompleted"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "TagAccountAcknowledged"
                  },
                  "TagAccountAcknowledged": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "ResourceId.$": "$.AccountId",
                      "Tags": [
                        {
                          "Key": "${TagKey}",
                          "Value": "${TagAcknowledgedValue}"
                        }
                      ]
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.TagResult",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "ThrottlingException",
                          "TooManyRequestsException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 6,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                        "Next": "AccountCompleted"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "AccountCompleted"
                  },
                  "AccountCompleted": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "End": true
                  }
                }
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.MapResult",
              "Next": "HasNextPage"
            },
            "HasNextPage": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "And": [
                    {
                      "Variable": "$.GetResourcesResult.PaginationToken",
                      "IsPresent": true
                    },
                    {
                      "Not": {
                        "Variable": "$.GetResourcesResult.PaginationToken",
                        "StringEquals": ""
                      }
                    }
                  ],
                  "Next": "GetTaggedAccountsNextPage"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "WorkflowSucceeded"
            },
            "GetTaggedAccountsNextPage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:resourcegroupstaggingapi:getResources",
              "Parameters": {
                "ResourceTypeFilters": [
                  "organizations:account"
                ],
                "TagFilters": [
                  {
                    "Key": "${TagKey}",
                    "Values": [
                      "${TagRequestedValue}"
                    ]
                  }
                ],
                "PaginationToken.$": "$.GetResourcesResult.PaginationToken"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.GetResourcesResult",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.ThrottledException",
                    "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.TooManyRequestsException",
                    "ResourceGroupsTaggingAPI.InternalServiceException",
                    "ThrottlingException",
                    "TooManyRequestsException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 6,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                }
              ],
              "Next": "ProcessAccountsMap"
            },
            "WorkflowSucceeded": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            }
          }
        }

  HourlyAccountClosureScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub account-closure-hourly-rule-${AWS::StackName}
      Description: Scheduled rule invoking the account closure Express State Machine hourly.
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
          Id: TargetAccountClosureStateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeExecutionRole.Arn

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Account Closure Express Step Functions State Machine.
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
  StateMachineLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Log Group for execution logs.
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule scheduling the workflow.
    Value: !GetAtt HourlyAccountClosureScheduleRule.Arn
  ScheduleExpression:
    Description: Schedule expression for triggering the account closure workflow.
    Value: !Ref ScheduleExpression
  TargetTagKey:
    Description: Tag key evaluated for account closure requests.
    Value: !Ref TagKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for StudyBuddy Cognito User Pool, Hosted UI, Google IdP, Secrets Manager, and Lambda triggers.

Parameters:
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Unique prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI domain (e.g., studybuddy-auth-12345).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Domain prefix must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and cannot start or end with a hyphen.

  FrontendDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: Base URL of the StudyBuddy frontend application (e.g., https://app.studybuddy.com).
    Default: 'https://app.studybuddy.com'
    AllowedPattern: '^https?://.+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.

  GoogleClientId:
    Type: String
    Description: Google OAuth 2.0 Web Client ID.
    NoEcho: false

  GoogleClientSecret:
    Type: String
    Description: Google OAuth 2.0 Web Client Secret.
    NoEcho: true

Resources:
  # Secrets Manager Secret for Google OAuth Credentials
  GoogleOAuthSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'StudyBuddy/GoogleOAuthCredentials-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: Google OAuth client credentials for StudyBuddy Cognito IdP
      SecretString: !Sub '{"client_id":"${GoogleClientId}","client_secret":"${GoogleClientSecret}"}'

  # IAM Execution Role for Cognito Lambda Triggers
  CognitoTriggerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'studybuddy-cognito-trigger-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Pre Sign-up Trigger Lambda Function
  PreSignUpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-pre-signup-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CognitoTriggerLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('Pre Sign-up Trigger Event:', JSON.stringify(event, null, 2));
            // Auto confirm user if needed or perform custom validation
            event.response.autoConfirmUser = false;
            event.response.autoVerifyEmail = false;
            return event;
          };

  # Post Confirmation Trigger Lambda Function
  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-post-confirmation-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CognitoTriggerLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('Post Confirmation Trigger Event:', JSON.stringify(event, null, 2));
            // Custom post-confirmation processing (e.g. provision user database records)
            return event;
          };

  # Post Authentication Trigger Lambda Function
  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-post-authentication-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CognitoTriggerLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('Post Authentication Trigger Event:', JSON.stringify(event, null, 2));
            // Custom post-authentication processing (e.g. record login timestamp)
            return event;
          };

  # Cognito User Pool
  StudyBuddyUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'studybuddy-user-pool-${AWS::StackName}'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false

  # Lambda Permissions for Cognito Invocations
  PreSignUpLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PostAuthenticationLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  # Cognito Hosted UI Domain
  StudyBuddyUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref CognitoDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool

  # Google Identity Provider for Cognito User Pool
  StudyBuddyGoogleIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref GoogleClientId
        client_secret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: 'profile email openid'
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
        username: sub

  # Cognito User Pool Client for Frontend
  StudyBuddyUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - StudyBuddyGoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ClientName: StudyBuddyWebClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub '${FrontendDomain}/callback'
        - !Ref FrontendDomain
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub '${FrontendDomain}/logout'
        - !Ref FrontendDomain
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the StudyBuddy Cognito User Pool.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: The ARN of the StudyBuddy Cognito User Pool.
    Value: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: The ID of the StudyBuddy Cognito User Pool App Client.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'

  CognitoHostedUIDomain:
    Description: The full URL of the Cognito Hosted UI domain.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HostedUIDomain'

  GoogleOAuthSecretArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Secrets Manager secret storing Google OAuth credentials.
    Value: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GoogleOAuthSecretArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template deploying Users and Fog VPCs with required subnets, route tables, gateway S3 endpoints, and interface endpoints for KMS, Secrets Manager, EventBridge, STS, and Lambda.

Parameters:
  UsersVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.50.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the Users VPC
  UsersSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.50.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the Users Subnet
  FogVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.60.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the Fog VPC
  FogSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.60.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the Fog Subnet

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # Users Layer VPC & Networking Resources
  # =========================================================================
  UsersVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref UsersVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-VPC

  UsersSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref UsersSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-Subnet

  UsersRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Users-RouteTable

  UsersSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref UsersSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template that provisions a set of Security Hub automation rules to automatically suppress accepted, expected, or non-actionable findings across the organization and specific accounts.

Parameters:
  DesignatedSubAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: The designated AWS Account ID for CIS benchmark suppression.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS Account ID.

  EbsSuppressionAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: The designated AWS Account ID for EBS default encryption suppression.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS Account ID.

  InfrequentAutomationAccountId1:
    Type: String
    Description: The first AWS Account ID that runs infrequent automation where unused credential findings will be suppressed.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS Account ID.

  InfrequentAutomationAccountId2:
    Type: String
    Description: The second AWS Account ID that runs infrequent automation where unused credential findings will be suppressed.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS Account ID.

  ExcludedHumanUserArn1:
    Type: String
    Description: Full ARN of the first named human IAM user excluded from org-wide IAM suppression.
    Default: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/admin-jdoe

  ExcludedHumanUserArn2:
    Type: String
    Description: Full ARN of the second named human IAM user excluded from org-wide IAM suppression.
    Default: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/admin-asmith

  IntentionallyPublicBucketArn1:
    Type: String
    Description: Full ARN of the first intentionally public S3 bucket (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::static-marketing-assets).
    Default: arn:aws:s3:::example-public-marketing-assets

  IntentionallyPublicBucketArn2:
    Type: String
    Description: Full ARN of the second intentionally public S3 bucket (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::public-downloads-repository).
    Default: arn:aws:s3:::example-public-downloads-repo

  BedrockGuardDutyFindingType:
    Type: String
    Description: GuardDuty finding type corresponding to expected cross-account Bedrock API activities.
    Default: UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/InstanceCredentialExfiltration.OutsideAWS

  UpdatedByAuthor:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the identity or automated system recorded in the suppression note.
    Default: CloudFormation-SecurityAutomation

Resources:
  Rule1OrgWideIAMSuppression:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Org-Wide IAM Policy Finding Suppression (Excluding Human Admins)
      Description: Suppresses IAM policy and hygiene findings organization-wide while excluding specific named human admin users.
      RuleOrder: 10
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Criteria:
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: SUPPRESSED
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.2
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.4
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.5
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.8
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ExcludedHumanUserArn1
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ExcludedHumanUserArn2
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: Suppressed per accepted security baseline policy for service accounts; human admins remain strictly monitored.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref UpdatedByAuthor

  Rule2DesignatedAccountCISSuppression:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Designated Account CIS Benchmark Finding Suppression
      Description: Suppresses a specific set of CIS benchmark controls in the designated sandbox/workload sub-account.
      RuleOrder: 20
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Criteria:
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: SUPPRESSED
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref DesignatedSubAccountId
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: CIS.1.4
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: CIS.1.5
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: CIS.1.6
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: CIS.1.16
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: CIS.2.1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: CIS.2.8
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: Suppressed CIS benchmark controls evaluated and accepted for designated sub-account workload requirements.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref UpdatedByAuthor

  Rule3OrgWideInfrastructureStandardsSuppression:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Org-Wide Bastion SG, S3 HTTP/Public, and Config Scope Suppression
      Description: Suppresses organization-wide findings for administrative ports on bastion hosts/testing, S3 public/HTTP access baselines, and regional Config recording.
      RuleOrder: 30
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Criteria:
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: SUPPRESSED
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.2
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.18
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.19
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.21
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.2
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.5
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: Config.1
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: Suppressed under accepted risk exception for bastion hosts, static web hosting patterns, and non-primary regional Config coverage.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref UpdatedByAuthor

  Rule4IntentionallyPublicBucketsSuppression:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Known Intentionally Public S3 Buckets Finding Suppression
      Description: Suppresses public access and ACL findings for an approved list of intentionally public S3 buckets.
      RuleOrder: 40
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Criteria:
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: SUPPRESSED
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.2
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.3
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.8
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.12
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref IntentionallyPublicBucketArn1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref IntentionallyPublicBucketArn2
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: Suppressed because these specific S3 buckets are registered and approved for public asset distribution.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref UpdatedByAuthor

  Rule5AccountEBSDefaultEncryptionSuppression:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Single Account EBS Default Encryption Suppression
      Description: Suppresses EC2.7 EBS default encryption findings for a specific account with legacy non-encrypted volume dependencies.

      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Criteria:
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS

          - Comparison: EQUALS

        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.7
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: EBS default encryption finding suppressed for this specific account under approved legacy exemption.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref UpdatedByAuthor

    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: 'AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31'
Description: AWS SAM template provisioning the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function and Bedrock AgentCore Gateway execution role.

Parameters:
  FunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: bac-mcp-tool
    Description: Name of the MCP tool Lambda function.
  MemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1024
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Memory allocation in MB for the Lambda function.
  Timeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 900
    MinValue: 3
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Function execution timeout in seconds.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365]
    Description: CloudWatch log retention period in days.

Resources:
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${FunctionName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-exec-role'
      Description: IAM execution role for the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn
        - PolicyName: XRayTracingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'xray:PutTraceSegments'
                  - 'xray:PutTelemetryRecords'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: BedrockModelInvocationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'bedrock:InvokeModel'
                  - 'bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:custom-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:provisioned-model/*'
        - PolicyName: CostExplorerAndUsagePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ce:GetCostAndUsage'
                  - 'ce:GetCostAndUsageWithResources'
                  - 'ce:GetCostForecast'
                  - 'ce:GetDimensionValues'
                  - 'ce:GetReservationCoverage'
                  - 'ce:GetReservationPurchaseRecommendation'
                  - 'ce:GetReservationUtilization'
                  - 'ce:GetSavingsPlansCoverage'
                  - 'ce:GetSavingsPlansPurchaseRecommendation'
                  - 'ce:GetSavingsPlansUtilization'
                  - 'ce:GetTags'
                  - 'ce:GetUsageForecast'
                  - 'cur:DescribeReportDefinitions'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: S3ObjectAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'

  McpToolLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref FunctionName
      Description: MCP tool function used for testing Bedrock AgentCore Gateway in AWS operations workflows.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: !Ref MemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref Timeout
      Tracing: Active
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      InlineCode: |
        import json
        import logging

        logger = logging.getLogger()
        logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
            return {
                "statusCode": 200,
                "headers": {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                },
                "body": json.dumps({
                    "message": "bac-mcp-tool executed successfully",
                    "requestId": context.aws_request_id
                })
            }

  BedrockAgentCoreGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-gateway-role'
      Description: Execution role assumed by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke tools and access necessary resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockGatewayLambdaInvokePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt McpToolLambdaFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${McpToolLambdaFunction.Arn}:*'
        - PolicyName: BedrockAgentCoreManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'bedrock:GetAgent'
                  - 'bedrock:GetAgentActionGroup'
                  - 'bedrock:GetAgentAlias'
                  - 'bedrock:GetAgentKnowledgeBase'
                  - 'bedrock:GetAgentVersion'
                  - 'bedrock:InvokeAgent'
                  - 'bedrock:ListAgentActionGroups'
                  - 'bedrock:ListAgentAliases'
                  - 'bedrock:ListAgentKnowledgeBases'
                  - 'bedrock:ListAgents'
                  - 'bedrock:ListAgentVersions'
                  - 'bedrock:PrepareAgent'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent-alias/*/*'
        - PolicyName: PassRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService': 'bedrock.amazonaws.com'
        - PolicyName: BedrockGatewayS3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock/*'

Outputs:
  McpToolLambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt McpToolLambdaFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-McpToolLambdaFunctionArn'
  McpToolLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-McpToolLambdaRoleArn'
  BedrockAgentCoreGatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to assume.
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreGatewayRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BedrockAgentCoreGatewayRoleArn'
  LambdaLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Log Group for the Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LambdaLogGroupArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automated EC2 Image Builder pipeline for CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI configured for Elastic Beanstalk with daily scanning, multi-account distribution, and a 6-month lifecycle policy.

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID for AMI sharing (e.g., o-a1b2c3d4e5).
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organization ID starting with 'o-' followed by 10-32 alphanumeric characters.

  OrganizationManagementAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: The 12-digit AWS Account ID of the AWS Organization management account.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid 12-digit AWS Account ID.

  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '111122223333'
    Description: Dummy AWS Account ID for the development environment.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid 12-digit AWS Account ID.

  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '444455556666'
    Description: Dummy AWS Account ID for the production environment.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid 12-digit AWS Account ID.

  ParentImageIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x
    Description: Specific CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM image identifier.

Resources:
  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ec2-imagebuilder-instance-role'
      Description: IAM role for EC2 instances launched during Image Builder workflows
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ec2-imagebuilder-profile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-lifecycle-role'
      Description: IAM role for Image Builder Lifecycle Policy execution
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy'

  ElasticBeanstalkPrerequisitesComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-elastic-beanstalk-prerequisites'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Prepares Amazon Linux 2023 ARM for AWS Elastic Beanstalk platform compatibility
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallEbPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "Updating packages and installing Elastic Beanstalk dependencies..."
                    - dnf update -y
                    - dnf install -y aws-cfn-bootstrap jq wget curl unzip tar gzip shadow-utils
                    - dnf install -y docker containerd
                    - systemctl enable docker.service
                    - groupadd -f docker
                    - usermod -aG docker ec2-user || true
                    - mkdir -p /var/app/current
                    - mkdir -p /var/log/eb-engine
                    - mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - echo "Elastic Beanstalk prerequisites successfully installed."
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateInstallation
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker --version
                    - /opt/aws/bin/cfn-init --version || true

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm-eb-recipe'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: CIS L1 Hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM image recipe for Elastic Beanstalk
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/${ParentImageIdentifier}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkPrerequisitesComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
      Description: Build infrastructure configuration using ARM-based EC2 instances
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref InstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - c7g.large
        - t4g.medium
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dist-config'
      Description: Regional distribution shared to dev and prod accounts and AWS Organization
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-cis-eb-arm-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Hardened AL2023 ARM AMI configured for Elastic Beanstalk
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrganizationManagementAccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline'
      Description: Daily pipeline building CIS Level 1 AL2023 ARM AMIs with vulnerability scanning
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true

  ImageLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-policy'
      Description: Automatically deprecate and delete AMIs older than 6 months (180 days)
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      Status: ENABLED
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Name
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the created EC2 Image Builder Pipeline
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn

  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Recipe
    Value: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the Distribution Configuration
    Value: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn

  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Lifecycle Policy
    Value: !GetAtt ImageLifecyclePolicy.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito authentication.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: The deployment stage for API Gateway.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name for the Cognito User Pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name for the Cognito User Pool App Client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  MathsMcpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps({
                      "message": "Maths MCP Server placeholder response",
                      "input": event
                  })
              }

  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool # wait, fix type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: API for Maths MCP Server
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiGatewayAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  RootGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"status":"healthy"}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiGatewayAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  LambdaApiGatewayInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGatewayRestApi}/*/*/*'

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
