AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for QuickSight administrative monitoring, data lake pipelines, and metric streaming.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket to store Glue ETL scripts and preparation code.

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # Consolidated IAM Role
  # =========================================================================
  ConsolidatedAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub quicksight-admin-monitoring-role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConsolidatedAdminSuitePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:*
                  - quicksight:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                  - firehose:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/quicksight-admin-monitoring-role-${AWS::Region}

  # =========================================================================
  # S3 Data Lake and Script Storage Buckets
  # =========================================================================
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ScriptBucketName
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  # =========================================================================
  # Script Uploader Custom Resource
  # =========================================================================
  ScriptUploaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub quicksight-admin-script-uploader-${AWS::Region}
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')

          SCRIPTS = {
              'scripts/assets_access.py': (
                  "import sys\n"
                  "from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\n"
                  "from pyspark.context import SparkContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.context import GlueContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.job import Job\n"
                  "import boto3\n"
                  "\n"
                  "args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'TARGET_BUCKET'])\n"
                  "sc = SparkContext()\n"
                  "glueContext = GlueContext(sc)\n"
                  "spark = glueContext.spark_session\n"
                  "job = Job(glueContext)\n"
                  "job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n"
                  "print('Extracting QuickSight asset access permissions...')\n"
                  "# Extract and persist assets access data\n"
                  "job.commit()\n"
              ),
              'scripts/dataset_metadata.py': (
                  "import sys\n"
                  "from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\n"
                  "from pyspark.context import SparkContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.context import GlueContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.job import Job\n"
                  "\n"
                  "args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'TARGET_BUCKET'])\n"
                  "sc = SparkContext()\n"
                  "glueContext = GlueContext(sc)\n"
                  "spark = glueContext.spark_session\n"
                  "job = Job(glueContext)\n"
                  "job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n"
                  "print('Extracting QuickSight dataset metadata...')\n"
                  "job.commit()\n"
              ),
              'scripts/folder_assets.py': (
                  "import sys\n"
                  "from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\n"
                  "from pyspark.context import SparkContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.context import GlueContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.job import Job\n"
                  "\n"
                  "args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'TARGET_BUCKET'])\n"
                  "sc = SparkContext()\n"
                  "glueContext = GlueContext(sc)\n"
                  "spark = glueContext.spark_session\n"
                  "job = Job(glueContext)\n"
                  "job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n"
                  "print('Extracting QuickSight folder assets and relationships...')\n"
                  "job.commit()\n"
              ),
              'scripts/q_metadata.py': (
                  "import sys\n"
                  "from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\n"
                  "from pyspark.context import SparkContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.context import GlueContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.job import Job\n"
                  "\n"
                  "args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'TARGET_BUCKET'])\n"
                  "sc = SparkContext()\n"
                  "glueContext = GlueContext(sc)\n"
                  "spark = glueContext.spark_session\n"
                  "job = Job(glueContext)\n"
                  "job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n"
                  "print('Extracting QuickSight Q search index and topic metadata...')\n"
                  "job.commit()\n"
              ),
              'scripts/datasource_properties.py': (
                  "import sys\n"
                  "from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\n"
                  "from pyspark.context import SparkContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.context import GlueContext\n"
                  "from awsglue.job import Job\n"
                  "\n"
                  "args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'TARGET_BUCKET'])\n"
                  "sc = SparkContext()\n"
                  "glueContext = GlueContext(sc)\n"
                  "spark = glueContext.spark_session\n"
                  "job = Job(glueContext)\n"
                  "job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n"
                  "print('Extracting QuickSight datasource properties...')\n"
                  "job.commit()\n"
              )
          }

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  bucket = event['ResourceProperties']['BucketName']
                  if event['RequestType'] in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      for key, body in SCRIPTS.items():
                          s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=body.encode('utf-8'))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error: {e}")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Message": str(e)})

  ScriptUploaderCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::ScriptUploader
    DependsOn:
      - ScriptBucket
      - ConsolidatedAdminRole
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ScriptUploaderFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref ScriptBucket

  # =========================================================================
  # Glue ETL Jobs (Version 5.0)
  # =========================================================================
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUploaderCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-assets-access-pipeline
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      Timeout: 360
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/assets_access.py
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--TARGET_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  GlueJobDatasetMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUploaderCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-dataset-metadata-pipeline
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/dataset_metadata.py
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--TARGET_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUploaderCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-folder-assets-pipeline
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/folder_assets.py
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--TARGET_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUploaderCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-q-metadata-pipeline
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/q_metadata.py
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--TARGET_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUploaderCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-datasource-properties-pipeline
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/datasource_properties.py
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--TARGET_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  # =========================================================================
  # Glue Triggers (Staggered daily sequence starting at 2 AM UTC)
  # =========================================================================
  GlueTriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-quicksight-assets-access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  GlueTriggerDatasetMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-quicksight-dataset-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(15 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasetMetadata

  GlueTriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-quicksight-folder-assets
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(30 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  GlueTriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-quicksight-q-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(45 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  GlueTriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-quicksight-datasource-properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  # =========================================================================
  # Kinesis Data Firehose Delivery Streams
  # =========================================================================
  IngestionFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-cw-ingestion-stream
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/ingestion/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: cloudwatch/ingestion-errors/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP

  DashboardFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-cw-dashboards-stream
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/dashboards/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: cloudwatch/dashboards-errors/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP

  SpiceFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-cw-spice-stream
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/spice/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: cloudwatch/spice-errors/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP

  QIndexFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-cw-qindex-stream
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/q-index/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: cloudwatch/q-index-errors/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP

  QActionFirehoseStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:

      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:

        Prefix: cloudwatch/q-actions/year=!{timestamp:yyyy}/month=!{timestamp:MM}/day=!{timestamp:dd}/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: cloudwatch/q-actions-errors/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP

  # =========================================================================
  # CloudWatch Metric Streams
  # =========================================================================
  IngestionMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-ingestion-metric-stream
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt IngestionFirehoseStream.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedAdminRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight

  DashboardMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-dashboard-metric-stream
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DashboardFirehoseStream.Arn

  QActionMetricStream:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready ECS Fargate microservice registered with AWS Cloud Map private DNS (SRV record), VPC with public and private subnets, NAT Gateway, and step auto-scaling.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for naming and tagging (e.g., dev, staging, prod).

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: web-service
    Description: The name of the microservice.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Container image URI to deploy.

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Port exposed by the container.

  TaskCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '256'
    AllowedValues:
      - '256'
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '4096'
    Description: Number of CPU units used by the task.

  TaskMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues:
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '3072'
      - '4096'
      - '5120'
      - '6144'
      - '7168'
      - '8192'
    Description: Amount of memory (in MiB) used by the task.

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Initial desired number of ECS tasks.

  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional IAM Role ARN for the ECS tasks to assume to access AWS resources.

  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR range between /16 and /28.
    Description: The IP range for the VPC.

  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet (used for NAT Gateway).

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1 in AZ 1.

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2 in AZ 2.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, '']]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt

  DefaultPrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS Fargate tasks allowing VPC internal communication
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
          Description: Allow incoming traffic on container port from VPC
        - IpProtocol: icmp
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
          Description: Allow ICMP ping within VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg

  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}.local
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Description: Private DNS namespace for service discovery
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-dns

  ServiceDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      Description: Cloud Map service discovery for ECS microservice
      DnsConfig:
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-discovery

  CloudWatchLogsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-cluster
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-cluster

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasCustomTaskRole, !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref CloudWatchLogsGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-taskdef

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - DefaultPrivateRoute
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      EnableExecuteCommand: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-service

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 2
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${ECSCluster}/${ECSService.Name}
      RoleARN: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_ECSService
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-up
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 2

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-down
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  CPUUtilizationHighAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-CPUUtilization-High-70
      AlarmDescription: Triggers scale up when CPU utilization is >= 70%
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy

  CPUUtilizationLowAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-CPUUtilization-Low-20
      AlarmDescription: Triggers scale down when CPU utilization is <= 20%
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: Public Subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ECSClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster Name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

  ECSServiceName:
    Description: ECS Service Name
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespaceId:
    Description: Cloud Map Private DNS Namespace ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace

  ServiceDiscoveryArn:
    Description: Cloud Map Service Discovery Service ARN
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn

  ServiceDiscoveryDnsName:
    Description: DNS discovery record name for the service
    Value: !Sub ${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.local

  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID for the service
    Value: !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
all_security_errors: [AWS-0104] CRITICAL: A security group rule should not allow unrestricted egress to any IP address. — Security group rule allows unrestricted egress to any IP address. | [AWS-0164] HIGH: Instances in a subnet should not receive a public IP address by default. — Subnet associates public IP address.
latest_error_trivy: [AWS-0104] CRITICAL: A security group rule should not allow unrestricted egress to any IP address. — Security group rule allows unrestricted egress to any IP address. | [AWS-0164] HIGH: Instances in a subnet should not receive a public IP address by default. — Subnet associates public IP address.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demonstrations with OCI primary region.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.94.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the AWS VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range between /16 and /28.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.94.10.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet in the first available AZ.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range between /16 and /28.

  InternalAllowedHttpsCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.94.0.0/16'
    Description: Configurable internal CIDR range permitted for HTTPS inbound traffic.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range.

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.100.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block of the OCI primary region / backbone network.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range.

  EnableOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Flag to conditionally create the Customer Gateway and static VPN connection to OCI.

  OciGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Default: '203.0.113.1'
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI VPN endpoint / Customer Gateway.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.

  OciBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 31898
    Description: BGP ASN for the OCI Customer Gateway (used for static VPN provisioning).

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateOciVpn: !Equals [!Ref EnableOciVpn, 'true']

Resources:
  KmsFlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch log group encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-logs-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  KmsFlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsFlowLogsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsFlowLogsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  DefaultIgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Restrict inbound to internal HTTPS and outbound to OCI HTTPS
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalAllowedHttpsCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from internal CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS outbound only to OCI backbone CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Description: Hybrid interconnect Transit Gateway connecting AWS to OCI
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'

  VpcOciRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  CustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: ShouldCreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciBgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref OciGatewayIp
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-cgw'

  OciVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: ShouldCreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn'

  OciVpnConnectionRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Condition: ShouldCreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref OciVpnConnection

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the hybrid network VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  SubnetId:
    Description: ID of the subnet in the first available AZ
    Value: !Ref Subnet

  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the HTTPS restricted security group
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Transit Gateway
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway

  TransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the Transit Gateway VPC Attachment
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for VPC Flow Logs encryption

  LogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Log Group for VPC Flow Logs

    Condition: ShouldCreateOciVpn
    Description: ID of the OCI Customer Gateway
    Value: !Ref CustomerGateway

  VpnConnectionId:
    Condition: ShouldCreateOciVpn
    Description: ID of the static VPN Connection to OCI
    Value: !Ref OciVpnConnection

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline, including S3 storage, IAM roles, Glue jobs, and triggers.

Parameters:
  ScriptLocationBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the existing S3 bucket containing the Glue Python scripts (or defaults to the newly created bucket).
    Default: ''
  ScriptLocationPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 prefix/path where Glue scripts are located.
    Default: 'scripts/'
  TriggerScheduleCron:
    Type: String
    Description: Cron schedule expression for running the Glue jobs every 3 hours.
    Default: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail log table for Athena/downstream QuickSight admin analysis.
    Default: 'cloudtrail_logs'

Conditions:
  UseCreatedBucketForScripts: !Equals [!Ref ScriptLocationBucket, '']

Resources:
  QuickSightAdminBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'quicksight-admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  GlueQuickSightAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'QuickSightAdminGlueRole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAdminPipelineAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:*
                  - quicksight:*
                  - glue:*
                  - s3:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: '*'

  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-group-membership
      Description: PythonShell Glue job to extract QuickSight group memberships
      Role: !GetAtt GlueQuickSightAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub
          - 's3://${Bucket}/${Prefix}group_membership.py'
          - Bucket: !If [UseCreatedBucketForScripts, !Ref QuickSightAdminBucket, !Ref ScriptLocationBucket]
            Prefix: !Ref ScriptLocationPrefix
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 60
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': 'python'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/temp/'
        '--OUTPUT_PATH': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/group_membership/'

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-object-access
      Description: PythonShell Glue job to extract QuickSight object access permissions
      Role: !GetAtt GlueQuickSightAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub
          - 's3://${Bucket}/${Prefix}object_access.py'
          - Bucket: !If [UseCreatedBucketForScripts, !Ref QuickSightAdminBucket, !Ref ScriptLocationBucket]
            Prefix: !Ref ScriptLocationPrefix
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 60
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': 'python'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/temp/'
        '--OUTPUT_PATH': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/object_access/'

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-folder-assets
      Description: PythonShell Glue job to extract QuickSight folder assets
      Role: !GetAtt GlueQuickSightAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub
          - 's3://${Bucket}/${Prefix}folder_assets.py'
          - Bucket: !If [UseCreatedBucketForScripts, !Ref QuickSightAdminBucket, !Ref ScriptLocationBucket]
            Prefix: !Ref ScriptLocationPrefix
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 60
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': 'python'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/temp/'
        '--OUTPUT_PATH': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/folder_assets/'

  FolderLookupJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-folder-lookup
      Description: Glue ETL job to transform and create folder lookup tables
      Role: !GetAtt GlueQuickSightAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub
          - 's3://${Bucket}/${Prefix}folder_lookup.py'
          - Bucket: !If [UseCreatedBucketForScripts, !Ref QuickSightAdminBucket, !Ref ScriptLocationBucket]
            Prefix: !Ref ScriptLocationPrefix
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 60
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': 'python'
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-disable'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/temp/'
        '--OUTPUT_PATH': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/folder_lookup/'

  FolderPathJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-folder-path
      Description: Glue ETL job to process QuickSight folder paths and hierarchy
      Role: !GetAtt GlueQuickSightAdminRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub
          - 's3://${Bucket}/${Prefix}folder_path.py'
          - Bucket: !If [UseCreatedBucketForScripts, !Ref QuickSightAdminBucket, !Ref ScriptLocationBucket]
            Prefix: !Ref ScriptLocationPrefix
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 60
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': 'python'
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-disable'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/temp/'
        '--OUTPUT_PATH': !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/folder_path/'

  GroupMembershipTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-group-membership-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref TriggerScheduleCron
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GroupMembershipJob

  ObjectAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-object-access-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref TriggerScheduleCron
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref ObjectAccessJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-folder-assets-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref TriggerScheduleCron
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  FolderLookupTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-folder-lookup-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref TriggerScheduleCron
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderLookupJob

  FolderPathTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-admin-folder-path-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref TriggerScheduleCron
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderPathJob

Outputs:
  AdminBucketName:
    Description: Name of the QuickSight admin data pipeline S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref QuickSightAdminBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AdminBucketName'

  GroupMembershipS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for group membership output data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/group_membership/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GroupMembershipS3Path'

  ObjectAccessS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for object access output data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/object_access/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ObjectAccessS3Path'

  FolderAssetsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder assets output data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/folder_assets/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderAssetsS3Path'

  FolderLookupS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder lookup output data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/folder_lookup/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderLookupS3Path'

  FolderPathS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder path output data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/data/folder_path/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderPathS3Path'

  CloudTrailLogTableNameOutput:
    Description: CloudTrail log table name for downstream use
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogTableName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogTableName'

  CloudTrailLogS3Location:
    Description: S3 location for CloudTrail logs
    Value: !Sub 's3://${QuickSightAdminBucket}/cloudtrail_logs/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogS3Location'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a complete EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom Chef component, build workflow, daily schedule, tests, scanning, and lifecycle policy.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for tagging and resource naming conventions.

  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x
    Description: ARN of the parent image (Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI). Update region or version as needed.

  ChefRecipeS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket name where Chef recipes and artifacts are stored.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name.

  ChefRecipeS3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: chef/cookbooks.tar.gz
    Description: S3 object key for the Chef cookbook archive or recipe file.

  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Target AWS Region for AMI distribution.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 50
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Root volume size in GiB for the target AMI.

  RootVolumeType:
    Type: String
    Default: gp3
    AllowedValues:
      - gp2
      - gp3
      - io2
    Description: Storage volume type for the root block device.

  PipelineScheduleCron:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 0 * * ? *)
    Description: Daily cron schedule expression for the EC2 Image Builder pipeline.

  AmiDeprecationDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3650
    Description: Number of days after which built AMIs will be deprecated by the lifecycle policy.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ImageBuilderInstanceRole-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3ChefRecipeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${ChefRecipeS3Bucket}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${ChefRecipeS3Bucket}/*

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ImageBuilderInstanceProfile-${AWS::Region}
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ImageBuilderLifecycleRole-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLifecycleManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:DeleteImage
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:EnableImageDeprecation
                  - ec2:DisableImageDeprecation
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                Resource: '*'

  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ExecuteChefRecipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Downloads and executes Chef recipes from an S3 bucket.
      Data: !Sub |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallChef
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo "Installing Cinc/Chef Client..."
                    - curl -L https://omnitruck.cinc.sh/install.sh | bash || curl -L https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh | bash
              - name: DownloadChefArtifacts
                action: S3Download
                inputs:
                  - source: s3://${ChefRecipeS3Bucket}/${ChefRecipeS3Key}
                    destination: /tmp/chef-artifacts.tar.gz
              - name: ExtractAndRunChef
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /etc/chef /var/chef
                    - tar -xzf /tmp/chef-artifacts.tar.gz -C /var/chef
                    - |
                      if [ -f /var/chef/solo.rb ]; then
                        chef-solo -c /var/chef/solo.rb -j /var/chef/dna.json
                      elif [ -f /var/chef/run.sh ]; then
                        chmod +x /var/chef/run.sh
                        /var/chef/run.sh
                      else
                        echo "Executing fallback chef-solo configuration"
                        chef-solo --chef-license accept-silent -o "recipe[default]"
                      fi
                    - rm -f /tmp/chef-artifacts.tar.gz

  CustomBuildWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-BuildWorkflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Custom build workflow that updates SSM agent and collects metadata before AMI creation.
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        parameters:
          - name: waitForActionTimeoutSeconds
            type: string
            default: "7200"
            description: "Timeout in seconds for actions"
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: "ssmAgent"
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: ExecuteBash
            inputs:
              instanceId: '{{ steps.LaunchBuildInstance.outputs.instanceId }}'
              commands:
                - echo "Updating AWS SSM Agent..."
                - yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent || true
                - systemctl status amazon-ssm-agent || true
          - name: ExecuteBuildComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId: '{{ steps.LaunchBuildInstance.outputs.instanceId }}'
          - name: CollectSystemMetadata
            action: ExecuteBash
            inputs:
              instanceId: '{{ steps.LaunchBuildInstance.outputs.instanceId }}'
              commands:
                - echo "Collecting build metadata..."
                - mkdir -p /etc/imagebuilder
                - uname -a > /etc/imagebuilder/kernel-info.txt
                - cat /etc/os-release > /etc/imagebuilder/os-release.txt
                - rpm -qa --last > /etc/imagebuilder/installed-packages.txt
                - date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" > /etc/imagebuilder/build-timestamp.txt
          - name: CreateAMI
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId: '{{ steps.LaunchBuildInstance.outputs.instanceId }}'
          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId: '{{ steps.LaunchBuildInstance.outputs.instanceId }}'

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EcsOptimizedAl2Recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ChefRecipeComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: !Ref RootVolumeType
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-InfraConfig
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

    Type: String
    Default: TestUserTable
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
  AlarmNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String

    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AWS CloudFormation template for a content-level PII classification scanner
  for files accessed via an S3 Access Point, powered by Amazon Comprehend,
  storing findings in Amazon DynamoDB with optional SNS alerting and configurable VPC deployment.

Parameters:
  S3AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the S3 Access Point to be scanned (e.g., arn:aws:s3:us-east-1:123456789012:accesspoint/my-ap).
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:s3:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:accesspoint\/[a-zA-Z0-9.\-_]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 Access Point ARN.

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Optional VPC ID. Required only if the target S3 Access Point is VPC-scoped.
      Leave empty for internet-origin access points (runs Lambda outside VPC).

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Comma-separated list of Subnet IDs where the Lambda scanner will be placed.
      Required if VpcId is provided. Leave empty if running outside VPC.

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Security Group ID for the Lambda function.
      Required if VpcId is provided. Leave empty if running outside VPC.

  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Comma-separated list of Route Table IDs to associate with S3 and DynamoDB Gateway VPC Endpoints.
      Required only if VpcId is provided and CreateVpcEndpoints is true.

  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >
      Controls whether the template creates VPC endpoints (S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, SNS).
      Set to false if the target VPC already has any of these endpoints to avoid deployment conflicts.

  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Optional SNS Topic ARN to send scan completion notifications and alerts when PII is detected.
      Leave empty to disable SNS notifications.

  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Memory size allocated to the scanner Lambda function (in MB).

  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Timeout for the scanner Lambda function (in seconds, max 900).

  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'en'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'en'
      - 'es'
      - 'fr'
      - 'de'
      - 'it'
      - 'pt'
      - 'ar'
      - 'hi'
      - 'ja'
      - 'ko'
      - 'zh'
      - 'zh-TW'
    Description: Default language code for Amazon Comprehend PII entity detection.

  MaxFilesToScan:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 5000
    Description: Maximum number of files to scan per invocation (runtime and cost control).

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  ShouldCreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, 'true']
  HasSnsTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsTopicArn, '']]

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # DynamoDB Storage for PII Classification Reports
  # =========================================================================
  PiiReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PiiClassificationReports
        - Key: Application
          Value: S3-AccessPoint-PII-Scanner

  # =========================================================================
  # VPC Endpoints (Conditional on HasVpc AND CreateVpcEndpoints == true)
  # =========================================================================
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Comprehend and SNS interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref SecurityGroupId
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from Lambda scanner security group
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: pii-scanner-vpce-sg

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  DynamoDBGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: ShouldCreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  # =========================================================================
  # IAM Execution Role for Lambda Scanner
  # =========================================================================
  ScannerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 's3-ap-pii-scanner-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - !If
          - HasVpc
          - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiiScannerPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Ref S3AccessPointArn
                  - !Sub '${S3AccessPointArn}/object/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                  - comprehend:ContainsPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt PiiReportTable.Arn
              - !If
                - HasSnsTopic
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - sns:Publish
                  Resource: !Ref SnsTopicArn
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # =========================================================================
  # Scanner Lambda Function
  # =========================================================================
  ScannerLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 's3-ap-pii-scanner-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Scans objects via S3 Access Point using Amazon Comprehend for PII detection
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
          SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Ref S3AccessPointArn
          DYNAMODB_TABLE: !Ref PiiReportTable
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFilesToScan
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SnsTopicArn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import uuid
          import logging
          import datetime
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          s3_client = boto3.client('s3')
          comprehend_client = boto3.client('comprehend')
          dynamodb_client = boto3.client('dynamodb')
          sns_client = boto3.client('sns')

          ACCESS_POINT_ARN = os.environ.get('ACCESS_POINT_ARN')
          DYNAMODB_TABLE = os.environ.get('DYNAMODB_TABLE')
          DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE = os.environ.get('LANGUAGE_CODE', 'en')
          DEFAULT_MAX_FILES = int(os.environ.get('MAX_FILES', '500'))
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN', '')

          # Maximum chunk size for Comprehend DetectPiiEntities (UTF-8 bytes limit is 100 KB)
          MAX_CHUNK_BYTES = 90 * 1024
          # Sampling limit: maximum number of chunks per file to inspect
          MAX_CHUNKS_PER_FILE = 10

          def chunk_text(text, max_bytes):
              current_chunk = []
              current_size = 0
              lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
              for line in lines:
                  line_bytes = len(line.encode('utf-8'))
                  if line_bytes > max_bytes:
                      # Split long line into slice boundaries
                      start = 0
                      while start < len(line):
                          slice_part = line[start:start + 4000]
                          part_bytes = len(slice_part.encode('utf-8'))
                          if current_size + part_bytes > max_bytes:
                              if current_chunk:
                                  yield "".join(current_chunk)
                                  current_chunk = []
                                  current_size = 0
                          current_chunk.append(slice_part)
                          current_size += part_bytes
                          start += 4000
                  elif current_size + line_bytes > max_bytes:
                      if current_chunk:
                          yield "".join(current_chunk)
                      current_chunk = [line]
                      current_size = line_bytes
                  else:
                      current_chunk.append(line)
                      current_size += line_bytes

              if current_chunk:
                  yield "".join(current_chunk)

          def scan_object(ap_arn, key, lang_code):
              try:
                  response = s3_client.get_object(Bucket=ap_arn, Key=key)
                  body_bytes = response['Body'].read()
              except ClientError as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error reading object {key} from {ap_arn}: {e}")
                  return None, str(e)

              try:
                  text = body_bytes.decode('utf-8')
              except UnicodeDecodeError:
                  try:
                      text = body_bytes.decode('latin-1')
                  except Exception as ex:
                      logger.warning(f"File {key} is binary or unsupported encoding: {ex}")
                      return {'status': 'SKIPPED_BINARY', 'pii_found': False, 'findings': {}}, None

              entity_summary = {}
              total_entities = 0
              chunks_analyzed = 0

              for chunk in chunk_text(text, MAX_CHUNK_BYTES):
                  chunks_analyzed += 1
                  if chunks_analyzed > MAX_CHUNKS_PER_FILE:
                      logger.info(f"Sampling limit reached ({MAX_CHUNKS_PER_FILE} chunks) for {key}")
                      break

                  if not chunk.strip():
                      continue

                  try:
                      comp_resp = comprehend_client.detect_pii_entities(
                          Text=chunk,
                          LanguageCode=lang_code
                      )
                      for entity in comp_resp.get('Entities', []):
                          etype = entity['Type']
                          score = float(entity['Score'])
                          if etype not in entity_summary:
                              entity_summary[etype] = {'count': 0, 'max_score': 0.0}
                          entity_summary[etype]['count'] += 1
                          if score > entity_summary[etype]['max_score']:
                              entity_summary[etype]['max_score'] = score
                          total_entities += 1
                  except ClientError as err:
                      logger.error(f"Comprehend error on object {key}, chunk {chunks_analyzed}: {err}")
                      return None, str(err)

              return {
                  'status': 'SCANNED',
                  'chunks_analyzed': chunks_analyzed,
                  'total_pii_count': total_entities,
                  'pii_found': (total_entities > 0),
                  'findings': entity_summary
              }, None

          def write_report_to_dynamodb(scan_id, key, result, error_msg=None):
              item = {
                  'ScanId': {'S': scan_id},
                  'ObjectKey': {'S': key},
                  'Timestamp': {'S': datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z'},
                  'Status': {'S': result.get('status', 'ERROR') if result else 'ERROR'},
                  'PiiFound': {'BOOL': result.get('pii_found', False) if result else False},
                  'TotalPiiCount': {'N': str(result.get('total_pii_count', 0) if result else 0)},
                  'FindingsJson': {'S': json.dumps(result.get('findings', {}) if result else {})},
                  'ChunksAnalyzed': {'N': str(result.get('chunks_analyzed', 0) if result else 0)}
              }
              if error_msg:
                  item['ErrorMessage'] = {'S': error_msg}

              dynamodb_client.put_item(
                  TableName=DYNAMODB_TABLE,
                  Item=item
              )

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              scan_id = event.get('scan_id', str(uuid.uuid4()))
              ap_arn = event.get('access_point_arn', ACCESS_POINT_ARN)
              lang_code = event.get('language_code', DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE)
              max_files = int(event.get('max_files', DEFAULT_MAX_FILES))
              prefix = event.get('prefix', '')

              logger.info(f"Starting scan {scan_id} for Access Point {ap_arn}, max_files={max_files}, prefix='{prefix}'")

              scanned_count = 0
              pii_detected_files = []
              continuation_token = None

              while scanned_count < max_files:
                  list_kwargs = {'Bucket': ap_arn, 'MaxKeys': min(100, max_files - scanned_count)}
                  if prefix:
                      list_kwargs['Prefix'] = prefix
                  if continuation_token:
                      list_kwargs['ContinuationToken'] = continuation_token

                  try:
                      list_resp = s3_client.list_objects_v2(**list_kwargs)
                  except ClientError as e:
                      logger.error(f"Failed to list objects on access point {ap_arn}: {e}")
                      raise e

                  contents = list_resp.get('Contents', [])
                  if not contents:
                      break

                  for obj in contents:
                      key = obj['Key']
                      # Skip pseudo directory keys
                      if key.endswith('/'):
                          continue

                      logger.info(f"Scanning object: {key} (Size: {obj.get('Size', 0)} bytes)")
                      result, err = scan_object(ap_arn, key, lang_code)
                      write_report_to_dynamodb(scan_id, key, result, err)

                      if result and result.get('pii_found'):
                          pii_detected_files.append({
                              'key': key,
                              'count': result.get('total_pii_count', 0),
                              'types': list(result.get('findings', {}).keys())
                          })

                      scanned_count += 1
                      if scanned_count >= max_files:
                          break

                  if list_resp.get('IsTruncated') and scanned_count < max_files:
                      continuation_token = list_resp.get('NextContinuationToken')
                  else:
                      break

              summary = {
                  'ScanId': scan_id,
                  'AccessPointArn': ap_arn,
                  'TotalFilesScanned': scanned_count,
                  'FilesWithPiiCount': len(pii_detected_files),
                  'PiiFiles': pii_detected_files[:50],
                  'CompletedAt': datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z'
              }

              if SNS_TOPIC_ARN:
                  subject = f"PII Scan Complete - {len(pii_detected_files)} sensitive file(s) found"
                  message = (
                      f"PII Classification Scan Completed\n\n"
                      f"Scan ID: {scan_id}\n"
                      f"Access Point: {ap_arn}\n"
                      f"Total Files Scanned: {scanned_count}\n"
                      f"Files with PII: {len(pii_detected_files)}\n\n"
                      f"Details written to DynamoDB Table: {DYNAMODB_TABLE}\n"
                  )
                  try:
                      sns_client.publish(
                          TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN,
                          Subject=subject[:100],
                          Message=message
                      )
                      logger.info("Published scan summary to SNS topic")
                  except ClientError as sns_err:
                      logger.error(f"Failed to publish to SNS: {sns_err}")

              logger.info(f"Scan {scan_id} finished. Summary: {json.dumps(summary)}")
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': summary
              }

          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
