AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template to deploy an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP integration supporting AI-driven protein variant effect prediction.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Name of the project used for naming and tagging resources.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for protein variant effect prediction MCP integration.
    Description: Description of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name for the AgentCore Gateway. If left blank, it will be automatically generated from the project name.

  LambdaArnSsmPath:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/backend/lambda-arn
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path containing the backend Lambda function ARN.

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlSsmPath:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/auth/discovery-url
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path containing the Cognito discovery URL.

  CognitoClientIdSsmPath:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/auth/client-id
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path containing the Cognito user pool client ID.

  RoleArnSsmPath:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/agentcore/gateway-role-arn
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path where the newly created AgentCore IAM role ARN will be stored.

Conditions:
  HasCustomGatewayName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']]

Resources:
  AgentCoreExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: IAM execution role allowing Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke the backend Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeBackendLambdaFunction
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Sub '{{resolve:ssm:${LambdaArnSsmPath}}}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AgentCoreRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready private VPC infrastructure with multi-AZ ALB subnets, Lambda subnet, optional NAT Gateway for egress, and KMS-encrypted artifact S3 bucket.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  AlbSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for ALB Subnet 1 (Availability Zone 1).
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  AlbSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for ALB Subnet 2 (Availability Zone 2).
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the Lambda Subnet.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable or disable NAT Gateway for internet egress (required for OAuth and external identity provider flows).

Conditions:
  IsNatGatewayEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  AlbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-1'

  AlbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-2'

  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-subnet'

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw'

  AlbRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-rt'

  AlbInternetRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AlbRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  AlbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AlbRouteTable

  AlbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AlbRouteTable

  LambdaRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-rt'

  LambdaDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref LambdaRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  LambdaSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref LambdaRouteTable

  ArtifactStorageKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for artifact storage S3 bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: artifact-storage-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-artifact-key'

  ArtifactStorageKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-artifacts'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactStorageKmsKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactStorageKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-artifact-bucket'

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTlsRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  AlbSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID for ALB Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref AlbSubnet1

  AlbSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID for ALB Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref AlbSubnet2

  LambdaSubnetId:
    Description: Subnet ID for Lambda Subnet
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubnet

  NatGatewayId:
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for internet egress
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

  ArtifactStorageKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key for artifact encryption
    Value: !GetAtt ArtifactStorageKmsKey.Arn

  ArtifactStorageKeyId:
    Description: Key ID of the customer managed KMS key
    Value: !Ref ArtifactStorageKmsKey

  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Name of the artifact storage S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket

  ArtifactBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the artifact storage S3 bucket
    Value: !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template creating a two-step Step Functions state machine and two separate API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST) with dedicated IAM roles to execute the workflow.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Deployment stage name for the API Gateways.

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Step Functions State Machine
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  # Two-Step Pass Step Functions State Machine
  TwoStepStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TwoStepStateMachine'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "A simple two-step pass workflow",
          "StartAt": "StepOne",
          "States": {
            "StepOne": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "status": "Step 1 executed successfully"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.step1Output",
              "Next": "StepTwo"
            },
            "StepTwo": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "status": "Step 2 executed successfully"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.step2Output",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  # ============================================================================
  # API 1: GET API
  # ============================================================================
  GetApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt TwoStepStateMachine.Arn

  GetRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GetApi'
      Description: REST API with GET method to start Step Functions state machine execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  GetApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution

  GetApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "input": "{}",
              "stateMachineArn": "${TwoStepStateMachine}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi

  GetApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref EnvironmentStage

  # ============================================================================
  # API 2: POST API
  # ============================================================================
  PostApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt TwoStepStateMachine.Arn

  PostRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PostApi'
      Description: REST API with POST method to start Step Functions state machine execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  PostApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for an audit event SQS queue with KMS encryption, environment-specific configuration, optional DLQ, and CloudWatch alarms with SNS alerts.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment. Non-dev environments enable Dead Letter Queues and stricter retention.

  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address to receive CloudWatch alarm notifications via SNS.

  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Number of times a message can be delivered to the source queue before being moved to the dead-letter queue.

  OldMessageAgeAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Maximum age of oldest message in seconds before triggering an alarm.

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: '345600'
      VisibilityTimeout: '60'
      EnableDLQ: 'false'
    test:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: '604800'
      VisibilityTimeout: '120'
      EnableDLQ: 'true'
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: '1209600'
      VisibilityTimeout: '300'
      EnableDLQ: 'true'
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: '1209600'
      VisibilityTimeout: '300'
      EnableDLQ: 'true'

Conditions:
  IsNonDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, 'dev']]
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  AuditQueueKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS customer managed key for audit event SQS queue encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: AuditQueueKeyPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsAndServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - sns.amazonaws.com
                - sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AuditEventsEncryption

  AuditQueueKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/audit-queue-key-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'audit-queue-alarms-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlarmNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: AlarmTopicPolicy
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
      Protocol: email
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  AuditDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'audit-events-dlq-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AuditDeadLetterQueue

  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'audit-events-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditDeadLetterQueue.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !Ref MaxReceiveCount
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AuditEvents

  OldMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'audit-queue-old-messages-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when the oldest message in the audit queue exceeds the specified age threshold.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref OldMessageAgeAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  DLQMessageCountAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'audit-queue-dlq-messages-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when there are messages visible in the dead letter queue.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

Outputs:
  AuditQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the main audit events SQS queue
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditQueueUrl'

  AuditQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the main audit events SQS queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditQueueArn'

  AuditDLQUrl:
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Description: URL of the audit dead letter SQS queue

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for researchapp and AgentCore Cognito User Pool, Clients, Resource Server, Groups, Lambda hook, and SSM Parameter Store configurations.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the M2M Cognito User Pool Client.
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the Web App Cognito User Pool Client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OPTIONAL'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: 'https://api.researchapp.agentcore'
      Name: 'AgentCoreResourceServer'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: 'read'
          ScopeDescription: 'Read access to AgentCore resources'

  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: 'admin'
      Description: 'Administrative users with higher precedence'
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: 'customer'
      Description: 'Customer users group'
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - 'https://api.researchapp.agentcore/read'
      CallbackURLs:
        - 'http://localhost:8501/'
        - 'https://example.com/auth/callback'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - 'https://api.researchapp.agentcore/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  AddUserToCustomerGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToCustomerGroupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  AddUserToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: researchapp-agentcore-add-customer-group
      Description: Adds new users to the customer group in Cognito (not wired as trigger)
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt AddUserToCustomerGroupRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          GROUP_NAME: 'customer'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          cognito_client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = os.environ.get('USER_POOL_ID')
              group_name = os.environ.get('GROUP_NAME', 'customer')
              user_name = event.get('userName')
              
              if not user_name:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'body': 'Missing userName in event'
                  }
                  
              try:
                  cognito_client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=user_name,
                      GroupName=group_name
                  )
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': f'Successfully added {user_name} to {group_name}'
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error adding user to group: {str(e)}")
                  raise e

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  SSMCognitoDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito Domain Name

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect Discovery URL

  SSMTokenUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: Cognito OAuth Token URL

  SSMAuthorizeUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: Cognito OAuth Authorize URL

  SSMOAuthScopes:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth_scopes
      Type: String
      Value: 'https://api.researchapp.agentcore/read'
      Description: Cognito Resource Server Custom Scopes

  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Cognito Web Client ID

  SSMMachineClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
      Description: Cognito Machine-to-Machine Client ID

  SSMMachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_secret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineAppClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Cognito Machine-to-Machine Client Secret

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  CognitoDomainUrl:
    Description: Cognito Domain URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  WebAppClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the Web App Client
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  MachineAppClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the Machine-to-Machine Client
    Value: !Ref MachineAppClient

    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSyncDynamoDBRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem

                  - !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${APIDataTable.Arn}/*'

  CryptoTickerGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String!
          priceUSD: Float
          timestamp: String!
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          priceUSD: Float
          timestamp: String
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo

        schema {
          query: Query

    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId

    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableSource

      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn

        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable

          #set($priceData = $body.get($symbolLower))

          $util.toJson({

          })
        #else
          $util.error($ctx.result.body, "HttpError")
        #end

  StorePriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration

      Name: StorePriceInDynamoDB

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for MediaPackage live channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints, conditional origination control for Live-to-VOD workflows, and optional MediaPackage VOD resources.

Parameters:
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: live-stream
    Description: Prefix to be used for logical and physical naming of created resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, and underscores.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    AllowedValues:
      - Development
      - Staging
      - Production
    Description: Deployment environment name for tagging and resource identification.

  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: Project
    Description: Key name for a custom resource tag.

  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: MediaStreaming
    Description: Value for the custom resource tag.

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 bucket name for live-to-VOD archive storage. If provided, origin endpoints will set origination to DENY.

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 bucket name for VOD source video assets.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Packaging format output type for VOD configurations.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Manifest name for endpoints and packaging configurations.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, and underscores.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for HLS packaging and origin endpoints.

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Startover window in seconds for the origin endpoints (max 14 days).

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  EnableVod: !Or [!Condition HasArchiveBucket, !Condition HasVodSourceBucket]
  HasBothBuckets: !And [!Condition HasArchiveBucket, !Condition HasVodSourceBucket]
  HasOnlyArchiveBucket: !And [!Condition HasArchiveBucket, !Not [!Condition HasVodSourceBucket]]
  HasOnlyVodSourceBucket: !And [!Condition HasVodSourceBucket, !Not [!Condition HasArchiveBucket]]
  CreateHlsVod: !And
    - !Condition EnableVod
    - !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'APPLE_HLS'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]
  CreateDashVod: !And
    - !Condition EnableVod
    - !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ISO_DASH'], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, 'ALL']]

Resources:
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'Live streaming channel for ${LogicalNamePrefix}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls-endpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix}'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, 'DENY', 'ALLOW']
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
        PlaylistType: EVENT
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash-endpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix}'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, 'DENY', 'ALLOW']
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        ManifestWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
        Profile: NONE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  MediaPackageVodRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !If
                  - HasBothBuckets
                  - - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
                  - !If
                    - HasOnlyArchiveBucket
                    - - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                    - - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-packaging-group'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-packaging-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  HlsPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateHlsVod
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls-packaging-config'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: true
        HlsManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
            RepeatExtXKey: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls-packaging-config'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  DashPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateDashVod
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash-packaging-config'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            Profile: NONE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash-packaging-config'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

Outputs:
  ChannelId:
    Description: MediaPackage Channel ID
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel

  ChannelArn:
    Description: MediaPackage Channel ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageChannel.Arn

  HlsOriginEndpointArn:
    Description: HLS Origin Endpoint ARN
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Arn

  HlsOriginEndpointUrl:
    Description: HLS Origin Endpoint Playback URL
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Url

  DashOriginEndpointArn:
    Description: DASH Origin Endpoint ARN
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Arn

  DashOriginEndpointUrl:
    Description: DASH Origin Endpoint Playback URL
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Url

  VodPackagingGroupId:
    Condition: EnableVod
    Description: MediaPackage VOD Packaging Group ID
    Value: !Ref VodPackagingGroup

  VodPackagingGroupArn:
    Condition: EnableVod
    Description: MediaPackage VOD Packaging Group ARN
    Value: !GetAtt VodPackagingGroup.Arn

  MediaPackageVodRoleArn:
    Condition: EnableVod
    Description: IAM Role ARN for MediaPackage VOD bucket access
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageVodRole.Arn

  HlsPackagingConfigurationId:
    Condition: CreateHlsVod
    Description: MediaPackage VOD HLS Packaging Configuration ID
    Value: !Ref HlsPackagingConfiguration

  DashPackagingConfigurationId:
    Condition: CreateDashVod
    Description: MediaPackage VOD DASH Packaging Configuration ID
    Value: !Ref DashPackagingConfiguration

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) IAM roles, instance profiles, and policies.

Parameters:
  ClusterNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cluster-api-provider-aws
    Description: Prefix to use for naming Cluster API Provider AWS IAM resources.

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # Custom Managed Policies
  # =========================================================================

  ControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-control-plane-policy'
      Description: Managed policy granting permissions for Kubernetes control plane nodes managed by CAPA
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2ControlPlanePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVolumesModifications
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateAppCookieStickinessPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLbCookieStickinessPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeInstanceHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicyTypes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerListenerSSLCertificate
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSControlPlanePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  ControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-controllers-policy'
      Description: Managed policy granting infrastructure management permissions for CAPA controllers
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2VPCInfrastructurePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribePrefixLists
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: LaunchTemplatePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ELBManagementPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingManagementPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EKSAccessEntryPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ServiceLinkedRolesScoped
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: IAMPassRolePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/*${ClusterNamePrefix}*'

  ControllersEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-controllers-eks-policy'
      Description: Managed policy granting EKS cluster lifecycle, SSM, KMS, and IAM permissions for CAPA controllers
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSClusterAndNodegroupManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:ListTagsForResource
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
              - eks:CreateFargateProfile
              - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - eks:CreateAddon
              - eks:DeleteAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddonConfiguration
              - eks:DescribeAddonVersions
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:UpdateAddon
              - eks:AssociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:DisassociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:DescribeIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterRetrieval
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*:*:parameter/aws/service/eks/*'
          - Sid: IAMRoleAndPolicyInspection
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetPolicyVersion
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:GetRolePolicy
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSOperationsScopedByAlias
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                kms:ResourceAliases:
                  - 'alias/cluster-api-provider-aws-*'
          - Sid: EKSServiceLinkedRolesCreation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKS'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSNodegroup'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/eks-fargate.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSForFargate'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-fargate.amazonaws.com

  NodesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-nodes-policy'
      Description: Managed policy granting worker node permissions for CAPA managed clusters
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2NodePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRNodePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SecretsManagerScopedPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Sid: SSMNodePermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeAssociation
              - ssm:GetDeployablePatchSnapshotForInstance
              - ssm:GetDocument
              - ssm:DescribeDocument
              - ssm:GetManifest
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:ListAssociations
              - ssm:ListInstanceAssociations
              - ssm:PutInventory
              - ssm:PutComplianceItems
              - ssm:PutConfigurePackageResult
              - ssm:UpdateAssociationStatus
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceAssociationStatus
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
              - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
              - ec2messages:AcknowledgeMessage
              - ec2messages:DeleteMessage
              - ec2messages:FailMessage
              - ec2messages:GetEndpoint
              - ec2messages:GetMessages
              - ec2messages:SendReply
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: S3NodeBootstrapPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'

  # =========================================================================
  # IAM Roles
  # =========================================================================

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-control-plane-role'
      Description: IAM role for Kubernetes control plane EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControlPlanePolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEKSPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-control-plane-role'

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-controllers-role'
      Description: IAM role for Cluster API Provider AWS controllers (EC2 or EKS Pod Identity)
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEKSPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-controllers-role'

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-nodes-role'
      Description: IAM role for Kubernetes worker nodes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Ref NodesPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-nodes-role'

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-eks-control-plane-role'
      Description: IAM role used by the Amazon EKS service to manage AWS resources for EKS clusters
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-eks-control-plane-role'

  # =========================================================================
  # Instance Profiles
  # =========================================================================

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-control-plane'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-controllers'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ClusterNamePrefix}-nodes'
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Control Plane IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPlaneRoleArn'

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the Control Plane Instance Profile

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready CloudFormation template for an Amazon DynamoDB table with configurable keys, billing mode, point-in-time recovery, optional KMS encryption, and optional CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) The name of the DynamoDB table. If left blank, CloudFormation will generate a unique name.

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'id'
    Description: The name of the partition key (HASH).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid DynamoDB attribute name.

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: 'S'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'S'
      - 'N'
      - 'B'
    Description: The data type for the partition key (S = String, N = Number, B = Binary).

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) The name of the sort key (RANGE). Leave blank if no sort key is needed.

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: 'N'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'S'
      - 'N'
      - 'B'
    Description: The data type for the sort key (S = String, N = Number, B = Binary).

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'PROVISIONED'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'PROVISIONED'
      - 'PAY_PER_REQUEST'
    Description: Billing mode for the table. PROVISIONED or PAY_PER_REQUEST (on-demand).

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Read capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Write capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to enable Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) for continuous backups.

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) ARN or Key ID of a customer-managed KMS key for server-side encryption. If empty, default AWS-managed encryption is used.

  EnableAlerting:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable CloudWatch alarms for DynamoDB throttling and system errors.

  AlertSnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Existing SNS topic ARN for alarm notifications. If left blank and alerting is enabled, a new SNS topic will be created.

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  IsPitrEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
  UseKmsEncryption: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]
  IsAlertingEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlerting, 'true']
  CreateSnsTopic: !And
    - !Condition IsAlertingEnabled
    - !Equals [!Ref AlertSnsTopicArn, '']

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [IsPitrEnabled, true, false]
      SSESpecification: !If
        - UseKmsEncryption
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKeyArn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  DynamoDBAlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateSnsTopic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-alerts'

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsAlertingEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Alarm triggered when DynamoDB table experiences read throttle events.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - CreateSnsTopic
          - !Ref DynamoDBAlertTopic
          - !Ref AlertSnsTopicArn

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsAlertingEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Alarm triggered when DynamoDB table experiences write throttle events.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - CreateSnsTopic
          - !Ref DynamoDBAlertTopic
          - !Ref AlertSnsTopicArn

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsAlertingEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Alarm triggered when DynamoDB table experiences system errors (HTTP 500).
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - CreateSnsTopic
          - !Ref DynamoDBAlertTopic
          - !Ref AlertSnsTopicArn

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TableName'

  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TableArn'

  AlertSnsTopicArn:
    Condition: IsAlertingEnabled
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic used for DynamoDB CloudWatch alarms
    Value: !If
      - CreateSnsTopic
      - !Ref DynamoDBAlertTopic
      - !Ref AlertSnsTopicArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AlertSnsTopicArn'
