AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation Template for EC2 Image Builder Pipelines producing custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for x86_64 and arm64 with Docker, Python libraries, and distribution settings.

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    Description: Semantic version of the EC2 Image Builder recipes and pipelines (e.g., 1.0.0).
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid semantic version (e.g., 1.0.0).

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Root volume size in GiB for the generated AMIs.

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-exampleorgid'
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share the AMIs with (e.g., o-1234567890).
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organization ID starting with 'o-'.

  OrganizationManagementAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) AWS Account ID of the Organization Management account for the Organization ARN. Defaults to current account if left blank.

Conditions:
  UseCurrentAccountForOrg: !Equals [!Ref OrganizationManagementAccountId, '']

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ImageBuilderInstanceRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ImageBuilderInstanceProfile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  SoftwareInstallComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-software-install'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and enables SSM user sudo access.
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallBasePackagesAndDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -xe
                    - dnf update -y
                    - dnf install -y docker python3-pip python3-devel gcc git libffi-devel openssl-devel
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
                    - usermod -aG docker ec2-user || true
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -xe
                    - ARCH=$(uname -m)
                    - DOCKER_CONFIG=/usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
                    - mkdir -p $DOCKER_CONFIG
                    - COMPOSE_VERSION="v2.24.5"
                    - curl -SL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/${COMPOSE_VERSION}/docker-compose-linux-${ARCH}" -o ${DOCKER_CONFIG}/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x ${DOCKER_CONFIG}/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf ${DOCKER_CONFIG}/docker-compose /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -xe
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
                    - python3 -m pip install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: ConfigureSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -xe
                    - echo "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  ValidationTestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-validation-test'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Validates Docker Compose and required Python package imports.
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDockerAndCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -xe
                    - docker --version
                    - docker compose version
                    - docker-compose --version
              - name: VerifyPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -xe
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp; print('All required Python modules imported successfully.')"

  ImageDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution-config'
      Description: Public distribution and organization-level sharing configuration.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub 'custom-al2023-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub 'Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI built by ${AWS::StackName}'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub
                  - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrgMgmtAccount}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
                  - OrgMgmtAccount: !If
                      - UseCurrentAccountForOrg
                      - !Ref AWS::AccountId
                      - !Ref OrganizationManagementAccountId

  SharedInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration for x86_64 and arm64 builds.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
        - t4g.medium
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  Al2023X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI Recipe for x86_64
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ValidationTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  Al2023Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI Recipe for arm64
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ValidationTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86-pipeline'
      Description: Pipeline building custom Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMIs
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref Al2023X86ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SharedInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageDistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Arm64ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64-pipeline'
      Description: Pipeline building custom Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 AMIs
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref Al2023Arm64ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SharedInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageDistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

Outputs:
  X86ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 EC2 Image Builder Pipeline
    Value: !GetAtt X86ImagePipeline.Arn

  Arm64ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 EC2 Image Builder Pipeline
    Value: !GetAtt Arm64ImagePipeline.Arn

  X86ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 Image Recipe
    Value: !Ref Al2023X86ImageRecipe

  Arm64ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 Image Recipe
    Value: !Ref Al2023Arm64ImageRecipe

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the Distribution Configuration
    Value: !Ref ImageDistributionConfiguration

  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the Infrastructure Configuration
    Value: !Ref SharedInfrastructureConfiguration

          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data=None):
              response_data = response_data or {}
              response_body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f"See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  'PhysicalResourceId': event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              })
              logger.info(f"Response body: {response_body}")
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'],
                  data=response_body.encode('utf-8'),
                  headers={'content-type': '', 'content-length': str(len(response_body))},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                      logger.info(f"CloudFormation response status: {resp.status}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed to send response to CloudFormation: {e}")

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']
              demo_password = event['ResourceProperties']['DemoPassword']

              users = [
                  {"email": "alice@demo.local", "role": "member", "group": "team-alpha"},
                  {"bob@demo.local", "role": "member", "group": "team-alpha"},
                  {"charlie@demo.local", "role": "team_admin", "group": "team-alpha"},
                  {"dave@demo.local", "role": "member", "group": "team-beta"},
                  {"eve@demo.local", "role": "team_admin", "group": "team-beta"},
                  {"admin@demo.local", "role": "admin", "group": "admin"}
              ]

              try:
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      for user in users:
                          email = user["email"]
                          role = user["role"]
                          group = user["group"]
                          try:
                              client.admin_create_user(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  UserAttributes=[
                                      {'Name': 'email', 'Value': email},
                                      {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                                      {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role}
                                  ],
                                  MessageAction='SUPPRESS'
                              )
                              logger.info(f"Created user {email}")
                          except client.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                              logger.info(f"User {email} already exists, updating attributes")
                              client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  UserAttributes=[
                                      {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                                      {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role}
                                  ]
                              )

                          client.admin_set_user_password(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              Password=demo_password,
                              Permanent=True
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Set permanent password for {email}")

                          client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              GroupName=group
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Added {email} to group {group}")

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      for user in users:
                          email = user["email"]
                          try:
                              client.admin_delete_user(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email
                              )
                              logger.info(f"Deleted user {email}")
                          except client.exceptions.UserNotFoundException:
                              logger.info(f"User {email} not found during cleanup")
                          except Exception as e:
                              logger.warning(f"Error deleting user {email}: {e}")

                  send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Message': 'User seeding completed'})
              except Exception as ex:
                  logger.error(f"Error handling request: {ex}", exc_info=True)
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(ex)})

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for AWS Client VPN reporting. Creates CloudWatch Logs Insights query definitions and a comprehensive CloudWatch dashboard for AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, and Mixed Auth monitoring.

Parameters:
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'aws/aws-client-vpn/prod'
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Log Group where AWS Client VPN connection logs are published.

  QueryFolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: 'aws-client-vpn'
    Description: Folder path prefix under CloudWatch Logs Insights to organize saved queries.

  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'AWS-Client-VPN-Reporting'
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard to create.

Resources:
  QueryUsagePerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Total-Usage-Per-Endpoint'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `connection-id`, `ingress-bytes`, `egress-bytes`, `connection-duration-s`
        | stats count(`connection-id`) as TotalConnections,
                count_distinct(`username`) as UniqueUsers,
                count_distinct(`common-name`) as UniqueCertificates,
                round(sum(`ingress-bytes`) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2) as IngressGB,
                round(sum(`egress-bytes`) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2) as EgressGB,
                round((sum(`ingress-bytes`) + sum(`egress-bytes`)) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2) as TotalGB,
                round(avg(`connection-duration-s`) / 60, 2) as AvgDurationMinutes,
                round(max(`connection-duration-s`) / 3600, 2) as MaxDurationHours
          by `endpoint-id`
        | sort TotalGB desc

  QueryUsagePerAuthType:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Total-Usage-Per-Auth-Type'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `username`, `common-name`, `ingress-bytes`, `egress-bytes`, `connection-duration-s`,
               if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != "-" and `username` != "" and ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != "-" and `common-name` != "", "Mixed Auth (SAML/AD + Certificate)",
               if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != "-" and `username` != "", "AD / SAML User Auth",
               if(ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != "-" and `common-name` != "", "Mutual Auth (Certificate)", "Unknown Auth"))) as AuthType
        | stats count(*) as TotalEvents,
                count_distinct(coalesce(`username`, `common-name`)) as UniqueIdentities,
                round(sum(`ingress-bytes`) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2) as IngressGB,
                round(sum(`egress-bytes`) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2) as EgressGB,
                round((sum(`ingress-bytes`) + sum(`egress-bytes`)) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2) as TotalDataGB,
                round(avg(`connection-duration-s`) / 60, 2) as AvgDurationMinutes
          by AuthType
        | sort TotalEvents desc

  QueryDistinctUsers:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Distinct-Users-Activity'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp,
               coalesce(`username`, `common-name`, "Unknown") as Identity,
               if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != "-" and `username` != "" and ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != "-" and `common-name` != "", "Mixed Auth",
               if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != "-" and `username` != "", "AD / SAML",
               if(ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != "-" and `common-name` != "", "Mutual Auth", "Unknown"))) as AuthType,
               `endpoint-id`, `client-ip`, `ingress-bytes`, `egress-bytes`, `connection-duration-s`
        | filter Identity != "Unknown" and Identity != "-"
        | stats count(*) as ConnectionCount,
                count_distinct(`client-ip`) as DistinctClientIPs,
                round(sum(`ingress-bytes`) / (1024 * 1024), 2) as IngressMB,
                round(sum(`egress-bytes`) / (1024 * 1024), 2) as EgressMB,
                round((sum(`ingress-bytes`) + sum(`egress-bytes`)) / (1024 * 1024), 2) as TotalMB,
                round(sum(`connection-duration-s`) / 3600, 2) as TotalHoursConnected,
                round(avg(`connection-duration-s`) / 60, 2) as AvgMinutesPerSession,
                latest(@timestamp) as LastSeen
          by Identity, AuthType, `endpoint-id`
        | sort TotalMB desc
        | limit 100

  QueryConnectionDurations:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Connection-Durations-Summary'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `connection-id`,
               coalesce(`username`, `common-name`, "Unknown") as Identity,
               `connection-duration-s`, `connection-status`, `connection-reset-reason`
        | filter ispresent(`connection-duration-s`) and `connection-duration-s` > 0
        | stats count(`connection-id`) as CompletedConnections,
                min(`connection-duration-s`) as MinDurationSec,
                round(avg(`connection-duration-s`) / 60, 2) as AvgDurationMin,
                round(percentile(`connection-duration-s`, 50) / 60, 2) as MedianDurationMin,
                round(percentile(`connection-duration-s`, 95) / 60, 2) as P95DurationMin,
                round(max(`connection-duration-s`) / 3600, 2) as MaxDurationHours
          by `endpoint-id`, Identity
        | sort CompletedConnections desc
        | limit 100

  QueryConnectionFailures:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Connection-Failures-And-Resets'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `connection-id`,
               coalesce(`username`, `common-name`, "Unknown") as Identity,
               `client-ip`, `connection-status`, `connection-reset-reason`
        | filter `connection-status` != "authenticated" and `connection-status` != "active"
        | stats count(*) as FailureCount by `endpoint-id`, Identity, `connection-status`, `connection-reset-reason`

              "properties": {
                "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, `endpoint-id`, `username`, `common-name`, `ingress-bytes`, `egress-bytes`, `connection-duration-s`, if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != \"-\" and `username` != \"\" and ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != \"-\" and `common-name` != \"\", \"Mixed Auth (SAML/AD + Certificate)\", if(ispresent(`username`) and `username` != \"-\" and `username` != \"\", \"AD / SAML User Auth\", if(ispresent(`common-name`) and `common-name` != \"-\" and `common-name` != \"\", \"Mutual Auth (Certificate)\", \"Unknown Auth\"))) as AuthType | stats count(*) as TotalEvents, count_distinct(coalesce(`username`, `common-name`)) as UniqueIdentities, round(sum(`ingress-bytes`) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2) as IngressGB, round(sum(`egress-bytes`) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2) as EgressGB, round((sum(`ingress-bytes`) + sum(`egress-bytes`)) / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2) as TotalDataGB, round(avg(`connection-duration-s`) / 60, 2) as AvgDurationMinutes by AuthType | sort TotalEvents desc",

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication system using Amazon Cognito.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment name.
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: System and platform administrators
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 0

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      Description: Hotel property general managers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      Description: Multi-property regional oversight managers
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 2

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      Description: Revenue and pricing management staff
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 3

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      Description: Front desk and guest reception staff
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 4

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      Description: Housekeeping and facilities staff
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 5

  SpaAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  AdminAuthClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-auth-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  HotelResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub https://api.anycompanyhotel.com/${Environment}
      Name: !Sub AnyCompany Hotel API (${Environment})
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel resources
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel resources
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Admin access to AnyCompany Hotel resources

  M2MOAuth2Client:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - HotelResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub https://api.anycompanyhotel.com/${Environment}/read
        - !Sub https://api.anycompanyhotel.com/${Environment}/write
        - !Sub https://api.anycompanyhotel.com/${Environment}/admin
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn

  UserPoolDomainUrl:
    Description: The fully-qualified domain URL for OAuth2 endpoints
    Value: !Sub https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainUrl

  UserPoolDomainName:
    Description: The Cognito User Pool custom prefix domain name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for Hospitality Insights Cognito User Pool in production with post-authentication trigger, user groups, and optional SSO integration.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
      - staging
      - dev
    Description: Deployment environment name.

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Custom domain prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI. Leave empty to skip domain creation.

  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the federated SSO identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO integration.

  SsoMetadataUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Metadata URL or login endpoint for the federated SSO identity provider. Required if SSO provider name is specified.

  CallbackUrls:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'https://localhost:3000/callback'
    Description: Comma-separated list of allowed redirect (callback) URLs for the User Pool Client.

  LogoutUrls:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'https://localhost:3000/logout'
    Description: Comma-separated list of allowed sign-out URLs for the User Pool Client.

Conditions:
  HasDomainPrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainPrefix, '']]
  HasSsoProvider: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoMetadataUrl, '']]

Resources:
  PostAuthenticationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-post-auth-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UpdateCognitoUserAttributesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-post-auth'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Description: Updates the custom:last_login attribute upon successful user authentication.
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import datetime
          import boto3

          cognito_client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event.get('userPoolId')
              user_name = event.get('userName')
              now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

              if user_pool_id and user_name:
                  try:
                      cognito_client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=user_name,
                          UserAttributes=[
                              {
                                  'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                                  'Value': now
                              }
                          ]
                      )
                  except Exception as e:
                      print(f"Error updating last_login for user {user_name}: {str(e)}")
                      raise e

              return event

  PostAuthenticationLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt HospitalityInsightsUserPool.Arn

  HospitalityInsightsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-user-pool'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7

  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Administrators group with highest precedence
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: Regular users group with default privileges
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: Power users group with elevated application privileges
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  UserPoolIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: HasSsoProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref SsoMetadataUrl
      AttributeMapping:
        email: 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress'

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Condition: HasDomainPrefix
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  HospitalityInsightsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackUrls
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutUrls
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        !If
          - HasSsoProvider
          - - !Ref SsoProviderName
            - COGNITO
          - - COGNITO

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Hospitality Insights Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt HospitalityInsightsUserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'

  HostedUIDomain:
    Condition: HasDomainPrefix
    Description: Hosted UI Login Domain URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HostedUIDomain'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a WebSocket API managing client connections and session state using DynamoDB with TTL and Lambda for message echoing.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: The name of the WebSocket API stage.
  SessionTtlSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    Description: Time-to-live in seconds for client sessions in DynamoDB (default is 24 hours).

Resources:
  # DynamoDB Table for Session Management
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  # IAM Role for API Gateway to interact with DynamoDB
  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBSessionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  # IAM Role for Lambda Echo Function
  EchoLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageWebSocketConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*'

  # Lambda Function for Echoing Messages ($default route)
  EchoLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EchoFunction'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt EchoLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              request_context = event.get('requestContext', {})
              connection_id = request_context.get('connectionId')
              domain_name = request_context.get('domainName')
              stage = request_context.get('stage')

              if not connection_id or not domain_name or not stage:
                  logger.error("Missing connection context parameters")
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Bad Request'}

              endpoint_url = f"https://{domain_name}/{stage}"
              client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=endpoint_url)

              body = event.get('body', '')
              payload = body.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(body, str) else json.dumps(body).encode('utf-8')

              try:
                  client.post_to_connection(ConnectionId=connection_id, Data=payload)
                  logger.info("Echoed message to connection %s", connection_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error("Failed to post message to connection %s: %s", connection_id, str(e))
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': 'Failed to echo message'}

              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Echo successful'}

  # Permission for API Gateway to invoke the Lambda Function
  EchoLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref EchoLambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$default'

  # WebSocket API
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSocketApi'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  # $connect Route and Integration (Direct DynamoDB PutItem)
  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub |
          #set($ttl = $context.requestTimeEpoch / 1000 + ${SessionTtlSeconds})
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Item": {
              "connectionId": {
                "S": "$context.connectionId"
              },
              "connectedAt": {
                "N": "$context.requestTimeEpoch"
              },
              "ttl": {
                "N": "$ttl"
              }
            }
          }

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RouteResponseSelectionExpression: $default
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  ConnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref ConnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: /200/

  ConnectRouteResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::RouteResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteId: !Ref ConnectRoute
      RouteResponseKey: $default

  # $disconnect Route and Integration (Direct DynamoDB DeleteItem)
  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/DeleteItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub |
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Key": {
              "connectionId": {
                "S": "$context.connectionId"
              }
            }
          }

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref DisconnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: /200/

  # $default Route and Integration (Lambda Proxy Echo)
  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${EchoLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultIntegration}'

  # API Deployment
  WebSocketDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - ConnectRouteResponse
      - ConnectIntegrationResponse
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DisconnectIntegrationResponse
      - DefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  # API Stage
  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebSocketDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true

Outputs:
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: The ID of the WebSocket API.
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi
  WebSocketEndpointUri:
    Description: The WebSocket connection URL.
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
  SessionTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table tracking active WebSocket sessions.
    Value: !Ref SessionTable
  SessionTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table tracking active WebSocket sessions.
    Value: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn
  EchoLambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function handling $default echo route.
    Value: !GetAtt EchoLambdaFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a basic VPC with a single public subnet, Internet Gateway, custom route table, and Network ACL for TCP and UDP traffic.

Parameters:
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Description: Select the CIDR block for the VPC.
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    AllowedValues:
      - 172.18.0.0/16
      - 172.19.0.0/16
      - 172.20.0.0/16
      - 172.21.0.0/16
      - 172.22.0.0/16
      - 172.23.0.0/16

Mappings:
  SubnetCidrMapping:
    172.18.0.0/16:
      SubnetCidr: 172.18.0.0/22
    172.19.0.0/16:
      SubnetCidr: 172.19.0.0/22
    172.20.0.0/16:
      SubnetCidr: 172.20.0.0/22
    172.21.0.0/16:
      SubnetCidr: 172.21.0.0/22
    172.22.0.0/16:
      SubnetCidr: 172.22.0.0/22
    172.23.0.0/16:
      SubnetCidr: 172.23.0.0/22

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetCidrMapping, !Ref VpcCidrBlock, SubnetCidr]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-public-rt

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-public-nacl

  InboundNetworkAclEntryTCP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  InboundNetworkAclEntryUDP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  OutboundNetworkAclEntryTCP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  OutboundNetworkAclEntryUDP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: Public Subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: Internet Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: Public Route Table ID
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  NetworkAclId:
    Description: Network ACL ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetNetworkAcl

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) experiment template for cross-region chaos testing across Transit Gateways, Subnets, S3 Buckets, and DynamoDB Global Tables.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: The target AWS region to which cross-region traffic and replication are disrupted.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]{1}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region identifier (e.g., us-west-2).
    Default: us-west-2

  ExperimentDurationMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Description: Duration of the chaos experiment actions in minutes.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1440
    Default: 20

  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Description: Tag key identifying resources eligible for chaos experiments.
    Default: ChaosAllowed

  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Description: Tag value identifying resources eligible for chaos experiments.
    Default: 'true'

Resources:
  FISKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting FIS experiment CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: fis-logging-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/chaos-testing-*'

  FISKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/fis-experiment-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FISKmsKey

  FISLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/chaos-testing-${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FISKmsKey.Arn

  FISRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'FIS-CrossRegion-Chaos-Role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM Execution role for AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS)
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FISNetworkDisruptionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: NetworkDisruptionPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:ModifyTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
                  - ec2:DisruptSubnetConnectivity
                  - ec2:DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity
                  - ec2:DisruptConnectivity
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: FISS3ReplicationPausePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ReplicationControl
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PauseReplication
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: FISDynamoDBReplicationPausePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBReplicationControl
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:PauseReplication
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: FISCloudWatchLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  FISExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Cross-region chaos experiment: disrupt network connectivity to ${TargetRegion} and pause S3/DynamoDB replication'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FISRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !Sub '${FISLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Targets:
        SubnetTargets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref TagValue
          SelectionMode: ALL
        TransitGatewayTargets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref TagValue
          SelectionMode: ALL
        S3BucketTargets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref TagValue
          SelectionMode: ALL
        DynamoDBGlobalTableTargets:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref TagValue
          SelectionMode: ALL
      Actions:
        DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: Disrupt network connectivity across transit gateways
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${ExperimentDurationMinutes}M'
            scope: all
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: TransitGatewayTargets
        DisruptSubnetConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: Disrupt outbound network connectivity across subnets
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${ExperimentDurationMinutes}M'
            scope: all
          Targets:
            Subnets: SubnetTargets
        PauseS3BucketReplication:
          ActionId: aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication
          Description: Pause cross-region replication for tagged S3 buckets
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${ExperimentDurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            Buckets: S3BucketTargets
        PauseDynamoDBGlobalTableReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: Pause replication for tagged DynamoDB global tables
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${ExperimentDurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            GlobalTables: DynamoDBGlobalTableTargets
      Tags:
        Name: CrossRegionChaosExperiment
        TargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
        ChaosAllowed: !Ref TagValue

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: The ID of the FIS Experiment Template
    Value: !Ref FISExperimentTemplate

  FISRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM Execution Role for FIS
    Value: !GetAtt FISRole.Arn

  LogGroupArn:
    Description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Log Group used for FIS logging
    Value: !GetAtt FISLogGroup.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the dedicated KMS Key encrypting FIS logs
    Value: !GetAtt FISKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a VPC network foundation for Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS with VPC Flow Logs, KMS encryption, and multi-AZ NAT Gateways.

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/26
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/26)$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /26 CIDR block.

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.64/26
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/26)$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /26 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.128/26
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/26)$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /26 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/26)$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /26 CIDR block.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Key to encrypt VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-logs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}*'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role for VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: VPC CIDR Block
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  PublicSubnets:
    Description: Public Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]

  PrivateSubnets:
    Description: Private Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  FlowLogsLogGroupArn:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group ARN for VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN used for Flow Logs encryption
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

Resources:

    Properties:
      RoleName: sample-imagebuilder-instance-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  InstanceProfile:

  LifecycleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: sample-imagebuilder-lifecycle-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  CustomComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Install and run Chef Client on Linux using WebDownload
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefInstallScript
                action: WebDownload
                inputs:
                  - source: https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh
                    destination: /tmp/install-chef.sh
              - name: InstallChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chmod +x /tmp/install-chef.sh
                    - /tmp/install-chef.sh

              - name: RunChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chef-client --version

      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Update SSM agent and build an AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        steps:
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: ExecuteBash
            inputs:
              commands:
                - yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent || yum install -y https://s3.amazonaws.com/ec2-downloads-windows/SSMAgent/latest/linux_amd64/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm
                - systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent
          - name: BuildAMI

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for Cognito-based authentication layer for Lex Web UI, supporting Lex V1/V2, authenticated and unauthenticated roles, and optional live chat API.

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'identity pool'
    Description: Name for the Cognito Identity Pool.
  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'OrderFlowers'
    Description: Name of the Amazon Lex V1 Bot (used if Lex V2 Bot ID is not provided).
  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) ID of the Amazon Lex V2 Bot. When specified, Lex V2 is used instead of Lex V1.
  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Alias ID of the Amazon Lex V2 Bot.
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: If true, denies unauthenticated users access to Lex and Live Chat APIs.
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: If true, allows calling the live chat API Gateway endpoint.

Conditions:
  HasLexV2BotId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, '']]
  HasLexV2BotAliasId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotAliasId, '']]
  UseLexV2: !Condition HasLexV2BotId
  UseLexV1: !And
    - !Not [!Condition HasLexV2BotId]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV1BotName, '']]
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, 'true']
  AllowUnauth: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'false']
  AllowUnauthAndLexV1: !And
    - !Condition AllowUnauth
    - !Condition UseLexV1
  AllowUnauthAndLexV2: !And
    - !Condition AllowUnauth
    - !Condition UseLexV2
  AllowUnauthAndLiveChat: !And
    - !Condition AllowUnauth
    - !Condition EnableLiveChat

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClient'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH

  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderName

  CognitoAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoAuthRole'
      Description: IAM role for authenticated Cognito identity pool users
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoUnauthRole'
      Description: IAM role for unauthenticated Cognito identity pool users
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt CognitoAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

  AuthPollyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AuthPollyPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - polly:SynthesizeSpeech
            Resource: '*'

  AuthLexV1Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseLexV1
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AuthLexV1Policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:PostContent
              - lex:PostText
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*'

  AuthLexV2Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: UseLexV2
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AuthLexV2Policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:RecognizeText
              - lex:RecognizeUtterance
              - lex:StartConversation
              - lex:DeleteSession
            Resource: !If
              - HasLexV2BotAliasId
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/*'

  AuthLiveChatPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: EnableLiveChat
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AuthLiveChatPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoAuthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/*/*'

  UnauthLexV1Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: AllowUnauthAndLexV1
    Properties:
      PolicyName: UnauthLexV1Policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:PostContent
              - lex:PostText
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}:*'

  UnauthLexV2Policy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: AllowUnauthAndLexV2
    Properties:
      PolicyName: UnauthLexV2Policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lex:RecognizeText
              - lex:RecognizeUtterance
              - lex:StartConversation
              - lex:DeleteSession
            Resource: !If
              - HasLexV2BotAliasId
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/*'

  UnauthLiveChatPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: AllowUnauthAndLiveChat
    Properties:
      PolicyName: UnauthLiveChatPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CognitoUnauthRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - execute-api:Invoke
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/*/*'

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito Identity Pool
    Value: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId'
