AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Complete authentication infrastructure for customer support system using Amazon Cognito, Lambda triggers, and SSM parameters.

Parameters:
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Unique prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain name.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9](-?[a-z0-9])*$
    ConstraintDescription: Domain prefix must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and cannot start or end with a hyphen.
  
  WebAppCallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Comma-separated list of allowed callback URLs for the web client application.
    Default: 'https://localhost:3000/callback,https://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/cognito'

  WebAppLogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Comma-separated list of allowed logout URLs for the web client application.
    Default: 'https://localhost:3000/logout,https://localhost:3000'

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Lambda Post-Confirmation Trigger
  PostConfirmationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoPostConfirmationRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToGroupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  # Lambda Function to automatically add new sign-ups to the customer group
  PostConfirmationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AutoAddCustomerGroup'
      Description: Adds newly confirmed users to the customer group automatically.
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", event)
              trigger_source = event.get('triggerSource', '')
              if trigger_source in ['PostConfirmation_ConfirmSignUp', 'PostConfirmation_ConfirmForgotPassword']:
                  user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
                  user_name = event['userName']
                  try:
                      client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=user_name,
                          GroupName='customer'
                      )
                      logger.info(f"User {user_name} successfully added to group customer")
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.error(f"Error adding user {user_name} to group customer: {str(e)}")
                      raise e
              return event

  # Lambda Permission to allow Cognito invocation
  PostConfirmationLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambda.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  # Cognito User Pool
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DependsOn:
      - PostConfirmationLambdaPermission
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CustomerSupportUserPool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambda.Arn

  # User Pool Group: admin (higher precedence: 1)
  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Administrator group with elevated privileges
      Precedence: 1

  # User Pool Group: customer (lower precedence: 2)
  CustomerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Customer group for standard support users
      Precedence: 2

  # Cognito Domain for Hosted UI
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref CognitoDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Resource Server defining custom read scope
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: customersupport-api
      Name: CustomerSupportResourceServer
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer support resources

  # Web Application Client using Authorization Code Grant flow
  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebAppClient'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - customersupport-api/read
      CallbackURLs: !Ref WebAppCallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref WebAppLogoutURLs
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # Machine-to-Machine Client using Client Credentials grant flow
  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-M2MClient'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - customersupport-api/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # SSM Parameter: User Pool ID
  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID for Customer Support

  # SSM Parameter: Web App Client ID
  SSMWebAppClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Cognito Web Application Client ID

  # SSM Parameter: M2M Client ID
  SSMM2MClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/m2m_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MClient
      Description: Cognito Machine-to-Machine Client ID

  # SSM Parameter: Custom OAuth Scope
  SSMOAuthScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/oauth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: customersupport-api/read
      Description: Custom OAuth Read Scope for Customer Support API

  # SSM Parameter: Discovery URL
  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OpenID Connect Discovery URL

  # SSM Parameter: Token Endpoint
  SSMTokenEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/token_endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Description: Cognito OAuth2 Token Endpoint

  # SSM Parameter: Authorize Endpoint
  SSMAuthorizeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/authorize_endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Description: Cognito OAuth2 Authorize Endpoint

  # SSM Parameter: Hosted UI Domain
  SSMDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Description: Cognito Hosted UI Domain URL

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  WebAppClientId:
    Description: The ID of the Web Application Client
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient

  M2MClientId:
    Description: The ID of the Machine-to-Machine Client
    Value: !Ref M2MClient

  CustomOAuthScope:
    Description: The custom OAuth read scope
    Value: customersupport-api/read

  CognitoHostedUIDomain:
    Description: The full Cognito hosted UI domain URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: The OAuth2 Token Endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  AuthorizeEndpoint:
    Description: The OAuth2 Authorize Endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: The OpenID Connect Discovery URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template to deploy a high-availability VPC across two Availability Zones with public and private subnets, an Internet Gateway, and dual NAT Gateways.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Default: 10.10.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in AZ 1
    Default: 10.10.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in AZ 2
    Default: 10.10.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in AZ 1
    Default: 10.10.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in AZ 2
    Default: 10.10.11.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NAT1-EIP

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NAT2-EIP

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NATGateway1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NATGateway2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcCidr:
    Description: The CIDR block of the VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: The list of Availability Zones used
    Value: !Join
      - ', '
      - - !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
        - !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Public Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Public Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of Public Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Private Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Subnet ID of Private Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of Private Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production Route 53 Hosted Zone and DNS configuration for prxu.org, Google Workspace, CDN aliases, and service routing.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: prxu.org.
    Description: The domain name for the hosted zone with trailing period.
  GoogleSiteVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=placeholder_token
    Description: Google Workspace domain verification TXT value.
  DovetailCdnCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for dovetail-cdn.
  DovetailCdnStagingCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d222222abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for dovetail-cdn-staging.
  FeederCdnCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d333333abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for f (Feeder CDN production).
  FeederCdnStagingCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d444444abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for f-staging (Feeder CDN staging).
  FeederCdnDevCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d555555abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for f.development (Feeder CDN dev).
  AdFilesCdnCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d666666abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for a (Ad files CDN).
  RyanCdnCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d777777abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for ryan-cdn (Sandbox CDN).
  AuthFeedProxyProdTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: auth-proxy-prod.internal.prxu.org
    Description: CNAME target for authenticated feed proxy production subdomain.
  AuthFeedProxyStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: auth-proxy-staging.internal.prxu.org
    Description: CNAME target for authenticated feed proxy staging subdomain.
  DovetailRouterProdTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: router-prod.internal.prxu.org
    Description: CNAME target for Dovetail router production.
  DovetailRouterStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: router-staging.internal.prxu.org
    Description: CNAME target for Dovetail router staging.

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Production public hosted zone for prxu.org

  ApexGoogleMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'

  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerification}"'
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"'

  DovetailCdnARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref DovetailCdnCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DovetailCdnAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref DovetailCdnCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DovetailCdnStagingARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref DovetailCdnStagingCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  DovetailCdnStagingAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref DovetailCdnStagingCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnProdARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'f.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnProdAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'f.${DomainName}'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnStagingARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'f-staging.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnStagingCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnStagingAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'f-staging.${DomainName}'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnStagingCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnDevARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'f.development.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnDevCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  FeederCdnDevAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'f.development.${DomainName}'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnDevCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  AdFilesCdnARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'a.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref AdFilesCdnCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  AdFilesCdnAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'a.${DomainName}'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref AdFilesCdnCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  RyanCdnARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'ryan-cdn.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref RyanCdnCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  RyanCdnAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'ryan-cdn.${DomainName}'
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref RyanCdnCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  LegacyDovetailCdnCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cdn.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub 'dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}'

  LegacyDovetailCdnStagingCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cdn-staging.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub 'dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}'

  AuthFeedProxyProdCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'auth-proxy.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AuthFeedProxyProdTarget

  AuthFeedProxyStagingCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'auth-proxy-staging.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AuthFeedProxyStagingTarget

  DovetailRouterProdCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'dovetail-router.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '30'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DovetailRouterProdTarget

  DovetailRouterStagingCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'dovetail-router-staging.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '30'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DovetailRouterStagingTarget

  AcmValidationDovetailCdnRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_acm-dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_acm-validation.placeholder.acm-validations.aws.'

  AcmValidationDovetailCdnStagingRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_acm-dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_acm-validation.placeholder.acm-validations.aws.'

  AcmValidationFeederCdnRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_acm-f.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_acm-validation.placeholder.acm-validations.aws.'

  AcmValidationFeederCdnStagingRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_acm-f-staging.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_acm-validation.placeholder.acm-validations.aws.'

  AcmValidationFeederCdnDevRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_acm-f-development.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_acm-validation.placeholder.acm-validations.aws.'

  AcmValidationAdFilesCdnRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_acm-a.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_acm-validation.placeholder.acm-validations.aws.'

  AcmValidationRyanCdnRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_acm-ryan-cdn.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_acm-validation.placeholder.acm-validations.aws.'

  AcmValidationRouterRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_acm-router.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '_acm-validation.placeholder.acm-validations.aws.'

    Description: The ID of the created Route 53 Hosted Zone.
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
  HostedZoneNameServers:
    Description: Name servers for the created Route 53 Hosted Zone.
    Value: !Join [',', !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers]

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a simple learning VPC setup with optional networking components.

Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix used for naming resources.
    Default: SimpleApp1

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet.
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  SourceIpRange:
    Type: String
    Description: IP address range allowed to access HTTP and HTTPS in the security group.
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$

  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    Description: Controls whether to create and attach an Internet Gateway.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    Description: Controls whether to create a public subnet.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    Description: Controls whether to create a custom route table.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    Description: Controls whether to create a security group.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

Conditions:
  EnableInternetGateway: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, 'true']
  EnablePublicSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, 'true']
  EnableRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, 'true']
  EnableSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, 'true']
  EnablePublicRoute: !And
    - !Condition EnableInternetGateway
    - !Condition EnableRouteTable
  EnableSubnetRouteTableAssociation: !And
    - !Condition EnablePublicSubnet
    - !Condition EnableRouteTable

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamingPrefix}-VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: EnableInternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamingPrefix}-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: EnableInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: EnablePublicSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamingPrefix}-Public-Subnet

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: EnableRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamingPrefix}-Public-RT

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: EnablePublicRoute
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: EnableSubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: EnableSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub Security group for ${NamingPrefix} allowing HTTP and HTTPS access
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIpRange
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIpRange
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamingPrefix}-SG

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a Landing Zone Hub VPC with Transit Gateway, NAT Gateways, VPC Endpoints, and Flow Logs for multi-account spoke connectivity.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Prefix applied to resource names and export values.

  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the landing zone Hub VPC.

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in AZ 1.

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in AZ 2.

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in AZ 1.

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in AZ 2.

  SpokeNetworkCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(8|[9]|1[0-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block encompassing spoke VPC networks routed via Transit Gateway.

  TransitGatewayAmazonSideAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    Description: Private Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Transit Gateway.

  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: Retention period in days for VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAmazonSideAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Description: Hub Transit Gateway for multi-account spoke attachment
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tgw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tgw-hub-attachment
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1SpokeRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref SpokeNetworkCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnet2SpokeRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref SpokeNetworkCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-group
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-hub-flow-log
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group controlling access to VPC Interface Endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from Hub VPC CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SpokeNetworkCIDR
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from Spoke networks
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoints-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ec2messages-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ssmmessages-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-logs-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: Hub VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-VpcId

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: Hub VPC CIDR Block
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-VpcCidr

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1Id

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2Id

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1Id

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2Id

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready Bedrock AgentCore Student Services infrastructure with domain-specific IAM execution roles and Cognito OAuth2 client credentials authentication.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
      - test
    Description: Environment name for deployment tracking and resource tagging.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # Shared IAM Base Policy
  # ============================================================================
  StudentServicesBaseManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub student-services-base-policy-${AWS::Region}
      Description: Base permissions for Bedrock AgentCore student services microservices
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:custom-model/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:provisioned-model/*
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*

  # ============================================================================
  # 1. StudentServicesAgent (Orchestrator - IAM only, no Cognito)
  # ============================================================================
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub student-services-agent-orchestrator-${AWS::Region}
      Description: Execution role for the main Student Services Agent orchestrator
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseManagedPolicy

  # ============================================================================
  # 2. StudentServicesGateway (Cognito only, no execution role)
  # ============================================================================
  GatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub student-services-gateway-pool-${Environment}
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  GatewayUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool
      Domain: !Sub ss-gw-${AWS::AccountId}

  GatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool
      Identifier: https://gateway.studentservices.edu
      Name: StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Scope granting access to the Student Services API Gateway

  GatewayUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GatewayResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: student-services-gateway-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - https://gateway.studentservices.edu/access

  # ============================================================================
  # 3. CourseRegistration Domain
  # ============================================================================
  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub student-services-course-reg-${AWS::Region}
      Description: Execution role for Course Registration agent with DynamoDB full access
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseManagedPolicy
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess

  CourseRegistrationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub student-services-course-reg-pool-${Environment}
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      Domain: !Sub ss-coursereg-${AWS::AccountId}

  CourseRegistrationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      Identifier: https://coursereg.studentservices.edu
      Name: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access scope for Course Registration microservice

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: course-registration-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - https://coursereg.studentservices.edu/access

  # ============================================================================
  # 4. CourseCatalog Domain
  # ============================================================================
  CourseCatalogExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub student-services-course-catalog-${AWS::Region}
      Description: Execution role for Course Catalog agent with Bedrock Knowledge Base access
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseManagedPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockKnowledgeBaseRetrieveAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockKnowledgeBaseRetrieve
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:Retrieve
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:knowledge-base/*

  CourseCatalogUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub student-services-course-catalog-pool-${Environment}
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CourseCatalogUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      Domain: !Sub ss-catalog-${AWS::AccountId}

  CourseCatalogResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      Identifier: https://catalog.studentservices.edu
      Name: CourseCatalogResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access scope for Course Catalog microservice

  CourseCatalogUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseCatalogResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: course-catalog-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - https://catalog.studentservices.edu/access

  # ============================================================================
  # 5. CourseReview Domain
  # ============================================================================
  CourseReviewExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub student-services-course-review-${AWS::Region}
      Description: Execution role for Course Review agent with DynamoDB read-only access
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseManagedPolicy
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess

  CourseReviewUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub student-services-course-review-pool-${Environment}
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CourseReviewUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
      Domain: !Sub ss-review-${AWS::AccountId}

  CourseReviewResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
      Identifier: https://review.studentservices.edu
      Name: CourseReviewResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access scope for Course Review microservice

  CourseReviewUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseReviewResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: course-review-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - https://review.studentservices.edu/access

  # ============================================================================
  # 6. LoanApplication Domain
  # ============================================================================
  LoanApplicationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub student-services-loan-app-${AWS::Region}
      Description: Execution role for Loan Application agent with SageMaker invoke access
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseManagedPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerEndpointInvokeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerInvokeEndpoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpointAsync
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*

  LoanApplicationUserPool:

      UserPoolName: !Sub student-services-loan-app-pool-${Environment}

          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:

          AttributeDataType: String

  LoanApplicationUserPoolDomain:

    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool
      Domain: !Sub ss-loan-${AWS::AccountId}

  LoanApplicationResourceServer:

  LoanApplicationUserPoolClient:

    DependsOn: LoanApplicationResourceServer

      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - https://loan.studentservices.edu/access

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 Log-Based Monitoring Controls with CloudWatch Logs, KMS, SNS Alarms, and Query Definitions.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/cloudtrail/cis-benchmark-events
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group to receive CloudTrail management events.
  RetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    AllowedValues: [30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: Log retention period in days for the CloudWatch Log Group.
  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: CISBenchmark
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for the CIS benchmark metric filters.

Resources:
  CISKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Customer Managed Key for CIS Benchmark SNS Topic and CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: cis-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsAndAlarms
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - logs.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cis-benchmark-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CISKmsKey

  CISLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup

  # 1. Unauthorized API Calls
  UnauthorizedApiCallMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:

  UnauthorizedApiCallAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

      AlarmName: CIS-Unauthorized-API-Calls
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when unauthorized API calls are attempted.
      MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCallCount
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISSnsTopic

  UnauthorizedApiCallQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition

      Name: CIS-Unauthorized-API-Calls-Query
      LogGroupNames:

      QueryString: |

    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

      MetricName: ConsoleSigninWithoutMfaCount
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISSnsTopic

  ConsoleSigninWithoutMfaQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-Console-Sign-In-Without-MFA-Query
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISLogGroup
      QueryString: |

  RootAccountUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-Root-Account-Usage
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when the root account is used.
      MetricName: RootAccountUsageCount
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISSnsTopic

  RootAccountUsageQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-Root-Account-Usage-Query
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventSource, eventName, sourceIPAddress, userAgent
        | filter userIdentity.type = "Root" and isempty(userIdentity.invokedBy) and eventType != "AwsServiceEvent"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 100

  # 4. IAM Policy Changes
  IamPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{($.eventName=DeleteGroupPolicy)||($.eventName=DeleteRolePolicy)||($.eventName=DeleteUserPolicy)||($.eventName=PutGroupPolicy)||($.eventName=PutRolePolicy)||($.eventName=PutUserPolicy)||($.eventName=CreatePolicy)||($.eventName=DeletePolicy)||($.eventName=CreatePolicyVersion)||($.eventName=DeletePolicyVersion)||($.eventName=AttachRolePolicy)||($.eventName=DetachRolePolicy)||($.eventName=AttachUserPolicy)||($.eventName=DetachUserPolicy)||($.eventName=AttachGroupPolicy)||($.eventName=DetachGroupPolicy)}'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace

      MetricName: IamPolicyChangeCount
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300

      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISLogGroup
