AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automated deployment and configuration of AWS Security Hub across an AWS Control Tower organization.

Parameters:
  AuditAccountIdParameter:
    Type: String
    Default: /superwerker/audit_account_id
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path containing the AWS Control Tower Audit Account ID.
  LogArchiveAccountIdParameter:
    Type: String
    Default: /superwerker/log_archive_account_id
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path containing the AWS Control Tower Log Archive Account ID.
  ControlTowerExecutionRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: AWSControlTowerExecution
    Description: The name of the cross-account execution role provisioned by AWS Control Tower.

Resources:
  SecurityHubAutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role for SSM Automation to configure Security Hub across accounts
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAutomationSecurityHubPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/${ControlTowerExecutionRoleName}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                  - organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
                  - securityhub:DisableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:DescribeOrganizationConfiguration
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:DescribeHub
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/ssm/*

  EventBridgeToSSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: IAM role allowing EventBridge to start SSM Automation executions
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAutomationExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${LandingZoneSetupDocument}:$DEFAULT
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${AccountProvisionedDocument}:$DEFAULT

  LandingZoneSetupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: Superwerker-SecurityHub-LandingZoneSetup
      Content:
        description: Configure Security Hub delegated administration and organization-wide baseline.
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AuditAccountIdParam:
            type: String
            default: !Ref AuditAccountIdParameter
            description: Parameter store path for Audit Account ID
          LogArchiveAccountIdParam:
            type: String
            default: !Ref LogArchiveAccountIdParameter
            description: Parameter store path for Log Archive Account ID
          ExecutionRoleName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref ControlTowerExecutionRoleName
            description: Control Tower execution role name
        mainSteps:
          - name: SetupSecurityHubBaseline
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountIdParam: '{{AuditAccountIdParam}}'
                LogArchiveAccountIdParam: '{{LogArchiveAccountIdParam}}'
                ExecutionRoleName: '{{ExecutionRoleName}}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import os
                import time

                def get_parameter(ssm, name):
                    resp = ssm.get_parameter(Name=name)
                    return resp['Parameter']['Value']

                def assume_role(account_id, role_name, session_name):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    role_arn = f"arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/{role_name}"
                    assumed = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=role_arn,
                        RoleSessionName=session_name
                    )
                    credentials = assumed['Credentials']
                    return boto3.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=credentials['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=credentials['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=credentials['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1')
                    )

                def enable_hub_in_session(session):
                    sh = session.client('securityhub')
                    try:
                        sh.describe_hub()
                    except sh.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                        sh.enable_security_hub(
                            EnableDefaultStandards=True,
                            ControlFindingGenerator='SECURITY_CONTROL'
                        )

                def handler(events, context):
                    region = os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1')
                    ssm = boto3.client('ssm', region_name=region)
                    sh_management = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region)

                    audit_account_id = get_parameter(ssm, events['AuditAccountIdParam'])
                    log_archive_account_id = get_parameter(ssm, events['LogArchiveAccountIdParam'])
                    exec_role = events['ExecutionRoleName']

                    # 1. Enable Security Hub in Management Account
                    try:
                        sh_management.describe_hub()
                    except sh_management.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                        sh_management.enable_security_hub(
                            EnableDefaultStandards=True,
                            ControlFindingGenerator='SECURITY_CONTROL'
                        )

                    # 2. Register Audit Account as Delegated Admin
                    admin_accounts = sh_management.list_organization_admin_accounts()
                    already_delegated = any(
                        admin['AccountId'] == audit_account_id and admin['Status'] == 'ENABLED'
                        for admin in admin_accounts.get('AdminAccounts', [])
                    )

                    if not already_delegated:
                        sh_management.enable_organization_admin_account(
                            AdminAccountId=audit_account_id
                        )
                        time.sleep(10)

                    # 3. Assume role in Audit Account & enable Security Hub + auto-enable org members
                    audit_session = assume_role(audit_account_id, exec_role, 'SecurityHubAuditSetup')
                    enable_hub_in_session(audit_session)
                    sh_audit = audit_session.client('securityhub')

                    sh_audit.update_organization_configuration(
                        AutoEnable=True,
                        AutoEnableStandards='DEFAULT'
                    )

                    # 4. Assume role in Log Archive Account & enable Security Hub
                    log_session = assume_role(log_archive_account_id, exec_role, 'SecurityHubLogSetup')
                    enable_hub_in_session(log_session)

                    # 5. Add Log Archive as member in Audit Account if not present
                    members_resp = sh_audit.list_members(OnlyAssociated=False)
                    existing_members = [m['AccountId'] for m in members_resp.get('Members', [])]

                    if log_archive_account_id not in existing_members:
                        sh_audit.create_members(
                            AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': log_archive_account_id}]
                        )

                    return {
                        'status': 'SUCCESS',
                        'AuditAccountId': audit_account_id,
                        'LogArchiveAccountId': log_archive_account_id
                    }

  AccountProvisionedDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: Superwerker-SecurityHub-AccountProvisioned
      Content:
        description: Enable Security Hub in a newly provisioned member account and associate it with the Audit delegated administrator.
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AccountId:
            type: String
            description: Account ID of the newly provisioned account
          AuditAccountIdParam:
            type: String
            default: !Ref AuditAccountIdParameter
            description: Parameter store path for Audit Account ID
          ExecutionRoleName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref ControlTowerExecutionRoleName
            description: Control Tower execution role name
        mainSteps:
          - name: ConfigureMemberSecurityHub
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AccountId: '{{AccountId}}'
                AuditAccountIdParam: '{{AuditAccountIdParam}}'
                ExecutionRoleName: '{{ExecutionRoleName}}'
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import os
                import time

                def get_parameter(ssm, name):
                    resp = ssm.get_parameter(Name=name)
                    return resp['Parameter']['Value']

                def assume_role(account_id, role_name, session_name):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    role_arn = f"arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/{role_name}"
                    assumed = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=role_arn,
                        RoleSessionName=session_name
                    )
                    credentials = assumed['Credentials']
                    return boto3.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=credentials['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=credentials['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=credentials['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1')
                    )

                def handler(events, context):
                    region = os.environ.get('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1')
                    target_account_id = events['AccountId']
                    exec_role = events['ExecutionRoleName']
                    ssm = boto3.client('ssm', region_name=region)
                    audit_account_id = get_parameter(ssm, events['AuditAccountIdParam'])

                    if target_account_id == audit_account_id:
                        return {'status': 'SKIPPED_AUDIT_ACCOUNT'}

                    # Retry assuming role in newly provisioned account
                    member_session = None
                    for attempt in range(6):
                        try:
                            member_session = assume_role(target_account_id, exec_role, 'SecurityHubMemberEnable')
                            break
                        except Exception:
                            time.sleep(10)

                    if not member_session:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"Could not assume {exec_role} in {target_account_id}")

                    # Enable Security Hub in member account
                    sh_member = member_session.client('securityhub')
                    try:
                        sh_member.describe_hub()
                    except sh_member.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                        sh_member.enable_security_hub(
                            EnableDefaultStandards=True,
                            ControlFindingGenerator='SECURITY_CONTROL'
                        )

                    # Connect with Audit Account Delegated Admin
                    audit_session = assume_role(audit_account_id, exec_role, 'SecurityHubAuditLink')
                    sh_audit = audit_session.client('securityhub')

                    members_resp = sh_audit.list_members(OnlyAssociated=False)
                    existing_members = [m['AccountId'] for m in members_resp.get('Members', [])]

                    if target_account_id not in existing_members:
                        sh_audit.create_members(
                            AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': target_account_id}]
                        )

                    return {
                        'status': 'SUCCESS',
                        'AccountId': target_account_id
                    }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Shared IAM roles, GuardDuty detector, CloudWatch Log Groups, and CloudFormation
  registry extension activations for multi-cluster EKS deployments.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment alias used as a prefix for named resources (e.g., dev, staging, prod).
    Default: eks-shared
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, or underscores.

  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional hash or suffix to ensure global naming uniqueness across deployments.
    Default: ''

  # PermissionsBoundary:
  #   Type: String
  #   Description: Optional ARN of an IAM Permissions Boundary policy to attach to all created IAM roles.
  #   Default: ''

  BastionS3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: The name of the S3 bucket to which the bastion host IAM role is granted GetObject access.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name.

Conditions:
  HasEnvironmentHash: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentHash, '']]
  # HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundary, '']]

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # Amazon GuardDuty
  # ============================================================================
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES
      DataSources:
        S3Logs:
          Enable: true
        Kubernetes:
          AuditLogs:
            Enable: true

  # ============================================================================
  # CloudWatch Log Groups for CloudFormation Extension Registries
  # ============================================================================
  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      RetentionInDays: 30

  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      RetentionInDays: 30

  EKSClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Roles
  # ============================================================================

  # 1. Lambda execution role with read-only access for resource discovery
  ResourceDiscoveryLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-resource-discovery-lambda-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-resource-discovery-lambda-role'
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResourceDiscoveryReadOnly
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                  - tag:GetTagKeys
                  - tag:GetTagValues
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource: '*'

  # 2. Lambda role for getting the caller identity and accessing CloudFormation and CloudTrail logs
  CallerIdentityLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-caller-identity-lambda-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-caller-identity-lambda-role'
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityAndLogAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  # 3. Role for describing EKS node groups
  EKSNodeGroupDescribeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-eks-nodegroup-describe-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-eks-nodegroup-describe-role'
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSDescribeNodeGroupsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeUpdate
                Resource: '*'

  # 4. CloudFormation execution role with max session duration of 8400 seconds
  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-execution-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-execution-role'
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationBroadManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: '*'

  # 5. Logging delivery role for CloudFormation registry logs
  CloudFormationLoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-registry-logging-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-registry-logging-role'
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - resources.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationRegistryLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  # 6. Role for CodeBuild and EKS service integration
  CodeBuildEKSRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-codebuild-eks-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-codebuild-eks-role'
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildEKSServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  # 7. Role for CloudFormation extension hooks
  CloudFormationExtensionHookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-extension-hook-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-extension-hook-role'
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - resources.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - hooks.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ExtensionHooksBroadPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: '*'

  # 8. Bastion instance role
  BastionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If
        - HasEnvironmentHash
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-role'
        - !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion-role'
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  BastionInstanceProfile:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for comprehensive SQS infrastructure with KMS encryption and CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Environment name prefix for resources.

Resources:
  KmsEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting SQS queues and CloudWatch alarms
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: sqs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAndSQS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sqs.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'

  KmsEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-sqs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsEncryptionKey

  StandaloneFifoQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-standalone-queue.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-fifo-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-fifo-queue.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  StandardDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-standard-dlq'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-standard-queue'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-separate-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-standard-queue-messages-sent'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor standard queue number of messages sent as a sum
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

  FifoQueueMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-fifo-queue-messages-sent-anomaly'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor FIFO queue average number of messages sent using anomaly detection
      ActionsEnabled: false
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSent (Expected)
          ReturnData: true

  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-standard-queue-sent-message-size'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor maximum sent message size on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

  SeparateFifoQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-separate-fifo-queue-sent-message-size'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor maximum sent message size on separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandaloneFifoQueue.QueueName

  StandardDlqMessagesVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-standard-dlq-messages-visible'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor visible messages on standard DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.QueueName

  FifoDlqMessagesVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-fifo-dlq-messages-visible'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor visible messages on FIFO DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDeadLetterQueue.QueueName

  StandardQueueAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-standard-queue-age-of-oldest-message'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor maximum age of oldest message on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

  SeparateFifoQueueAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-separate-fifo-queue-age-of-oldest-message'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor maximum age of oldest message on separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandaloneFifoQueue.QueueName

  StandardQueueMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-standard-queue-messages-not-visible'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor maximum number of messages not visible on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

  SeparateFifoQueueMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-separate-fifo-queue-messages-not-visible'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor maximum number of messages not visible on separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandaloneFifoQueue.QueueName

  StandardDlqAgeOfOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-standard-dlq-age-of-oldest-message'
      AlarmDescription: Monitor maximum age of oldest message on standard DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.QueueName

  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-synthetic-always-ok'
      AlarmDescription: Synthetic alarm that evaluates to not breaching on missing data
      ActionsEnabled: false
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: -1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName

Outputs:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for encrypting all SQS queues
    Value: !GetAtt KmsEncryptionKey.Arn
  StandaloneFifoQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the standalone FIFO queue without DLQ
    Value: !Ref StandaloneFifoQueue
  StandaloneFifoQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the standalone FIFO queue without DLQ
    Value: !GetAtt StandaloneFifoQueue.Arn
  FifoQueueWithDlqUrl:
    Description: URL of the FIFO queue with DLQ
    Value: !Ref FifoQueueWithDlq
  FifoQueueWithDlqArn:
    Description: ARN of the FIFO queue with DLQ
    Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.Arn
  FifoDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the FIFO DLQ
    Value: !Ref FifoDeadLetterQueue
  FifoDeadLetterQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the FIFO DLQ
    Value: !GetAtt FifoDeadLetterQueue.Arn
  StandardQueueWithDlqUrl:
    Description: URL of the Standard queue with DLQ
    Value: !Ref StandardQueueWithDlq
  StandardQueueWithDlqArn:
    Description: ARN of the Standard queue with DLQ
    Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.Arn
  StandardDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the Standard DLQ
    Value: !Ref StandardDeadLetterQueue
  StandardDeadLetterQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the Standard DLQ
    Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.Arn
  SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the separate FIFO DLQ
    Value: !Ref SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue
  SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the separate FIFO DLQ
    Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation Template to deploy private networking infrastructure for a private Red Hat OpenShift on AWS (ROSA) cluster with PrivateLink, an Egress VPC, and Transit Gateway routing.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: ROSA Cluster VPC Configuration
        Parameters:
          - NumberOfAZs
          - ROSAVpcCidr
          - ROSASubnet1Cidr
          - ROSASubnet2Cidr
          - ROSASubnet3Cidr
      - Label:
          default: Egress VPC Configuration
        Parameters:
          - EgressVpcCidr
          - EgressPublicSubnetCidr
          - EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      - Label:
          default: Optional Features
        Parameters:
          - CreateELBServiceLinkedRole
          - EnableFlowLogs
    ParameterLabels:
      NumberOfAZs:
        default: Number of Availability Zones for ROSA
      ROSAVpcCidr:
        default: ROSA VPC CIDR Block
      ROSASubnet1Cidr:
        default: ROSA Subnet 1 CIDR Block
      ROSASubnet2Cidr:
        default: ROSA Subnet 2 CIDR Block (AZ 2)
      ROSASubnet3Cidr:
        default: ROSA Subnet 3 CIDR Block (AZ 3)
      EgressVpcCidr:
        default: Egress VPC CIDR Block
      EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
        default: Egress Public Subnet CIDR Block
      EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
        default: Egress Private Subnet CIDR Block
      CreateELBServiceLinkedRole:
        default: Create ELB Service-Linked Role
      EnableFlowLogs:
        default: Enable VPC Flow Logs

Parameters:
  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: String
    Default: '3'
    AllowedValues:
      - '1'
      - '3'
    Description: Number of Availability Zones for the private ROSA cluster (Single-AZ = 1, Multi-AZ = 3).

  ROSAVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the ROSA private VPC.

  ROSASubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA Subnet 1 (AZ 1).

  ROSASubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA Subnet 2 (AZ 2, ignored if Single-AZ).

  ROSASubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA Subnet 3 (AZ 3, ignored if Single-AZ).

  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the centralized Egress VPC.

  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the Egress VPC public subnet hosting the NAT and Internet Gateways.

  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the Egress VPC private subnet hosting the Transit Gateway attachment.

  CreateELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing service-linked role.

  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to enable VPC Flow Logs delivered to CloudWatch Logs and encrypted with a KMS customer managed key for both VPCs.

Conditions:
  IsMultiAZ: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, '3']
  ShouldCreateELBRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateELBServiceLinkedRole, 'true']
  ShouldEnableFlowLogs: !Equals [!Ref EnableFlowLogs, 'true']

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # Service Linked Role
  # =========================================================================
  ElasticLoadBalancingServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: ShouldCreateELBRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing created for ROSA

  # =========================================================================
  # Egress VPC Infrastructure
  # =========================================================================
  EgressVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc'

  EgressInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-igw'

  EgressVPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressInternetGateway

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-subnet'

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-subnet'

  EgressNatElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: EgressVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-nat-eip'

  EgressNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EgressNatElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-nat-gw'

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-rt'

  EgressPublicRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref EgressInternetGateway

  EgressPublicRouteToROSA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachmentEgress
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref ROSAVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-rt'

  EgressPrivateRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref EgressNatGateway

  EgressPrivateRouteToROSA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachmentEgress
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref ROSAVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  # =========================================================================
  # ROSA VPC Infrastructure
  # =========================================================================
  ROSAVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref ROSAVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc'

  ROSASubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref ROSASubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-subnet-1'

  ROSASubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref ROSASubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-subnet-2'

  ROSASubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref ROSASubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-subnet-3'

  ROSARouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-rt'

  ROSARouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachmentROSA
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSARouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  ROSASubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ROSASubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSARouteTable

  ROSASubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ROSASubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSARouteTable

  ROSASubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ROSASubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref ROSARouteTable

  # =========================================================================
  # Transit Gateway Infrastructure
  # =========================================================================
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Description: Transit Gateway connecting ROSA VPC and Egress VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt'

  TransitGatewayAttachmentEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attachment-egress'

  TransitGatewayAttachmentROSA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      SubnetIds: !If
        - IsMultiAZ
        - - !Ref ROSASubnet1
          - !Ref ROSASubnet2
          - !Ref ROSASubnet3
        - - !Ref ROSASubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attachment-rosa'

  TransitGatewayAssociationEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayAttachmentEgress

  TransitGatewayAssociationROSA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayAttachmentROSA

  TransitGatewayRouteToInternet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAssociationEgress
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayAttachmentEgress

  TransitGatewayRouteToROSA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAssociationROSA
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref ROSAVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayAttachmentROSA

  # =========================================================================
  # VPC Flow Logs & KMS & CloudWatch Logs
  # =========================================================================
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      Description: KMS Customer Managed Key for VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Log Groups
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-logs-kms-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  ROSAFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}-rosa'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  EgressFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}-egress'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  VpcFlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ROSAFlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ROSAFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
                  - !GetAtt EgressFlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${EgressFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  ROSAFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref ROSAFlowLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref ROSAVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rosa-flow-log'

  EgressFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref EgressFlowLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-egress-flow-log'

Outputs:
  ROSAVPCId:
    Description: The ID of the private ROSA cluster VPC
    Value: !Ref ROSAVPC

  ROSASubnet1Id:
    Description: The ID of ROSA Subnet 1 (AZ 1)
    Value: !Ref ROSASubnet1

  ROSASubnet2Id:
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Description: The ID of ROSA Subnet 2 (AZ 2)
    Value: !Ref ROSASubnet2

  ROSASubnet3Id:

    Description: The ID of ROSA Subnet 3 (AZ 3)

  ROSASubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of active ROSA Subnet IDs

  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: The ID of the Egress VPC private subnet

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: The ID of the Egress VPC Internet Gateway

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: The ID of the Egress NAT Gateway
    Value: !Ref EgressNatGateway

  NatGatewayElasticIP:
    Description: The Elastic IP allocated to the NAT Gateway
    Value: !Ref EgressNatElasticIP

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: The ID of the Transit Gateway

  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: The ID of the Transit Gateway Route Table

  TransitGatewayROSAAttachmentId:
    Description: The ID of the Transit Gateway ROSA VPC Attachment

  TransitGatewayEgressAttachmentId:
    Description: The ID of the Transit Gateway Egress VPC Attachment
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayAttachmentEgress

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Description: The ARN of the KMS Key used to encrypt VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

Description: >
  Prerequisites and nine AWS Systems Manager Automation remediation documents
  for PCI DSS controls, with exported outputs for Config conformance packs.

Resources:
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/pci-compliance-logs-${AWS::AccountId}'
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  CloudTrailKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for CloudTrail PCI DSS compliance log encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: KeyPolicyForPCICloudTrail
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToDescribeKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToEncryptLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:cloudtrail:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  CloudTrailKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/pci-dss-cloudtrail-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailKmsKey

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'SSMAutomationRemediationRole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'

  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogsRole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn

  RemediationDocCloudTrailEncryptAndCloudWatch:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'Remediation-EncryptCloudTrailAndConfigureCWLogs-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Encrypts a specified CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrates with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: The KMS key ID, ARN, or alias used to encrypt CloudTrail logs.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailKmsKey.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group to which CloudTrail events will be delivered.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role for CloudTrail to deliver logs to CloudWatch Logs.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: updateTrailEncryptionAndCloudWatch
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'

  RemediationDocEnableKmsKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'Remediation-EnableKmsKeyRotation-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables key rotation for a specified AWS KMS customer managed key.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: The unique identifier or ARN of the KMS key.
        mainSteps:
          - name: enableKeyRotation
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'

  RemediationDocCloudTrailCWLogsIntegration:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'Remediation-IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchLogs-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Configures a CloudTrail trail to deliver events to a CloudWatch Logs log group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role for CloudWatch delivery.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: integrateCloudWatchLogs
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'

  RemediationDocUpdatePasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'Remediation-UpdateIamPasswordPolicyPCI-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates account IAM password policy to meet PCI DSS requirements.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          MinimumPasswordLength:
            type: Integer
            default: 14
            description: Minimum password length.
          RequireUppercaseCharacters:
            type: Boolean
            default: true
            description: Require uppercase characters.
          RequireLowercaseCharacters:
            type: Boolean
            default: true
            description: Require lowercase characters.
          RequireNumbers:
            type: Boolean
            default: true
            description: Require numeric characters.
          RequireSymbols:
            type: Boolean
            default: true
            description: Require symbols.
          AllowUsersToChangePassword:
            type: Boolean
            default: true
            description: Allow users to change passwords.
          HardExpiry:
            type: Boolean
            default: true
            description: Enforce hard expiry preventing login after password expiration.
          MaxPasswordAge:
            type: Integer
            default: 90
            description: Maximum password age in days.
          PasswordReusePrevention:
            type: Integer
            default: 24
            description: Number of previous passwords to prevent reuse.
        mainSteps:
          - name: updatePasswordPolicy
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: '{{ MinimumPasswordLength }}'
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: '{{ RequireUppercaseCharacters }}'
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: '{{ RequireLowercaseCharacters }}'
              RequireNumbers: '{{ RequireNumbers }}'
              RequireSymbols: '{{ RequireSymbols }}'
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: '{{ AllowUsersToChangePassword }}'
              HardExpiry: '{{ HardExpiry }}'
              MaxPasswordAge: '{{ MaxPasswordAge }}'
              PasswordReusePrevention: '{{ PasswordReusePrevention }}'

  RemediationDocCloudTrailValidationMultiRegionCW:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'Remediation-EnableCloudTrailValidationMultiRegionCW-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables log file validation, multi-region logging, and CloudWatch Logs integration on a CloudTrail trail.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role for CloudWatch delivery.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: configureTrail
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'

  RemediationDocRevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'Remediation-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revokes all inbound and outbound rules on a given default security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the default security group.
        mainSteps:
          - name: revokeAllRules
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    group_id = events['GroupId']

                    sg_response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    sg = sg_response['SecurityGroups'][0]

                    ip_permissions = sg.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    if ip_permissions:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions
                        )

                    ip_permissions_egress = sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ip_permissions_egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ip_permissions_egress
                        )

                    return {
                        'StatusCode': 200,
                        'Message': f'Successfully revoked all ingress and egress rules for security group {group_id}'
                    }

  RemediationDocDeleteSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'Remediation-DeleteSecurityGroup-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Deletes a specified EC2 security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the security group to delete.
        mainSteps:
          - name: deleteSecurityGroup
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'

  RemediationDocReleaseElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'Remediation-ReleaseElasticIp-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Releases an unattached Elastic IP address given its allocation ID.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: The allocation ID of the Elastic IP address.
        mainSteps:
          - name: releaseAddress
            action: 'aws:executeAwsApi'
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'

  RemediationDocRemoveCodeBuildCredentials:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'Remediation-RemoveCodeBuildAwsCredentials-${AWS::Region}'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates a CodeBuild project to remove plaintext AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the CodeBuild project.
        mainSteps:
          - name: removeCredentialsFromEnvironment
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.10
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    cb = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']

                    response = cb.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    if not response.get('projects'):
                        raise Exception(f'Project {project_name} not found')

                    project = response['projects'][0]
                    environment = project.get('environment', {})
                    env_vars = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])

                    keys_to_remove = {'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'}
                    filtered_vars = [v for v in env_vars if v.get('name') not in keys_to_remove]

                    environment['environmentVariables'] = filtered_vars

                    cb.update_project(
                        name=project_name,
                        environment=environment
                    )

                    return {
                        'StatusCode': 200,
                        'Message': f'Successfully sanitized environment variables for project {project_name}'
                    }
