AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Telemetry monitoring pipeline and CloudWatch dashboard for Claude Desktop (CoWork) usage tracking.

Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard for CoWork telemetry.
    Default: Claude-Desktop-CoWork-Telemetry
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group to receive CoWork telemetry events.
    Default: /aws/claude-desktop/cowork-telemetry

  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of days to retain telemetry log events.
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

  MetricsNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for CoWork telemetry metrics.
    Default: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork

  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS region where CloudWatch metrics and dashboard will be scoped.
    Default: us-east-1

Resources:
  CoWorkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Metric Filters: Schema 1 - Local Agent Mode
  # Schema format: { "mode": "local_agent", "user": "...", "model": "...", "usage": { "input_tokens": N, ... }, "cost_usd": N }
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LocalAgentInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.schema = "local_agent" || $.mode = "local_agent") && ($.usage.input_tokens >= 0) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.input_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: $.user
            - Key: Model
              Value: $.model

  LocalAgentOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.schema = "local_agent" || $.mode = "local_agent") && ($.usage.output_tokens >= 0) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.output_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: $.user
            - Key: Model
              Value: $.model

  LocalAgentCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup

    Properties:

        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 2,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "# Claude Desktop (CoWork) Telemetry Dashboard\nMetrics aggregated across Local Agent Mode and Claude Code schemas. Scoped to **${MetricsRegion}**."
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 4,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Input Tokens", "id": "m1" } ],
                  [ ".", "OutputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Output Tokens", "id": "m2" } ],
                  [ { "expression": "m1 + m2", "label": "Total Tokens", "id": "eTotalTokens" } ]
                ],
                "view": "singleValue",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Total Tokens Consumed",
                "period": 86400
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 4,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 4,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "EstimatedCost", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Estimated Cost (USD)" } ]
                ],
                "view": "singleValue",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Total Estimated Cost ($)",
                "period": 86400
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 8,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 4,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "SessionTurns", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Session Turns" } ]
                ],
                "view": "singleValue",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Total Session Turns",
                "period": 86400
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 4,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "CacheReadTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Cache Read Tokens" } ]
                ],
                "view": "singleValue",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Cache Hit Tokens",
                "period": 86400
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 16,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 4,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "EstimatedCost", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "mCost", "visible": false } ],
                  [ ".", "SessionTurns", { "stat": "Sum", "id": "mTurns", "visible": false } ],
                  [ { "expression": "IF(mTurns > 0, mCost / mTurns, 0)", "label": "Avg Cost / Turn ($)", "id": "eAvgCost" } ]
                ],
                "view": "singleValue",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Average Cost per Turn",
                "period": 86400
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 20,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 4,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricsNamespace}} MetricName=\"SessionTurns\"', 'Sum', 86400)", "id": "eActiveUsers", "visible": false } ],
                  [ { "expression": "COUNT(eActiveUsers)", "label": "Active Users (24h)", "id": "eUserCount" } ]
                ],
                "view": "singleValue",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Active Users",
                "period": 86400
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Input Tokens" } ],
                  [ ".", "OutputTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Output Tokens" } ],
                  [ ".", "CacheReadTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Cache Read Tokens" } ],
                  [ ".", "CacheCreationTokens", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Cache Creation Tokens" } ]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Token Usage Trends Over Time",
                "period": 3600
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricsNamespace}", "EstimatedCost", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Cost (USD)", "yAxis": "left" } ],
                  [ ".", "SessionTurns", { "stat": "Sum", "label": "Session Turns", "yAxis": "right" } ]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Cost & Session Turn Trends Over Time",
                "period": 3600
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricsNamespace},User} MetricName=\"InputTokens\"', 'Sum', 86400)", "id": "eUserTokens" } ]
                ],
                "view": "bar",
                "stacked": true,
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Token Usage Breakdown by User",
                "period": 86400
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 8,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricsNamespace},User} MetricName=\"EstimatedCost\"', 'Sum', 86400)", "id": "eUserCost" } ]
                ],
                "view": "bar",
                "stacked": true,
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Cost Breakdown by User ($)",
                "period": 86400
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 16,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricsNamespace},User} MetricName=\"SessionTurns\"', 'Sum', 86400)", "id": "eUserTurns" } ]
                ],
                "view": "bar",
                "stacked": true,
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Session Activity Breakdown by User",
                "period": 86400
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 18,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 7,
              "properties": {
                "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, schema, mode, user, userId, model, modelId, usage.input_tokens, tokens.input, usage.output_tokens, tokens.output, cost_usd, estimatedCost\n| sort @timestamp desc\n| limit 100",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "title": "Recent Raw CoWork Events",
                "view": "table"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CDK Bootstrap template with S3 bucket, ECR repository, KMS key, IAM roles, and SSM version parameter.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    Description: An alphanumeric string used to distinguish between different bootstrap stacks deployed in the same environment.
    MaxLength: 10
    MinLength: 1
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Qualifier must be between 1 and 10 alphanumeric characters.

  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket to store file assets. If left blank, a default name will be generated.

  KmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Existing KMS Key ID or ARN to use for asset encryption. If left blank, a new KMS key will be created.

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: List of AWS account IDs permitted to publish assets and initiate deployments.

  TrustedAccountsForLookup:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: List of AWS account IDs permitted to perform context lookups.

  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: List of managed policy ARNs to attach to the CloudFormation execution role. Leave empty for AdministratorAccess.

  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: Number
    Default: 22
    Description: The version of the bootstrap environment schema.

Conditions:
  CreateNewKey: !Equals [!Ref KmsKeyId, '']
  UseCustomBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketName, '']]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccounts], '']]
  HasTrustedAccountsForLookup: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup], '']]
  HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies], '']]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS Key for CDK assets bucket (${Qualifier})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDeploymentRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  FileAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - UseCustomBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
        - !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AccessControl: Private
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - CreateNewKey
                - !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
                - !Ref KmsKeyId
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: CleanupOldVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 365

  FileAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceHTTPS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !If
          - CreateNewKey
          - !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
          - !Ref KmsKeyId
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Retain maximum 100 untagged images",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "imageCountMoreThan",
                  "countNumber": 100
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"
                }
              }
            ]
          }

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishingPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:Abort*
                  - s3:DeleteObject*
                  - s3:GetBucket*
                  - s3:GetObject*
                  - s3:List*
                  - s3:PutObject*
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: KmsKeyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
                  - !Ref KmsKeyId

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishingPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrAuth
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrRepoAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
              - Sid: KmsAccessForEcr
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
                  - !Ref KmsKeyId

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccountsForLookup
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup
              Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LookupKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Deny
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: '*'

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassCloudFormationExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
              - Sid: S3ReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject*
                  - s3:GetBucket*
                  - s3:List*
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: KmsKeyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
                  - !Ref KmsKeyId

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  CdkBootstrapVersion:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version'
      Description: The version of the CDK bootstrap environment
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: The name of the S3 bucket created for CDK file assets
    Value: !Ref FileAssetsBucket

  BucketDomainName:
    Description: The domain name of the S3 bucket created for CDK file assets
    Value: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.RegionalDomainName

  RepositoryName:
    Description: The name of the ECR repository created for container assets
    Value: !Ref ContainerAssetsRepository

  RepositoryArn:
    Description: The ARN of the ECR repository created for container assets
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the KMS Key used to encrypt CDK assets
    Value: !If
      - CreateNewKey
      - !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      - !Ref KmsKeyId

  FilePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM role for file publishing
    Value: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn

  ImagePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM role for container image publishing
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn

  LookupRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM role for context lookup
    Value: !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn

  DeploymentActionRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM role for CDK deployment actions
    Value: !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn

  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM role passed to CloudFormation for stack execution
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn

  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Description: The SSM parameter tracking the CDK bootstrap version
    Value: !Ref CdkBootstrapVersion

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green deployment with support for temporary green environments and sample application deployment.

Parameters:
  CreateNewApplication:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Specify whether to create a new Elastic Beanstalk application or reference an existing one.

  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-bluegreen-app
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application.

  CreateBlueEnvironment:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create/manage the Blue environment via this template.

  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-blue-env
    Description: Name of the Blue environment.

  CreateGreenEnvironment:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to deploy the temporary Green environment for testing and traffic routing. Set to false to tear down.

  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-green-env
    Description: Name of the Green environment.

  SolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.4.2 running Node.js 20
    Description: Solution stack name for the Elastic Beanstalk environment.

  SampleSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: elasticbeanstalk-samples
    Description: S3 bucket name containing the sample deployment zip. If left as default 'elasticbeanstalk-samples', the current region is automatically appended.

  SampleSourceKey:
    Type: String
    Default: nodejs-sample.zip
    Description: S3 object key for the sample application package.

  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    Description: EC2 instance type for the Elastic Beanstalk environment instances.

  EnvironmentType:
    Type: String
    Default: SingleInstance
    AllowedValues:
      - SingleInstance
      - LoadBalanced
    Description: Elastic Beanstalk environment type (SingleInstance or LoadBalanced).

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateApp: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewApplication, 'true']
  ShouldCreateBlueEnv: !Equals [!Ref CreateBlueEnvironment, 'true']
  ShouldCreateGreenEnv: !Equals [!Ref CreateGreenEnvironment, 'true']
  IsDefaultBucket: !Equals [!Ref SampleSourceBucket, 'elasticbeanstalk-samples']
  NeedsAppVersion: !Or
    - !Condition ShouldCreateBlueEnv
    - !Condition ShouldCreateGreenEnv

Resources:
  BeanstalkServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-elasticbeanstalk-service-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkEnhancedHealth
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkManagedUpdatesCustomerRolePolicy

  BeanstalkInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-elasticbeanstalk-ec2-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWorkerTier
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkMulticontainerDocker

  BeanstalkInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-beanstalk-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref BeanstalkInstanceRole

  EBApplication:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: ShouldCreateApp
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Elastic Beanstalk application supporting Blue-Green deployments.

  EBApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Condition: NeedsAppVersion
    DependsOn:
      - EBApplication
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Initial application version deployed from S3 sample
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - IsDefaultBucket
          - !Sub ${SampleSourceBucket}-${AWS::Region}
          - !Ref SampleSourceBucket
        S3Key: !Ref SampleSourceKey

  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: ShouldCreateBlueEnv
    DependsOn:
      - EBApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref BlueEnvironmentName
      Description: Blue deployment environment
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref EBApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref BeanstalkInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: InstanceType
          Value: !Ref InstanceType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref BeanstalkServiceRole

  GreenEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: ShouldCreateGreenEnv
    DependsOn:
      - EBApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvironmentName
      Description: Temporary Green deployment environment
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref EBApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref BeanstalkInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: InstanceType
          Value: !Ref InstanceType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref BeanstalkServiceRole

Outputs:
  ApplicationNameOutput:
    Description: The Elastic Beanstalk Application Name
    Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  BlueEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Condition: ShouldCreateBlueEnv
    Description: URL Endpoint for the Blue Environment
    Value: !GetAtt BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL

  GreenEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Condition: ShouldCreateGreenEnv
    Description: URL Endpoint for the Green Environment
    Value: !GetAtt GreenEnvironment.EndpointURL

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Service Catalog environment for Machine Learning Workshop with Admin and End User Portfolios.

Parameters:
  RootS3Url:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: Root S3 URL pointing to the location of the nested CloudFormation templates.
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    Description: Environment prefix for workshop resources and roles.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # Service Catalog Portfolios
  # ============================================================================
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop Admin Portfolio"
      Description: Portfolio containing baseline and administrative infrastructure products for ML workshop.
      ProviderName: WorkshopAdminTeam

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop End User Portfolio"
      Description: Portfolio containing end user application, analytics, and machine learning products.
      ProviderName: WorkshopAdminTeam

  # ============================================================================
  # Service Catalog Launch Roles
  # ============================================================================
  VpcLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-VpcProduct-LaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcLaunchPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"

  BaselineSecurityLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-BaselineSecurityProduct-LaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSKeyManagementServicePowerUser
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SsmAndKmsAdminPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Create*
                  - kms:Describe*
                  - kms:Enable*
                  - kms:List*
                  - kms:Put*
                  - kms:Update*
                  - kms:Revoke*
                  - kms:Disable*
                  - kms:Get*
                  - kms:Delete*
                  - kms:TagResource
                  - kms:UntagResource
                  - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
                  - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"

  DataExchangeLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-DataExchangeProduct-LaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataExchangePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dataexchange:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"

  InfraLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-InfraProduct-LaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InfraLaunchPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"

  AppLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-AppProduct-LaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppLaunchPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"

  SageMakerLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-SageMakerProduct-LaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerLaunchPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"

  ThirdPartyMlModelLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-ThirdPartyMlModelProduct-LaunchRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSMarketplaceManageSubscriptions
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ThirdPartyMlModelPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"

  # ============================================================================
  # Service Catalog Products
  # ============================================================================
  VpcProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-VPC-with-Private-Subnets-and-Endpoints"
      Owner: MLAdminTeam
      Description: VPC with isolated private subnets and VPC endpoints for ML workloads.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/vpc.template.yaml"

  IamKmsS3Product:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-IAM-Roles-KMS-Keys-and-S3-Buckets"
      Owner: MLAdminTeam
      Description: Core security baseline resources including IAM roles, KMS customer managed keys, and S3 buckets.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/baseline-security.template.yaml"

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-AWS-Data-Exchange-Product"
      Owner: MLAdminTeam
      Description: Provision AWS Data Exchange subscriptions and assets for workshop datasets.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/data-exchange.template.yaml"

  InfraProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-Infrastructure-Product"
      Owner: MLAdminTeam
      Description: Base ML workshop infrastructure including compute resources and security groups.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/infrastructure.template.yaml"

  AppProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-Application-Product"
      Owner: MLAdminTeam
      Description: ML workshop application stack.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/application.template.yaml"

  SageMakerProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-SageMaker-Notebook-Instance"
      Owner: MLAdminTeam
      Description: Secure SageMaker notebook instance configured inside private subnet with KMS encryption.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/sagemaker-notebook.template.yaml"

  ThirdPartyMlModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-Third-Party-ML-Model"
      Owner: MLAdminTeam
      Description: Pre-trained third-party machine learning model deployment package.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial Version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub "${RootS3Url}/third-party-ml-model.template.yaml"

  # ============================================================================
  # Portfolio Product Associations
  # ============================================================================
  AdminPortfolioVpcAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VpcProduct

  AdminPortfolioIamKmsS3Assoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IamKmsS3Product

  AdminPortfolioInfraAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfraProduct

  EndUserPortfolioDataExchangeAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct

  EndUserPortfolioAppAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref AppProduct

  EndUserPortfolioSageMakerAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerProduct

  EndUserPortfolioThirdPartyMlModelAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMlModelProduct

  # ============================================================================
  # Launch Role Constraints
  # ============================================================================
  VpcLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: AdminPortfolioVpcAssoc
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VpcProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt VpcLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch constraint using dedicated VPC launch role.

  IamKmsS3LaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: AdminPortfolioIamKmsS3Assoc
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IamKmsS3Product
      RoleArn: !GetAtt BaselineSecurityLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch constraint using dedicated Baseline Security launch role.

  InfraLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: AdminPortfolioInfraAssoc
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfraProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt InfraLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch constraint using dedicated Infrastructure launch role.

  DataExchangeLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: EndUserPortfolioDataExchangeAssoc
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt DataExchangeLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch constraint using dedicated Data Exchange launch role.

  AppLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: EndUserPortfolioAppAssoc
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref AppProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AppLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch constraint using dedicated Application launch role.

  SageMakerLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: EndUserPortfolioSageMakerAssoc
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch constraint using dedicated SageMaker launch role.

  ThirdPartyMlModelLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: EndUserPortfolioThirdPartyMlModelAssoc
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMlModelProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ThirdPartyMlModelLaunchRole.Arn
      Description: Launch constraint using dedicated Third Party ML Model launch role.

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM End User Roles
  # ============================================================================
  AdminLeadEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-SC-Admin-Lead"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSServiceCatalogAdminFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminLeadPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameterHistory
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/Stage: provisioning

  StandardEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentPrefix}-SC-End-User"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSServiceCatalogEndUserFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EndUserPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameterHistory
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/Stage: provisioning

  # ============================================================================
  # Portfolio Principal Associations
  # ============================================================================
  AdminPortfolioLeadAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt AdminLeadEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM

  EndUserPortfolioLeadAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt AdminLeadEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM

  EndUserPortfolioDevAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt StandardEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM

Outputs:
  AdminPortfolioId:
    Description: Portfolio ID for the Admin Portfolio
    Value: !Ref AdminPortfolio

  EndUserPortfolioId:
    Description: Portfolio ID for the End User Portfolio
    Value: !Ref EndUserPortfolio

  AdminLeadRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Service Catalog Admin Lead End User Role
    Value: !GetAtt AdminLeadEndUserRole.Arn

  StandardEndUserRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Standard End User Role
    Value: !GetAtt StandardEndUserRole.Arn

  AdminLeadRoleSwitchUrl:
    Description: Switch Role URL for the Service Catalog Admin Lead End User
    Value: !Sub "https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?account=${AWS::AccountId}&roleName=${AdminLeadEndUserRole}&displayName=${EnvironmentPrefix}-SC-Admin-Lead"

  DeveloperEndUserRoleSwitchUrl:
    Description: Switch Role URL for the Standard Developer End User
    Value: !Sub "https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?account=${AWS::AccountId}&roleName=${StandardEndUserRole}&displayName=${EnvironmentPrefix}-SC-End-User"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 VPC with public and private subnets, NACLs, routing, optional NAT Gateway, EC2 Placement Group, and DHCP Options Set.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Environment selection that governs CIDR blocks, naming, and domain assignments.

  DeployNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to 'true' to deploy a managed NAT Gateway and Elastic IP for IPv4 outbound private subnet traffic.

  BastionVpnPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1194
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Destination port allowed by the public NACL for bastion VPN connectivity (e.g. OpenVPN UDP/TCP).

Conditions:
  ShouldDeployNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNatGateway, 'true']

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: '10.100.0.0/16'
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: '10.100.1.0/24'
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: '10.100.2.0/24'
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: '10.100.3.0/24'
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: '10.100.10.0/24'
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: '10.100.20.0/24'
      DomainName: 'staging.compute.internal'
    production:
      VpcCidr: '10.200.0.0/16'
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: '10.200.1.0/24'
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: '10.200.2.0/24'
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: '10.200.3.0/24'
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: '10.200.10.0/24'
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: '10.200.20.0/24'
      DomainName: 'production.compute.internal'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, VpcCidr]
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DHCPOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-dhcp-options'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptions

  PlacementGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PlacementGroup
    Properties:
      Strategy: cluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-cluster-pg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ============================================================================
  # Subnets
  # ============================================================================

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PublicSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-public-az1-presentation1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PublicSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-public-az1-presentation2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PublicSubnet3Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-public-az2-compute'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PrivateSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-private-az1-app'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PrivateSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-private-az1-data'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ============================================================================
  # NAT Gateway & Elastic IP (Optional)
  # ============================================================================

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: ShouldDeployNatGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: ShouldDeployNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ============================================================================
  # Route Tables and Routes
  # ============================================================================

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultIPv4Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicDefaultIPv6Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultIPv6Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  PrivateDefaultIPv4Route:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: ShouldDeployNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ============================================================================
  # Public Network ACL and Rules
  # ============================================================================

  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${EnvironmentName}-public-nacl'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet1AclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicSubnet2AclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicSubnet3AclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  # Public Inbound IPv4 Rules
  PublicInboundIPv4HTTP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicInboundIPv4HTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicInboundIPv4SSH:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicInboundIPv4VpnUdp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: !Ref BastionVpnPort
        To: !Ref BastionVpnPort

  PublicInboundIPv4VpnTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 131
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: !Ref BastionVpnPort
        To: !Ref BastionVpnPort

  PublicInboundIPv4EphemeralTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow

      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024

  PublicInboundIPv4EphemeralUdp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 150
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024

  # Public Inbound IPv6 Rules
  PublicInboundIPv6HTTP:

    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200

      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 80

  PublicInboundIPv6HTTPS:

    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 210

      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 443

  PublicInboundIPv6SSH:

    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 220

      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:

  PublicInboundIPv6VpnUdp:

      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 230

      RuleAction: allow

      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Movies API with DynamoDB, AWS Lambda (Python 3.12), and Amazon API Gateway.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment stage name for the API Gateway deployment (e.g., dev, prod, staging).

Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub movies-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub movies-lambda-role-${Environment}-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCRUDPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/movies-create-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 1

  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/movies-read-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 1

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/movies-update-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 1

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/movies-delete-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 1

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-create-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              headers = {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"
              }
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  if 'title' not in body:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 400,
                          "headers": headers,
                          "body": json.dumps({"error": "Missing required field: title"})
                      }
                  table.put_item(Item=body)
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 201,
                      "headers": headers,
                      "body": json.dumps({"message": "Movie created successfully", "movie": body})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 500,
                      "headers": headers,
                      "body": json.dumps({"error": str(e)})
                  }

  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - ReadMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-read-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.parse
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              headers = {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"
              }
              try:
                  params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
                  title_param = params.get('title')
                  if not title_param:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 400,
                          "headers": headers,
                          "body": json.dumps({"error": "Path parameter 'title' is required"})
                      }
                  title = urllib.parse.unquote_plus(title_param)
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
                  if 'Item' not in response:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 404,
                          "headers": headers,
                          "body": json.dumps({"error": f"Movie '{title}' not found"})
                      }
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 200,
                      "headers": headers,
                      "body": json.dumps(response['Item'])
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 500,
                      "headers": headers,
                      "body": json.dumps({"error": str(e)})
                  }

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-update-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              headers = {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"
              }
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 400,
                          "headers": headers,
                          "body": json.dumps({"error": "Missing required field: title"})
                      }
                  table.put_item(Item=body)
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 200,
                      "headers": headers,
                      "body": json.dumps({"message": "Movie updated successfully", "movie": body})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 500,
                      "headers": headers,
                      "body": json.dumps({"error": str(e)})
                  }

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-delete-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              headers = {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"
              }
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title and event.get('queryStringParameters'):
                      title = event['queryStringParameters'].get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {
                          "statusCode": 400,
                          "headers": headers,
                          "body": json.dumps({"error": "Missing required field: title in body or query parameters"})
                      }
                  table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 200,
                      "headers": headers,
                      "body": json.dumps({"message": f"Movie '{title}' deleted successfully"})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 500,
                      "headers": headers,
                      "body": json.dumps({"error": str(e)})
                  }

  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub movies-api-${Environment}
      Description: Serverless Movies REST API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesApi.RootResourceId

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi

        Type: MOCK

            ResponseTemplates:

      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'

            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  MoviesPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource

      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST

    Properties:

      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:

      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY

        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

      ResourceId: !Ref MovieTitleResource

    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
