    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile to create.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created if no existing domain ID is supplied.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet created for the SageMaker domain.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet created for the SageMaker domain.

Conditions:
  CreateDomainCondition: !Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # IAM Execution Role for MLOps Engineer Persona
  # =========================================================================
  MLOpsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub sagemaker-mlops-role-${AWS::StackName}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsPassRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*sagemaker*
                Condition:
                  StringEqualsIfExists:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - sagemaker.amazonaws.com

        - PolicyName: MLOpsPipelinesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline-execution/*

        - PolicyName: MLOpsWorkloadsAndMonitoringPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  # Training, Transform, Tuning Jobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:UpdateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  # Processing Jobs & Model Monitoring
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:training-job/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transform-job/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:hyper-parameter-tuning-job/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:monitoring-schedule/*

        - PolicyName: MLOpsModelsAndEndpointsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  # Models & Model Registry
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  # Endpoints & Configurations
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpointAsync
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package-group/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint-config/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*

        - PolicyName: MLOpsLineageAndExperimentsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:UpdateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:CreateAction
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                  - sagemaker:UpdateAction
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAction
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:UpdateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:CreateContext
                  - sagemaker:DescribeContext
                  - sagemaker:UpdateContext
                  - sagemaker:DeleteContext
                  - sagemaker:ListContexts
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:ListAssociations
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:Search
                  - sagemaker:GetSearchSuggestions
                Resource: '*'

        - PolicyName: MLOpsStudioOwnershipRestrictedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Read-only metadata access for listing domains and spaces
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
                  - sagemaker:ListDomains
                  - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
                  - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:ListAppImageConfigs
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAppImageConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                Resource: '*'
              # App management restricted to user's own profile
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/*/${UserProfileName}/*/*
              # Space management restricted to user-owned spaces
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/*/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/Owner: !Ref UserProfileName

        - PolicyName: MLOpsGeneralDependenciesPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*sagemaker*
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*sagemaker*/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'

  # =========================================================================
  # Conditional VPC & Networking Resources
  # =========================================================================
  StudioVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub sagemaker-studio-vpc-${AWS::StackName}

  StudioInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub sagemaker-studio-igw-${AWS::StackName}

  StudioVPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub sagemaker-studio-rt-${AWS::StackName}

  StudioDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    DependsOn: StudioVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub sagemaker-studio-subnet-1-${AWS::StackName}

  StudioSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref StudioSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable

  StudioSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub sagemaker-studio-subnet-2-${AWS::StackName}

  StudioSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref StudioSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable

  StudioSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio domain
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow internal domain traffic
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub sagemaker-studio-sg-${AWS::StackName}

  StudioSecurityGroupIngressSelf:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: -1

  # =========================================================================
  # Conditional SageMaker Studio Domain
  # =========================================================================
  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateDomainCondition
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub mlops-domain-${AWS::StackName}
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref StudioSubnet1
        - !Ref StudioSubnet2
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub mlops-domain-${AWS::StackName}

  # =========================================================================
  # SageMaker Studio User Profile
  # =========================================================================
  SageMakerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - CreateDomainCondition
        - !Ref SageMakerDomain
        - !Ref ExistingDomainId
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref UserProfileName
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref UserProfileName

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the created SageMaker Studio User Profile.
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerUserProfile.UserProfileArn

  DomainId:
    Description: ID of the SageMaker Studio Domain associated with the user profile.
    Value: !If
      - CreateDomainCondition
      - !Ref SageMakerDomain
      - !Ref ExistingDomainId

  MLOpsExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM Execution Role scoped for the MLOps engineer persona.
    Value: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready IAM roles for the Data Master project data pipeline.

Parameters:
  RawDataKmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing AWS KMS key used for raw data encryption and decryption.
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-z0-9-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid KMS Key ARN.

  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Target AWS Account ID used to scope STS AssumeRole policies.
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid 12-digit AWS Account ID.

Resources:
  DmsKinesisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-DMS-Kinesis-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM role for AWS DMS to publish data to Amazon Kinesis streams.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DMSKinesisAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: IAM role for DMS VPC management restricted to the target account.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref TargetAccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  EventBridgePipesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-EventBridgePipes-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM role for EventBridge Pipes to forward data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PipesFirehoseDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  FirehoseDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-FirehoseDelivery-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM role for Kinesis Data Firehose with KMS raw data access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FirehoseDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  LambdaControllerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-LambdaController-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM role for Lambda processing controller functions with KMS access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ControllerProcessingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                  - states:StopExecution
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  LambdaWorkerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-LambdaWorker-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM role for Lambda worker and routing functions with KMS access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WorkerRoutingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  GlueJobAndCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-GlueJobAndCrawler-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM role for AWS Glue crawlers and ETL jobs with data lake and KMS access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueDataLakeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                  - lakeformation:GrantPermissions
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  LakeFormationDataAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-LakeFormationDataAccess-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM role registered with AWS Lake Formation for managing data lake access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lakeformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LakeFormationStorageAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  StepFunctionsOrchestrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-StepFunctionsOrchestrator-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM role for AWS Step Functions to orchestrate data pipeline components.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsPipelineControl
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:StartCrawler
                  - glue:GetCrawler
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:RunTask
                  - ecs:StopTask
                  - ecs:DescribeTasks
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - emr-serverless:StartJobRun
                  - emr-serverless:GetJobRun
                  - emr-serverless:CancelJobRun
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutTargets
                  - events:PutRule
                  - events:DescribeRule
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-EcsTaskExecution-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM execution role for ECS Fargate tasks to pull images and publish logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-EcsTask-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM task role for ECS Fargate containers requiring data lake and KMS access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcsDataProcessingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  EmrServerlessJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-EmrServerlessJob-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM execution role for EMR Serverless applications and jobs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: emr-serverless.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EmrServerlessDataPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetDatabase

                  - glue:GetTable

                  - glue:GetPartitions

                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:DeleteTable

                  - glue:BatchUpdatePartition

              - Effect: Allow

                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  ManagedGrafanaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'DataMaster-ManagedGrafana-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: IAM role for AWS Managed Grafana workspace to monitor pipeline metrics.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudWatch Composite Alarms for Remittance API Gateway, Lambda Functions, and RDS Instance.

Parameters:
  ApiGatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: Remittance
    Description: The name of the existing API Gateway API.
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: The name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function.
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: The name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function.
  DBInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: The identifier of the existing RDS database instance.

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # API Gateway Metric Alarms
  # =========================================================================
  ApiGateway4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiGateway-4XXError-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when API Gateway 4XX error rate averages above 0 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGateway5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiGateway-5XXError-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when API Gateway 5XX error rate averages above 1 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: ApiGateway-Latency-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when API Gateway latency averages at or above 10000 ms over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGatewayCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm monitoring API Gateway 4XX, 5XX, and Latency alarms.
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM("${ApiGateway4XXErrorAlarm}") OR ALARM("${ApiGateway5XXErrorAlarm}") OR ALARM("${ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm}")'

  # =========================================================================
  # Lambda Metric Alarms - GetRemittances
  # =========================================================================
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Errors-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when GetRemittances Lambda errors exceed 0 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Invocations-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when GetRemittances Lambda invocations exceed 2 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: GetRemittances-Duration-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when GetRemittances Lambda duration averages at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # =========================================================================
  # Lambda Metric Alarms - CreateRemittance
  # =========================================================================
  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Errors-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when CreateRemittance Lambda errors exceed 0 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Invocations-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when CreateRemittance Lambda invocations exceed 2 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CreateRemittance-Duration-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when CreateRemittance Lambda duration averages at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  LambdaCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm monitoring errors and duration across Remittance Lambda functions.
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM("${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm}") OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm}") OR ALARM("${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm}") OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm}")'

  # =========================================================================
  # RDS Metric Alarms
  # =========================================================================
  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-CPUUtilization-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when RDS CPU utilization averages at or above 70% over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-DatabaseConnections-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when RDS database connections average at or above 100 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-Deadlocks-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when RDS deadlocks average at or above 10 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-NetworkTransmitThroughput-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when RDS network transmit throughput averages at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-NetworkReceiveThroughput-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when RDS network receive throughput averages at or above 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-Queries-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when RDS queries average at or above 100 over 300 seconds.

      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-DiskQueueDepth-High
      AlarmDescription: Alarms when RDS disk queue depth averages at or above 50 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-ReadLatency-High

        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier

      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite alarm monitoring RDS instance metrics.
      AlarmRule: !Sub 'ALARM("${RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsDeadlocksAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsQueriesAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsReadLatencyAlarm}") OR ALARM("${RdsWriteLatencyAlarm}")'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for QuickSight Admin Console monitoring and data extraction pipeline, featuring 7 Glue jobs, 7 triggers, 5 Firehose delivery streams, 5 CloudWatch metric streams, and an S3 storage bucket.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the existing S3 bucket containing the Glue ETL and Python shell scripts.
  ScriptPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts
    Description: S3 prefix/path within the ScriptBucketName where the scripts are stored (without leading or trailing slash).

Resources:
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  AdminSuiteUnifiedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-unified-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteUnifiedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                  - quicksight:PassDataSet
                  - quicksight:PassDataSource
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:*:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-unified-role-${AWS::Region}'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue Jobs - Python Shell (5 jobs)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--target_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteUnifiedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--target_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless CRUD API for Kitten service using Amazon API Gateway and DynamoDB.

Resources:
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH

  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  KittenApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenServiceApi
      Description: REST API for Kitten Service with direct DynamoDB integration
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  GatewayResponseDefault4XX:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResponseType: DEFAULT_4XX
      ResponseParameters:
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"

  GatewayResponseDefault5XX:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResponseType: DEFAULT_5XX
      ResponseParameters:
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"

  KittenModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ContentType: application/json
      Name: KittenModel
      Description: Schema validation for Kitten input payload
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: Kitten
        type: object
        required:
          - name
          - color
        properties:
          name:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
          color:
            type: string
            minLength: 1

  ApiValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: KittenRequestValidator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt KittenApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten

  KittenItemResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !Ref KittenResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  KittenOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  KittenPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref ApiValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref KittenModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem"
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            #set($input = $input.path('$'))
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Item": {
                "KittenId": {
                  "S": "$context.requestId"
                },
                "name": {
                  "S": "$input.name"
                },
                "color": {
                  "S": "$input.color"
                }
              }
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: !Sub |
                {
                  "KittenId": "$context.requestId",
                  "message": "Kitten created successfully"
                }
          - SelectionPattern: "4\\d{2}"
            StatusCode: 400
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - SelectionPattern: "5\\d{2}"
            StatusCode: 500
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: 400
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: 500
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

    Properties:

      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/Scan"
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:

              "TableName": "${KittenTable}"

        IntegrationResponses:

            ResponseParameters:

            ResponseTemplates:

                    "KittenId": "$elem.KittenId.S",

                    "color": "$elem.color.S"

                #end
                ]
          - SelectionPattern: "4\\d{2}"
            StatusCode: 400
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - SelectionPattern: "5\\d{2}"
            StatusCode: 500
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'

              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"

            ResponseTemplates:

Description: Production-ready template creating a Step Functions state machine with a version and alias, triggered by API Gateway, EventBridge rules, and EventBridge Scheduler.

Resources:

  # IAM Roles
  # =========================================================================
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sfn-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-apigw-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAliasExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${AWS::StackName}-StateMachine:live'

  TerminatedRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-terminated-rule-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAliasExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${AWS::StackName}-StateMachine:live'

  ScheduledRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-scheduled-rule-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAliasExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${AWS::StackName}-StateMachine:live'

  TagRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tag-rule-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAliasExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${AWS::StackName}-StateMachine:live'

  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-scheduler-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAliasExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${AWS::StackName}-StateMachine:live'

  # =========================================================================
  # Step Functions State Machine, Version, and Alias
  # =========================================================================
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StateMachine'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "State machine with a single pass state returning 1",
          "StartAt": "ReturnOne",
          "States": {
            "ReturnOne": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": 1,
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: live
      Description: Live alias pointing to current version
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100

  # =========================================================================
  # API Gateway REST API Trigger
  # =========================================================================
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: API to start execution of the state machine alias
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiExecutionResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  ApiGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiExecutionResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: prod

  # =========================================================================
  # EventBridge Rule 1: Terminated State Changes
  # =========================================================================
  TerminatedStateRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-terminated-rule'
      Description: Triggers state machine alias on terminated state changes
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.states
        detail-type:
          - Step Functions Execution Status Change
        detail:
          status:
            - FAILED
            - TIMED_OUT
            - ABORTED
      Targets:
        - Id: SfnAliasTargetTerminated
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TerminatedRuleRole.Arn

  # =========================================================================
  # EventBridge Rule 2: Scheduled Rule (Every Minute, Disabled)
  # =========================================================================
  ScheduledEveryMinuteRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-scheduled-minute-rule'
      Description: Scheduled rule that runs every minute but is initially disabled
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: SfnAliasTargetScheduled
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt ScheduledRuleRole.Arn

  # =========================================================================
  # EventBridge Rule 3: AWS Tag Service Events
  # =========================================================================
  TagChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tag-change-rule'
      Description: Responds to tag events from AWS Tag service
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
        detail-type:
          - Tag Change on Resource
      Targets:
        - Id: SfnAliasTargetTag
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TagRuleRole.Arn

  # =========================================================================
  # EventBridge Scheduler Schedule (Every Minute, Flexible Window Disabled)
  # =========================================================================
  SchedulerMinuteSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-minute-schedule'
      Description: Runs every minute with flexible time window disabled
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: 'OFF'
      State: ENABLED
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions State Machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the State Machine Alias
    Value: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  ApiEndpointUrl:
    Description: GET URL to trigger the Step Functions State Machine
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/execute'

  SchedulerScheduleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Scheduler Schedule
    Value: !GetAtt SchedulerMinuteSchedule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready VPC with public and private subnets across two AZs, NAT Gateways, VPC Flow Logs, S3 Gateway Endpoint, and ECR Interface Endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block.

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block.

  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period in days for VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch.
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    Description: The type of traffic to capture in VPC Flow Logs.
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eip-natgw1'

  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eip-natgw2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-natgw-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-natgw-2'

  RouteTablePublic:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  RoutePublicDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTablePublic
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  RouteTableAssociationPublic1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTablePublic

  RouteTableAssociationPublic2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTablePublic

  RouteTablePrivate1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  RoutePrivate1Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTablePrivate1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  RouteTableAssociationPrivate1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTablePrivate1

  RouteTablePrivate2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  RoutePrivate2Default:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTablePrivate2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  RouteTableAssociationPrivate2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTablePrivate2

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-log'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref RouteTablePublic
        - !Ref RouteTablePrivate1
        - !Ref RouteTablePrivate2

  EndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints allowing outbound HTTPS to VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
          Description: Allow inbound HTTPS from within VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoints-sg'

  ECRAPIEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup

  ECRDKREndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
