AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for VPC infrastructure with KerberosEMRonEKS prefix, public and private subnets across 2 AZs, NAT Gateways, KMS-encrypted VPC Flow Logs, and VPC interface endpoints for SSM, SSM Messages, EC2 Messages, and Secrets Manager.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name prefix for resources

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-vpc-${EnvironmentName}

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-igw-${EnvironmentName}

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-public-subnet-1-${EnvironmentName}

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-public-subnet-2-${EnvironmentName}

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.128/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-private-subnet-1-${EnvironmentName}

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.192/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-private-subnet-2-${EnvironmentName}

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-eip-nat1-${EnvironmentName}

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-eip-nat2-${EnvironmentName}

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-nat1-${EnvironmentName}

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-nat2-${EnvironmentName}

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-public-rt-${EnvironmentName}

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-private-rt-1-${EnvironmentName}

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-private-rt-2-${EnvironmentName}

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-logs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/KerberosEMRonEKS*

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/KerberosEMRonEKS-flowlogs-${EnvironmentName}
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/KerberosEMRonEKS-${EnvironmentName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogsRole-${EnvironmentName}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-flow-log-${EnvironmentName}

  EndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints restricting to HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
          Description: Restrict outbound to HTTPS within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-endpoints-sg-${EnvironmentName}

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-vpce-ssm-${EnvironmentName}

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-vpce-ssmmessages-${EnvironmentName}

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-vpce-ec2messages-${EnvironmentName}

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub KerberosEMRonEKS-vpce-secretsmanager-${EnvironmentName}

Outputs:

    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VpcId

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 1 ID
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 2 ID
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2

  EndpointsSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID for VPC Endpoints
    Value: !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup

  FlowLogsLogGroupArn:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group ARN for VPC Flow Logs

Description: CloudFormation template to deploy an Amazon SageMaker Domain in VPC Only mode with a dedicated execution role and test user profile.

    Description: Name for the SageMaker Domain.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'

  TestUserName:

  DefaultS3BucketArn:

                  - sagemaker:UpdateContext

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template defining saved CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for Claude Code metrics analysis, monitoring, and cost attribution.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Log Group containing Claude Code metrics.

Resources:
  QueryRealTimeTokenAndRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/01-TokenAndRequestRatePerUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens
        | stats count(*) as requestCount, sum(inputTokens) as totalInputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as totalOutputTokens, sum(totalTokens) as aggregateTokens by userId, bin(5m)
        | sort aggregateTokens desc

  QueryRealTimeTpmRpmAverages:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/02-CurrentTpmRpmAverages
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, totalTokens
        | stats count(*) as requestsPerMinute, sum(totalTokens) as tokensPerMinute by bin(1m)
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 60

  QueryRealTimeRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RealTime/03-RateLimitRiskDetection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, modelId, rateLimitRemaining, rateLimitLimit, status, errorCode
        | filter ispresent(rateLimitRemaining) or status = 429 or errorCode like /(?i)throttling|rate.*limit/
        | stats count(*) as throttleEvents, min(rateLimitRemaining) as lowestRemainingCapacity by userId, modelId, bin(1m)
        | sort throttleEvents desc, lowestRemainingCapacity asc

  QuerySessionLevelUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/04-SessionLevelUsageSummary
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields sessionId, userId, totalTokens, cost, durationMs
        | stats count(*) as turnCount, sum(totalTokens) as sessionTokens, sum(cost) as sessionCost, min(@timestamp) as sessionStart, max(@timestamp) as sessionEnd, (max(@timestamp) - min(@timestamp)) / 1000 as sessionDurationSec by sessionId, userId
        | sort sessionCost desc

  QueryHourlyActivityTimeline:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/05-HourlyActivityTimeline
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, totalTokens, cost
        | stats count(*) as totalInvocations, count_distinct(userId) as activeUsers, count_distinct(sessionId) as activeSessions, sum(totalTokens) as tokensConsumed, sum(cost) as estimatedCost by bin(1h)
        | sort @timestamp desc

  QueryErrorAndThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/06-ErrorAndThrottlingDetection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, errorCode, errorMessage, status
        | filter status >= 400 or ispresent(errorCode) or ispresent(errorMessage)
        | stats count(*) as errorCount by coalesce(errorCode, status, 'UnknownError') as failureReason, userId, bin(5m)
        | sort errorCount desc

  QueryCostAttributionByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/CostReporting/07-CostAttributionByUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields userId, cost, inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens
        | stats count(*) as totalRequests, sum(inputTokens) as aggregateInputTokens, sum(outputTokens) as aggregateOutputTokens, sum(totalTokens) as aggregateTokens, sum(cost) as totalCostUSD by userId
        | sort totalCostUSD desc

  QueryCostAttributionByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/CostReporting/08-CostAttributionByModel
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields modelId, cost, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens
        | stats count(*) as totalInvocations, sum(inputTokens) as promptTokens, sum(outputTokens) as completionTokens, sum(cacheReadTokens) as cacheReads, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as cacheCreations, sum(cost) as totalExpenditureUSD by modelId
        | sort totalExpenditureUSD desc

  QueryCostAttributionByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/CostReporting/09-CostAttributionByOrganization
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields organizationId, department, team, cost, totalTokens
        | stats count(*) as invocationCount, count_distinct(userId) as userCount, sum(totalTokens) as tokenUsage, sum(cost) as departmentCostUSD by coalesce(organizationId, department, team, 'DefaultOrg') as orgIdentifier
        | sort departmentCostUSD desc

  QueryModelEfficiencyAndLatency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Debugging/10-ModelEfficiencyAndLatency
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields modelId, latencyMs, durationMs, outputTokens
        | stats count(*) as sampleSize, avg(coalesce(latencyMs, durationMs)) as avgLatencyMs, pct(coalesce(latencyMs, durationMs), 50) as p50LatencyMs, pct(coalesce(latencyMs, durationMs), 90) as p90LatencyMs, pct(coalesce(latencyMs, durationMs), 99) as p99LatencyMs, avg(outputTokens / (coalesce(latencyMs, durationMs) / 1000)) as avgTokensPerSec by modelId
        | sort sampleSize desc

  QueryCacheHitMissRatesOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Debugging/11-CacheHitMissRatesOverall
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens, inputTokens
        | stats count(*) as totalRequests, sum(cacheReadTokens) as totalCacheReadTokens, sum(cacheCreationTokens) as totalCacheWriteTokens, sum(inputTokens) as totalInputTokens, (sum(cacheReadTokens) / (sum(cacheReadTokens) + sum(inputTokens))) * 100 as overallCacheHitPct
        | sort totalRequests desc

  QueryCacheHitRatesOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Debugging/12-CacheHitRatesOverTime
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, cacheReadTokens, inputTokens
        | stats sum(cacheReadTokens) as cachedTokens, sum(inputTokens) as baseInputTokens, (sum(cacheReadTokens) / (sum(cacheReadTokens) + sum(inputTokens))) * 100 as cacheHitPercentage by bin(1h)
        | sort @timestamp desc

  QueryCacheHitRatesBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Debugging/13-CacheHitRatesBySession
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields sessionId, userId, cacheReadTokens, inputTokens, cost
        | stats count(*) as requests, sum(cacheReadTokens) as cachedTokens, sum(inputTokens) as uncachedInputTokens, (sum(cacheReadTokens) / (sum(cacheReadTokens) + sum(inputTokens))) * 100 as sessionCacheHitRatio, sum(cost) as totalCost by sessionId, userId
        | sort sessionCacheHitRatio asc, requests desc

  QueryPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Debugging/14-PeakUsageWindows
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, totalTokens, cost
        | stats count(*) as requestVolume, sum(totalTokens) as tokenVolume, sum(cost) as windowCost by bin(15m)
        | sort tokenVolume desc
        | limit 25

  QuerySpecificSessionDeepDive:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Debugging/15-SpecificSessionDeepDive
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, sessionId, userId, modelId, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, durationMs, cost, status, errorCode
        | filter ispresent(sessionId)
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 200

  QueryMetricFieldExplorer:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/Debugging/16-MetricFieldExplorer
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | limit 20

  QueryDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/CostReporting/17-DailyUsageSummary
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, totalTokens, cost, userId, sessionId
        | stats count(*) as totalInvocations, count_distinct(userId) as uniqueActiveUsers, count_distinct(sessionId) as totalSessions, sum(totalTokens) as dailyTokenVolume, sum(cost) as dailySpendUSD by bin(1d)
        | sort @timestamp desc

  QueryLongRunningSessionsAnalysis:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/UserAnalytics/18-LongRunningSessionsAnalysis
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields sessionId, userId, @timestamp
        | stats min(@timestamp) as sessionStart, max(@timestamp) as sessionEnd, (max(@timestamp) - min(@timestamp)) / 60000 as sessionDurationMinutes, count(*) as interactionCount by sessionId, userId
        | filter sessionDurationMinutes > 30
        | sort sessionDurationMinutes desc

  QueryHighCostOutlierRequests:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/CostReporting/19-HighCostOutlierRequests
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userId, sessionId, modelId, inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, cost, durationMs
        | sort cost desc
        | limit 100

Outputs:
  LogGroupNameOutput:
    Description: Targeted CloudWatch Log Group for Claude Code metrics queries.
    Value: !Ref LogGroupName

  TokenAndRequestRatePerUserQueryId:
    Description: Query definition ID for Real-Time Token and Request Rate Per User.
    Value: !Ref QueryRealTimeTokenAndRequestRatePerUser

  CostAttributionByUserQueryId:
    Description: Query definition ID for Cost Attribution By User.
    Value: !Ref QueryCostAttributionByUser

  DailyUsageSummaryQueryId:
    Description: Query definition ID for Daily Usage Summary.
    Value: !Ref QueryDailyUsageSummary

  CacheHitMissRatesOverallQueryId:
    Description: Query definition ID for Cache Hit/Miss Rates Overall.
    Value: !Ref QueryCacheHitMissRatesOverall

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for SuperCoolAPI AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB integration, IAM auth, and full CloudWatch logging.

Resources:
  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SuperCoolAPI-CloudWatchLogsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs

  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SuperCoolAPI-DynamoDBRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBTableAndIndexAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
                  - !Sub '${Table1.Arn}/*'

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Mutation {
          addTodo(description: String!): Todo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  DynamoDBDataSource1:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSourceRefApproach
      Description: DynamoDB data source using Ref intrinsic function for table and AWS::Region pseudo-parameter
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  DynamoDBDataSource2:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSourceArnSplitApproach
      Description: DynamoDB data source parsing table name and region from DynamoDB Table Arn
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Select [1, !Split ['table/', !GetAtt Table1.Arn]]
        AwsRegion: !Select [3, !Split [':', !GetAtt Table1.Arn]]

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The ID of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GraphQLApiId'

  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: The ARN of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GraphQLApiArn'

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: The Endpoint URL of the AppSync GraphQL API

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready CloudFormation template creating a shared VPC for EMR on EKS and Celeborn shuffle service, with public/private subnets across two AZs, NAT Gateways, VPC Endpoints, KMS-encrypted VPC Flow Logs, and complete route tables.

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range in the form x.x.x.x/x.

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range in the form x.x.x.x/x.

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range in the form x.x.x.x/x.

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1 (sized for EKS/Celeborn pods)
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range in the form x.x.x.x/x.

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.14.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2 (sized for EKS/Celeborn pods)
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range in the form x.x.x.x/x.

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: First Availability Zone for subnets (leave blank to use the region's first AZ)
    Default: ''

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Description: Second Availability Zone for subnets (leave blank to use the region's second AZ)
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  UseCustomAZ1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AvailabilityZone1, '']]
  UseCustomAZ2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AvailabilityZone2, '']]

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # KMS Key and CloudWatch Logs for VPC Flow Logs
  # =========================================================================
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Dedicated KMS Customer Managed Key for VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch Log Group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs-${AWS::StackName}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key"

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flow-logs-${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs"

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  # =========================================================================
  # VPC and Flow Log
  # =========================================================================
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-log"

  # =========================================================================
  # Internet Gateway
  # =========================================================================
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # =========================================================================
  # Subnets
  # =========================================================================
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseCustomAZ1, !Ref AvailabilityZone1, !Select [0, !GetAZs '']]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: subnet-type
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseCustomAZ2, !Ref AvailabilityZone2, !Select [1, !GetAZs '']]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: subnet-type
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseCustomAZ1, !Ref AvailabilityZone1, !Select [0, !GetAZs '']]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: subnet-type
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !If [UseCustomAZ2, !Ref AvailabilityZone2, !Select [1, !GetAZs '']]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: subnet-type
          Value: private

  # =========================================================================
  # NAT Gateways & Elastic IPs
  # =========================================================================
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az1"

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az2"

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-az1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-az2"

  # =========================================================================
  # Route Tables and Routes
  # =========================================================================
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az1"

  PrivateDefaultRouteAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az2"

  PrivateDefaultRouteAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # =========================================================================
  # S3 Gateway Endpoint
  # =========================================================================
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # =========================================================================
  # Interface VPC Endpoints Security Group
  # =========================================================================
  EndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints allowing HTTPS inbound from VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
          Description: Allow HTTPS inbound from VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-endpoints-sg"

  # =========================================================================
  # Interface VPC Endpoints
  # =========================================================================
  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ssm-endpoint"

  Ec2Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ec2-endpoint"

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-logs-endpoint"

  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-monitoring-endpoint"

  StsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sts-endpoint"

  EmrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-elasticmapreduce-endpoint"

      VpcId: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 VPC across three Availability Zones with optional public subnets and mandatory private subnets.

Parameters:
  VpcIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Description: Identifier prefix for VPC resources and naming.
    Default: my-vpc
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: The IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-4]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /24.

  EnablePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Description: Specify whether to create public subnets, an Internet Gateway, and a public route table.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

Conditions:
  CreatePublicSubnetsCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnablePublicSubnets, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-vpc'

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicDefaultRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-public-subnet-2'

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-public-subnet-3'

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-private-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcIdentifier}-private-subnet-3'

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Description: The Amazon-provided IPv6 CIDR block assigned to the VPC
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks]

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: List of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: List of public subnet IDs
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetsCondition
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
        - !Ref PublicSubnet3

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience with public and private subnets, configurable NAT Gateway, and VPC Flow Logs.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Description: An environment name that will be prefixed to resource names and exports.
    Type: String
    Default: production

  VpcCIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24

  PublicSubnet3CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 3 in Availability Zone 3.
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.103.0/24

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24

  PrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 3 in Availability Zone 3.
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24

  NatGatewayStrategy:
    Description: Select NAT Gateway strategy. Single (cost-effective single NAT in AZ1) or MultiAZ (high availability one per AZ).
    Type: String
    Default: Single
    AllowedValues:
      - Single
      - MultiAZ

Conditions:
  IsMultiAZNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayStrategy, 'MultiAZ']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-route-table
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsMultiAZNat
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsMultiAZNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsMultiAZNat
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsMultiAZNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsMultiAZNat, !Ref NatGateway2, !Ref NatGateway1]

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsMultiAZNat, !Ref NatGateway3, !Ref NatGateway1]

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  VpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-${VPC}
      RetentionInDays: 7

  VpcFlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VPC-ID

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1-ID

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2-ID

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet3-ID

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of Public Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet-IDs

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1-ID

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2-ID

  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet3-ID

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of Private Subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet-IDs

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: Primary NAT Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1-ID

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: Secondary NAT Gateway ID (AZ2)
    Condition: IsMultiAZNat
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2-ID

  NatGateway3Id:
    Description: Tertiary NAT Gateway ID (AZ3)
    Condition: IsMultiAZNat
    Value: !Ref NatGateway3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway3-ID

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Production-ready isolated private VPC for an AI-powered customer support application with Bedrock, ECR, KMS-encrypted VPC Flow Logs, and VPC Endpoints.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-support-prod
    Description: Environment name prefix for all provisioned resources.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the isolated VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2.

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 3.

  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: Retention period in days for VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs.
    AllowedValues: [30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 730, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS customer-managed key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: flow-logs-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-key
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-group
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPublishPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-flow-log
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      SecurityGroupEgress: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Bedrock Agent Runtime
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      SecurityGroupEgress: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-agent-runtime-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  McpRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Model Context Protocol (MCP) Runtime
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      SecurityGroupEgress: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-mcp-runtime-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for application Lambda functions
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      SecurityGroupEgress: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-lambda-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpceIngressFromAgent:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
