AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a highly available, multi-AZ VPC designed for Amazon EKS with dedicated public and private subnets, NAT Gateways, route tables, and security groups.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-vpc-network
    Description: Name prefix used to tag and identify resources created by this stack.

  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: The IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 1 located in AZ 1.

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 2 located in AZ 2.

  PublicSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Public Subnet 3 located in AZ 3.

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 1 located in AZ 1.

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.12.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 2 located in AZ 2.

  PrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.13.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for Private Subnet 3 located in AZ 3.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  # Public Route Table and Routes
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateways and Elastic IPs (Per AZ)
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az2'

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az3'

  NatGatewayAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-az1'

  NatGatewayAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-az2'

  NatGatewayAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-az3'

  # Private Route Tables and Routes (Per AZ)
  PrivateRouteTableAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-az1'

  PrivateDefaultRouteAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAZ1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ1

  PrivateRouteTableAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-az2'

  PrivateDefaultRouteAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAZ2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ2

  PrivateRouteTableAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-az3'

  PrivateDefaultRouteAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAZ3

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ3

  # Security Group for EKS Control Plane and Worker Communication
  EKSClusterSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EKS control plane to communicate with worker nodes
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-eks-cluster-sg'

  EKSClusterSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EKSClusterSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref EKSClusterSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      Description: Allow all intra-cluster communication within the security group

  # Security Group for Ingress / Service Mesh Gateway exposed to internet
  IngressGatewaySecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: 'AWS::LanguageExtensions'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template to create an IAM execution role for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated with Amazon EKS.

Parameters:
  ResourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix to apply to resource names created by this template.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 50
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, and underscores.

  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Amazon EKS cluster integrated with SageMaker HyperPod.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 100

  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: The VPC ID where the SageMaker HyperPod and EKS cluster reside.

  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id>
    Description: List of Security Group IDs associated with the SageMaker HyperPod cluster.

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of Private Subnet IDs associated with the SageMaker HyperPod cluster.

  LifecycleScriptsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket name containing lifecycle scripts for HyperPod cluster initialization.

  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Flag to indicate whether to create RIG (Resource Isolation Group) policies.

  RigInputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 bucket name for RIG input data (optional).

  RigOutputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 bucket name for RIG output data (optional).

  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Flag to enable gated access for RIG resources.

Conditions:
  CreateRigPolicy: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigInputBucketName, '']]
  EnableGatedAccessCondition: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  HasSeparateRigOutputBucket: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputBucketName, '']]

Resources:
  HyperPodExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}ExecRole'
      Description: IAM execution role for SageMaker HyperPod cluster with EKS integration.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-EksCniPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-EniAndHyperPodManagementPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${VpcId}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EKSClusterName}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: sagemaker:hyperpod-prerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}ExecRole'

  RigCustomPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRigPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-RigPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputBucketName}'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputBucketName}/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*'
          - !If
            - EnableGatedAccessCondition
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*sagemaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*sagemaker*/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*SageMaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*SageMaker*/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - EnableGatedAccessCondition
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - sqs:SendMessage
                - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                - sqs:DeleteMessage
                - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                - sqs:GetQueueUrl
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - HasSeparateRigOutputBucket
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:ListBucket
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputBucketName}'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - HasSeparateRigOutputBucket
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputBucketName}/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  Fn::ForEach::SubnetPolicies:
    - SubnetId
    - !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
    - 'SubnetPolicy${SubnetId}':
        Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
        Properties:
          PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-subnet-${SubnetId}-policy'
          Roles:
            - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${SubnetId}'

  Fn::ForEach::SecurityGroupPolicies:
    - SecurityGroupId
    - !Ref SecurityGroupIds
    - 'SecurityGroupPolicy${SecurityGroupId}':
        Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
        Properties:
          PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-sg-${SecurityGroupId}-policy'
          Roles:
            - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/${SecurityGroupId}'

Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the IAM execution role for SageMaker HyperPod cluster.
    Value: !Ref HyperPodExecRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RoleName'

  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM execution role for SageMaker HyperPod cluster.
    Value: !GetAtt HyperPodExecRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RoleArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to deploy three private subnets across us-east-1a, us-east-1b, and us-east-1c with individual route tables, NAT Gateway routes, Network ACL associations, an S3 VPC endpoint, and dynamic exports.

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: The ID of the target VPC where the subnets and resources will be created.

  NatGatewayIdA:
    Type: String
    Description: The ID of the NAT Gateway for Availability Zone us-east-1a (e.g., nat-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx).
    AllowedPattern: ^nat-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid NAT Gateway ID in the format nat- followed by 8 or 17 hexadecimal characters.

  NatGatewayIdB:
    Type: String
    Description: The ID of the NAT Gateway for Availability Zone us-east-1b (e.g., nat-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx).
    AllowedPattern: ^nat-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid NAT Gateway ID in the format nat- followed by 8 or 17 hexadecimal characters.

  NatGatewayIdC:
    Type: String
    Description: The ID of the NAT Gateway for Availability Zone us-east-1c (e.g., nat-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx).
    AllowedPattern: ^nat-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid NAT Gateway ID in the format nat- followed by 8 or 17 hexadecimal characters.

  NetworkAclId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl::Id
    Description: The ID of the Network ACL to associate with all three private subnets.

Resources:
  # Subnets
  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.24.24.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1a
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.24.25.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1b
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PrivateSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.24.26.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1c
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Route Tables
  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  PrivateRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Default Routes to NAT Gateways
  DefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayIdA

  DefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayIdB

  DefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayIdC

  # Subnet Route Table Associations
  SubnetRouteTableAssociationA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA

  SubnetRouteTableAssociationB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  SubnetRouteTableAssociationC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableC

  # Subnet Network ACL Associations
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociationA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId

  SubnetNetworkAclAssociationB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId

  SubnetNetworkAclAssociationC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId

  # S3 VPC Endpoint
  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: FullAccessToS3
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'

Outputs:
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of the created private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

  PrivateRouteTableIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of the created private route table IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableIds'

  SubnetGroupCidr:
    Description: Subnet group CIDR covering the private subnets.
    Value: 10.24.24.0/21
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-SubnetGroupCIDR'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Baseline IAM groups, roles, instance profiles, and managed policies for AWS operational personas.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # Managed Policies
  # ============================================================================
  SystemAdminManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: SystemAdminPolicy
      Description: Near-full access outside IAM with guardrails for MFA, Billing, and KMS logging keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAllActionsOutsideIAM
            Effect: Allow
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyIAMManagement
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - iam:*
              - organizations:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAndActions
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - ce:*
              - cur:*
              - tax:*
              - purchase-orders:*
              - account:GetAccountInformation
              - account:GetContactInformation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLikeIfExists:
                kms:ResourceAliases:
                  - alias/*logging*
                  - alias/*cloudtrail*
                  - alias/*audit*
                  - alias/*logs*

  IAMAdminManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: IAMAdminPolicy
      Description: Full IAM access with guardrails for MFA, Billing, and KMS logging keys.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowIAMAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:*
              - access-analyzer:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAndActions
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - ce:*
              - cur:*
              - tax:*
              - purchase-orders:*
              - account:GetAccountInformation
              - account:GetContactInformation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLikeIfExists:
                kms:ResourceAliases:
                  - alias/*logging*
                  - alias/*cloudtrail*
                  - alias/*audit*
                  - alias/*logs*

  InstanceOpsManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: InstanceOperationsPolicy
      Description: Instance operations limited to EC2, ELB, CloudWatch, and Auto Scaling with VPC modification deny.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowInstanceOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - cloudwatch:*
              - logs:*
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyVpcNetworkingModifications
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:ModifyVpc*
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:ModifySubnet*
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateVpn*
              - ec2:DeleteVpn*
              - ec2:AttachVpn*
              - ec2:DetachVpn*
              - ec2:CreateCustomerGateway
              - ec2:DeleteCustomerGateway
              - ec2:CreateVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:AcceptVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:CreateTransitGateway*
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGateway*
              - ec2:ModifyTransitGateway*
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAndActions
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - ce:*
              - cur:*
              - tax:*
              - purchase-orders:*
              - account:GetAccountInformation
              - account:GetContactInformation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLikeIfExists:
                kms:ResourceAliases:
                  - alias/*logging*
                  - alias/*cloudtrail*
                  - alias/*audit*
                  - alias/*logs*

  ReadOnlyAdminManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ReadOnlyAdminPolicy
      Description: Broad read-only administrator access across core services with MFA and guardrails.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCoreReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:Get*
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:Get*
              - cloudwatch:List*
              - logs:Describe*
              - logs:Get*
              - logs:FilterLogEvents
              - s3:Get*
              - s3:List*
              - rds:Describe*
              - rds:ListTagsForResource
              - lambda:Get*
              - lambda:List*
              - dynamodb:Describe*
              - dynamodb:List*
              - sqs:Get*
              - sqs:List*
              - sns:Get*
              - sns:List*
              - config:Get*
              - config:Describe*
              - config:List*
              - cloudtrail:Describe*
              - cloudtrail:Get*
              - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:List*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsoleAndActions
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - ce:*
              - cur:*
              - tax:*
              - purchase-orders:*
              - account:GetAccountInformation
              - account:GetContactInformation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLikeIfExists:
                kms:ResourceAliases:
                  - alias/*logging*
                  - alias/*cloudtrail*
                  - alias/*audit*
                  - alias/*logs*

  BillingReadOnlyManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BillingReadOnlyPolicy
      Description: Read-only access to billing and cost management consoles and data.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBillingReadOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - aws-portal:View*
              - billing:Get*
              - billing:List*
              - ce:Get*
              - ce:Describe*
              - cur:Describe*
              - purchase-orders:View*
              - tax:Get*
              - account:GetAccountInformation
              - account:GetContactInformation
            Resource: '*'

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Groups
  # ============================================================================
  SystemAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdminManagedPolicy

  IAMAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: IAMAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdminManagedPolicy

  InstanceOpsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: InstanceOperations
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsManagedPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: ReadOnlyAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminManagedPolicy

  BillingReadOnlyGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: BillingReadOnly
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BillingReadOnlyManagedPolicy

  # ============================================================================
  # EC2 Assumable Roles and Instance Profiles
  # ============================================================================
  SystemAdminEC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SystemAdminEC2Role
      Description: EC2-assumable role for system administration.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdminManagedPolicy

  SystemAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: SystemAdminInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref SystemAdminEC2Role

  IAMAdminEC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: IAMAdminEC2Role
      Description: EC2-assumable role for IAM administration.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdminManagedPolicy

  IAMAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: IAMAdminInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMAdminEC2Role

  InstanceOpsEC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: InstanceOpsEC2Role
      Description: EC2-assumable role for instance operations.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsManagedPolicy

  InstanceOpsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: InstanceOpsInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsEC2Role

  ReadOnlyAdminEC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ReadOnlyAdminEC2Role
      Description: EC2-assumable role for read-only administration.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminManagedPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: ReadOnlyAdminInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminEC2Role

Outputs:
  SystemAdminGroupId:
    Description: The ID/Name of the System Administrator IAM Group
    Value: !Ref SystemAdminGroup

  IAMAdminGroupId:
    Description: The ID/Name of the IAM Administrator IAM Group
    Value: !Ref IAMAdminGroup

  InstanceOpsGroupId:
    Description: The ID/Name of the Instance Operations IAM Group
    Value: !Ref InstanceOpsGroup

  ReadOnlyAdminGroupId:
    Description: The ID/Name of the Read-Only Administrator IAM Group
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyAdminGroup

  BillingReadOnlyGroupId:
    Description: The ID/Name of the Billing Read-Only IAM Group
    Value: !Ref BillingReadOnlyGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for shared IAM roles, instance profiles, and SSM parameters for Amazon EKS Quick Start.

Parameters:
  RolePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-quickstart
    Description: Prefix to apply to all IAM role names.

Resources:
  # EKS Control Plane Role
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-control-plane-role'
      Description: EKS Control Plane Role for EKS Quick Start
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2DescribePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'

  # EKS Fargate Pod Execution Role
  EKSFargatePodExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-fargate-execution-role'
      Description: EKS Fargate Pod Execution Role for EKS Quick Start
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy

  # Managed Node Instance Role
  ManagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-managed-node-role'
      Description: IAM role for EKS managed node groups
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-managed-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeInstanceRole

  # Unmanaged Node Instance Role
  UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-unmanaged-node-role'
      Description: IAM role for EKS self-managed / unmanaged nodes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-unmanaged-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole

  # Role Creation Role (for creating fixed-name IAM role CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC)
  RoleCreationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-role-creation-role'
      Description: Role allowing Lambda to create and manage the CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageKubernetesVPCRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Lambda Role: Copy S3 Artifacts
  CopyZipsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-copy-zips-role'
      Description: Lambda execution role for copying zip artifacts from S3
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3CopyPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'

  # Lambda Role: Read Resources (with read-only access across the account)
  ReadResourcesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-read-resources-role'
      Description: Lambda execution role for reading resources across the account
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess

  # Lambda Role: Delete Bucket Contents
  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-delete-bucket-contents-role'
      Description: Lambda execution role for emptying S3 buckets
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BucketCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: '*'

  # Lambda Role: Clean Up Load Balancers
  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-cleanup-lb-role'
      Description: Lambda execution role for cleaning up load balancers created by Kubernetes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLoadBalancersPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'

  # Lambda Role: Clean Up Security Group Dependencies
  CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-cleanup-sg-role'
      Description: Lambda execution role for cleaning up security group dependencies
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupSecurityGroupsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'

  # Lambda Role: Clean Up Lambda Functions
  CleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-cleanup-lambda-role'
      Description: Lambda execution role for cleaning up Lambda functions
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - lambda:ListFunctions

  # Lambda Role: Resolve Caller ARNs

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a lab VPC with web and application subnets, shared route table, web security group, S3 gateway endpoint, and Kinesis interface endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  WebSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Web Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  WebSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Web Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  AppSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Application Subnet 1 in Availability Zone 1.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  AppSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for Application Subnet 2 in Availability Zone 2.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block between /16 and /28.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lab-VPC

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lab-Web-Subnet-1

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lab-Web-Subnet-2

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lab-App-Subnet-1

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lab-App-Subnet-2

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lab-Shared-RouteTable

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web tier allowing inbound HTTPS from VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow inbound HTTPS from within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Lab-Web-SG

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: '*'

  KinesisStreamsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  KinesisFirehoseInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Shared per-account IAM roles and instance profiles for Amazon EKS clusters
  and CloudFormation custom resource Lambda handlers.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Common prefix for all IAM roles and instance profiles created by this stack.
    Default: eks-shared
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@\-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be alphanumeric or contain valid IAM name characters (+, =, ,, ., @, -, _).

  SsmParameterPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Base SSM parameter hierarchy path that custom resource handlers can read.
    Default: /eks/*

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # Custom Resource Lambda Execution Roles
  # =========================================================================

  S3AssetCopyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cr-s3-asset-copy'
      Description: Execution role for custom resource copying deployment assets between S3 buckets
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicExecutionAndLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: S3AssetCopyPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: '*'

  ResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cr-resource-reader'
      Description: Execution role for custom resource reading arbitrary AWS resources
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicExecutionAndLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: ResourceReaderPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                  - ssm:Describe*
                  - ssm:Get*
                  - kms:Describe*
                  - route53:Get*
                  - route53:List*
                Resource: '*'

  S3BucketCleanerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cr-s3-bucket-cleaner'
      Description: Execution role for custom resource deleting bucket contents prior to deletion
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicExecutionAndLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: S3BucketPurgePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: '*'

  OrphanedResourcesCleanerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cr-orphaned-resources-cleaner'
      Description: Execution role for cleaning up orphaned load balancers, security groups, and ENIs after cluster teardown
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicExecutionAndLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: OrphanedResourcesCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaCleanerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cr-lambda-cleaner'
      Description: Execution role for custom resource cleaning up leftover Lambda functions and log groups
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicExecutionAndLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: LambdaCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:ListVersionsByFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DeleteLogGroup
                Resource: '*'

  CallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cr-caller-identity'
      Description: Execution role for custom resource retrieving caller account and partition identity
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicExecutionAndLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'

  CloudFormationTypeRegistrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cr-cfn-type-registration'
      Description: Execution role for custom resource registering CloudFormation resource provider types
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicExecutionAndLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationRegistryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeRegistrations
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeVersions
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                Resource: '*'

  SsmParameterResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cr-ssm-parameter-resolver'
      Description: Execution role for custom resource resolving Systems Manager parameters under a configuration path
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicExecutionAndLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
        - PolicyName: SsmResolverPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${SsmParameterPathPrefix}'

  # =========================================================================
  # CloudFormation Service Role for VPC Provisioning
  # =========================================================================

  CloudFormationVpcProvisioningRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cfn-vpc-provisioner'
      Description: Role assumed by CloudFormation when provisioning cluster VPC resources
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVpc
                  - ec2:DeleteVpc
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateSubnet
                  - ec2:DeleteSubnet
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
                  - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:CreateNatGateway
                  - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
                  - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:AllocateAddress
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                Resource: '*'

  # =========================================================================
  # Amazon EKS Control Plane Role
  # =========================================================================

  EksClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cluster-role'
      Description: IAM role for the Amazon EKS cluster control plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController'

  # =========================================================================
  # Amazon EKS Fargate Profile Execution Role
  # =========================================================================

  EksFargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-fargate-profile-role'
      Description: IAM role assumed by Amazon EKS Fargate profiles
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'

  # =========================================================================
  # Amazon EKS Managed Node Group IAM Role & Instance Profile
  # =========================================================================

  EksManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-managed-node-role'

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  EksManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-managed-node-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref EksManagedNodeRole

  # =========================================================================
  # Amazon EKS Unmanaged / Self-Managed Node Group IAM Role & Instance Profile
  # =========================================================================

  EksUnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-role'
      Description: IAM role for Amazon EKS self-managed / unmanaged worker nodes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  EksUnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref EksUnmanagedNodeRole

  SESCredentialsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:

  SESCredentialsLambdaRole:

              VERSION = 0x04
