              signature = hmac.new(signature, SERVICE.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              signature = hmac.new(signature, MESSAGE.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              signature = hmac.new(signature, TERMINAL.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              signature = hmac.new(signature, bytes([VERSION]), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              return base64.b64encode(signature).decode('utf-8')

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})

              user_name = properties.get('IAMUserName')
              access_key_id = properties.get('AccessKeyId')
              secret_access_key = properties.get('SecretAccessKey')
              kms_key_arn = properties.get('KmsKeyArn')

              username_param = f"/ses/smtp/{user_name}/username"
              password_param = f"/ses/smtp/{user_name}/password"
              physical_id = f"ses-smtp-creds-{user_name}"

              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

              try:
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      smtp_password = calculate_smtp_password(secret_access_key)

                      # Store SMTP Username (same as AccessKeyId)
                      put_args_user = {
                          'Name': username_param,
                          'Description': f'SES SMTP Username for IAM user {user_name}',
                          'Value': access_key_id,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_key_arn:
                          put_args_user['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn
                      ssm.put_parameter(**put_args_user)

                      # Store SMTP Password
                      put_args_pass = {
                          'Name': password_param,
                          'Description': f'SES SMTP Password for IAM user {user_name}',
                          'Value': smtp_password,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True
                      }
                      if kms_key_arn:
                          put_args_pass['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn
                      ssm.put_parameter(**put_args_pass)

                      response_data = {
                          'SmtpUsernameParameter': username_param,
                          'SmtpPasswordParameter': password_param,
                          'SmtpUsername': access_key_id
                      }
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', response_data, physical_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          ssm.delete_parameters(Names=[username_param, password_param])
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.warning("Failed to delete SSM parameters: %s", str(e))
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)

Description: Production-ready CloudFormation template for a WebSocket API backed by a Python Lambda function for grant-processing status updates.

            Resource: '*'

          - Sid: AllowRelatedFunctionsDecryption

          import json

          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          table_name = os.environ.get('TABLE_NAME')
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get('requestContext', {})
              route_key = request_context.get('routeKey')
              connection_id = request_context.get('connectionId')
              domain_name = request_context.get('domainName')
              stage = request_context.get('stage')

              print(f"Route: {route_key}, ConnectionId: {connection_id}")

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  try:
                      table.put_item(Item={'connectionId': connection_id})
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}
                  except ClientError as e:
                      print(f"Error on connect: {e}")
                      return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': 'Failed to connect'}

              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  try:
                      table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}
                  except ClientError as e:
                      print(f"Error on disconnect: {e}")
                      return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': 'Failed to disconnect'}

              elif route_key == 'statusUpdate':
                  endpoint_url = f"https://{domain_name}/{stage}"
                  apigw_client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=endpoint_url)
                  body = event.get('body', '{}')
                  try:
                      body_json = json.loads(body) if isinstance(body, str) else body
                      grant_id = body_json.get('grantId', 'Unknown')
                      status = body_json.get('status', 'Processing')
                      message_payload = json.dumps({'grantId': grant_id, 'status': status}).encode('utf-8')
                  except Exception:
                      message_payload = json.dumps({'message': 'Invalid payload format'}).encode('utf-8')

                  try:
                      scan_response = table.scan(ProjectionExpression='connectionId')
                      for item in scan_response.get('Items', []):
                          target_conn = item['connectionId']
                          try:
                              apigw_client.post_to_connection(
                                  ConnectionId=target_conn,
                                  Data=message_payload
                              )
                          except apigw_client.exceptions.GoneException:
                              table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': target_conn})
                          except Exception as err:
                              print(f"Error sending to {target_conn}: {err}")
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Status update broadcasted'}
                  except ClientError as e:
                      print(f"Error reading connections: {e}")
                      return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': 'Failed to broadcast update'}

              elif route_key == '$default':
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Default route acknowledged'}

              return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Unknown route'}

  Subnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24

    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$

  Subnet2Cidr:

    Properties:

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

        - Key: Name

  RedisSecurityGroupIngressSubnet1:

      GroupId: !Ref RedisSecurityGroup

      FromPort: 6379
      ToPort: 6379

  RedisSecurityGroupIngressSubnet2:

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for ElastiCache Redis and SNS encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:

        Id: key-policy
        Statement:

            Action:

            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNS

            Principal:

            Action:

            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowElastiCacheService

            Principal:
              Service: elasticache.amazonaws.com
            Action:

              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant

              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-kms-key

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  RedisSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Subnet group for Redis test cluster across two AZs
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-redis-subnet-group

  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: Redis cluster mode enabled test environment
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: !Ref RedisEngineVersion
      CacheNodeType: !Ref RedisNodeType
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref RedisSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref RedisSecurityGroup
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      NumNodeGroups: 2
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: 1
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-redis-cluster

  ResilienceAlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-resilience-alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-resilience-alerts

  ResilienceAlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref ResilienceAlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref ResilienceAlertTopic

  SsmAutomationApprovalRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ssm-approval-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SsmAutomationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ssm-approval-role

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  Subnet1Id:
    Description: ID of Private Subnet 1
    Value: !Ref Subnet1

  Subnet2Id:
    Description: ID of Private Subnet 2
    Value: !Ref Subnet2

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  RedisReplicationGroupId:
    Description: ID of the Redis Replication Group
    Value: !Ref RedisReplicationGroup

  RedisConfigurationEndpointAddress:
    Description: Redis Cluster Configuration Endpoint Address
    Value: !GetAtt RedisReplicationGroup.ConfigurationEndpoint.Address

  RedisConfigurationEndpointPort:
    Description: Redis Cluster Configuration Endpoint Port

  SnsTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the encrypted SNS Topic for CloudWatch notifications
    Value: !Ref ResilienceAlertTopic

  SsmAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM Role for SSM Automation approval signals
    Value: !GetAtt SsmAutomationApprovalRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS AppSync GraphQL API for a simple songs service with IAM authorization, request tracing, and DynamoDB backend.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name for resource tagging and naming.

Resources:
  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'songs-${Environment}-${AWS::StackName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'appsync-songs-dynamodb-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBSongsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${SongsTable.Arn}/*'

  SongsGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'songs-api-${Environment}'
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true

  SongsGraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String!): Song
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  SongsDynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsDynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Type: NONE

  ValidateArtistFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: SongsGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidateArtist
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt NoneDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #if($util.isNullOrEmpty($ctx.args.artist) || !$ctx.args.artist.matches("^[a-zA-Z]+$"))
          $util.error("Validation error: artist is required and must contain only letters.", "ValidationError")
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.args)
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  CreateSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: SongsGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: CreateSongInDynamoDB
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($util.autoId())
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "name": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.name),
            "artist": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.artist)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Scan"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result.items)

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - SongsGraphQLSchema
      - ValidateArtistFunction
      - CreateSongFunction
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidateArtistFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt CreateSongFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson({})
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The ID of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: The endpoint URL for the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl

  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: The ARN of the AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.Arn

  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: The name of the Songs DynamoDB Table
    Value: !Ref SongsTable

  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: The ARN of the Songs DynamoDB Table
    Value: !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a Cognito-authenticated REST API with /me and /open endpoints backed by a Lambda function.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name for resource naming and deployment stage.

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-user-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-app-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-lambda-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  ApiBackendLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-api-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              path = event.get('path', '')
              request_context = event.get('requestContext', {})
              authorizer = request_context.get('authorizer', {})
              claims = authorizer.get('claims', {})
              
              response_body = {
                  "path": path,
                  "authenticated": bool(claims),
                  "claims": claims if claims else None,
                  "message": "Authenticated identity claims retrieved successfully" if claims else "Unauthenticated request processed successfully"
              }
              
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*"
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(response_body)
              }

  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rest-api
      Description: Regional REST API secured by Cognito User Pool
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiGatewayAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn

  ApiGatewayMeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  ApiGatewayMeMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayMeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiGatewayAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ApiBackendLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ApiGatewayOpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  ApiGatewayOpenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayOpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ApiBackendLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMeMethod
      - ApiGatewayOpenMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi

  ApiGatewayStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiGatewayDeployment
      StageName: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ApiBackendLambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGatewayRestApi}/*/*/*

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito App Client
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient

  ApiUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the deployed REST API

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Connects AWS Account to marbot.io monitoring and alerting service with EventBridge integration and cross-account access role.

Parameters:
  EndpointId:
    Type: String
    Description: marbot endpoint ID (e.g., from your marbot Slack or Microsoft Teams integration setup).
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid marbot endpoint identifier.

  MarbotAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '386249388811'
    Description: AWS Account ID of the marbot service.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS Account ID.

  EnableAutoMonitoring:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and EventBridge monitoring rules across your resources.

  EnableAccountAliases:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Allow marbot to enrich notifications with friendly AWS account aliases.

  EnableMetricGraphs:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Allow marbot to embed CloudWatch metric graphs into alert notifications.

  EnableCodePipelineApproval:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Allow marbot to approve or reject AWS CodePipeline manual approval actions directly from chat.

Conditions:
  HasAutoMonitoring: !Equals [!Ref EnableAutoMonitoring, 'true']
  HasAccountAliases: !Equals [!Ref EnableAccountAliases, 'true']
  HasMetricGraphs: !Equals [!Ref EnableMetricGraphs, 'true']
  HasCodePipelineApproval: !Equals [!Ref EnableCodePipelineApproval, 'true']

Resources:
  EventBridgeConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub marbot-connection-${EndpointId}
      Description: Connection to marbot.io endpoint
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: x-api-key
          ApiKeyValue: !Ref EndpointId

  EventBridgeApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub marbot-destination-${EndpointId}
      Description: API Destination for marbot.io
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeConnection.Arn
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoint/${EndpointId}
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 10

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub marbot-eventbridge-role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeMarbotApiDestination
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:InvokeApiDestination
                Resource: !GetAtt EventBridgeApiDestination.Arn

  KeepAliveScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub marbot-keepalive-${EndpointId}
      Description: Sends periodic heartbeat and stack identification to marbot every 30 days
      ScheduleExpression: rate(30 days)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MarbotApiDestinationTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt EventBridgeApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              awsAccountId: <aws.events.rule-arn>
              ruleName: <aws.events.rule-name>
            InputTemplate: !Sub >
              {
                "type": "heartbeat",
                "accountId": "${AWS::AccountId}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "stackId": "${AWS::StackId}",
                "endpointId": "${EndpointId}"
              }

  PermissionsBoundary:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: HasAutoMonitoring
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub marbot-permissions-boundary-${AWS::Region}
      Description: Permissions boundary restricting resources managed by marbot auto-monitoring
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowedMonitoringServices
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
              - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - events:PutRule
              - events:DeleteRule
              - events:DescribeRule
              - events:PutTargets
              - events:RemoveTargets
              - events:ListTargetsByRule
              - sns:CreateTopic
              - sns:DeleteTopic
              - sns:Subscribe
              - sns:Unsubscribe
              - sns:SetTopicAttributes
              - sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic
              - tag:GetResources
              - tag:TagResources
              - tag:UntagResources
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyPrivilegeEscalation
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - iam:*
            Resource: '*'

  MarbotCrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub marbot-role-${AWS::Region}
      Description: Cross-account role assumed by marbot.io to monitor resources and manage alerts
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${MarbotAccountId}:root
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Ref AWS::StackId
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - HasAutoMonitoring
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Policies:
        - !If
          - HasAutoMonitoring
          - PolicyName: AutoMonitoringPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: CloudWatchAlarmsManagement
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                    - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                    - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  Resource: '*'
                - Sid: EventBridgeRuleManagement
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - events:DescribeRule
                    - events:PutRule
                    - events:DeleteRule
                    - events:PutTargets
                    - events:RemoveTargets
                    - events:ListTargetsByRule
                  Resource: '*'
                - Sid: ResourceDiscovery
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - tag:GetResources
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasAccountAliases
          - PolicyName: AccountAliasesPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: ListAccountAliases
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - iam:ListAccountAliases
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasMetricGraphs
          - PolicyName: MetricGraphsPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: CloudWatchMetricData
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                    - cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasCodePipelineApproval
          - PolicyName: CodePipelineApprovalPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: CodePipelineApprovalActions
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                    - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  RegistrationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  RegistrationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub marbot-registration-${EndpointId}
      Description: Registers CloudFormation stack and AWS account with marbot.io
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.11
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt RegistrationLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error

          def send_cfn_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f"See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': response_data
              }).encode('utf-8')
              headers = {
                  'content-type': '',
                  'content-length': str(len(response_body))
              }
              req = urllib.request.Request(response_url, data=response_body, headers=headers, method='PUT')
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                      pass
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Failed sending CFN response: {e}")

          def handler(event, context):
              print(f"Received event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              endpoint_id = properties.get('EndpointId')
              api_url = f"https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoint/{endpoint_id}"

              payload = {
                  'requestType': request_type,
                  'stackId': event.get('StackId'),
                  'accountId': properties.get('AccountId'),
                  'region': properties.get('Region'),
                  'roleArn': properties.get('RoleArn'),
                  'externalId': properties.get('ExternalId')
              }
              data = json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8')
              headers = {
                  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                  'x-api-key': endpoint_id
              }
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(api_url, data=data, headers=headers, method='POST')
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                      print(f"Marbot registration response status: {resp.status}")
                  send_cfn_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Status': 'Registered'}, physical_resource_id=f"marbot-registration-{endpoint_id}")
              except Exception as err:
                  print(f"Error communicating with marbot API: {err}")
                  # On Delete, always report SUCCESS so stack can be cleanly removed
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      send_cfn_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'Status': 'Deleted'}, physical_resource_id=event.get('PhysicalResourceId'))
                  else:
                      send_cfn_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(err)})

  MarbotRegistration:
    Type: Custom::MarbotRegistration
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt RegistrationLambda.Arn
      EndpointId: !Ref EndpointId
      AccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Region: !Ref AWS::Region
      RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn
      ExternalId: !Ref AWS::StackId

Outputs:
  MarbotRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by marbot
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotCrossAccountRole.Arn

  ExternalId:
    Description: External ID required for marbot cross-account role assumption
    Value: !Ref AWS::StackId

  EventBridgeApiDestinationArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge API Destination for marbot
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeApiDestination.Arn

  KeepAliveRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the scheduled heartbeat EventBridge rule
    Value: !GetAtt KeepAliveScheduleRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS CloudFormation template for a Glue Data Catalog database, optional Glue crawler, and optional Glue Spark ETL job.

Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix used to name all created resources.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 50
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, or underscores.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing S3 bucket containing raw data to be crawled and transformed (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::my-source-bucket).
    AllowedPattern: ^arn:aws:s3:::[a-z0-9.-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket ARN (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name).

  SourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 prefix inside the source bucket to scan (e.g., raw-data/). Do not start with a leading slash.
    Default: ''

  EnableCrawler:
    Type: String
    Description: Toggle to create and enable the Glue Crawler.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'

  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Description: Cron schedule expression for the Glue Crawler (defaults to once daily at 12:00 UTC).
    Default: cron(0 12 * * ? *)

  EnableJob:
    Type: String
    Description: Toggle to create and enable the Glue Spark ETL Job.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional ARN of the target S3 bucket for transformed output (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::my-target-bucket). Leave empty if ETL job is not used.
    Default: ''

  TargetPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 prefix in the target bucket where transformed data will be written (e.g., processed-data/).
    Default: ''

  ScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 URI to the Spark ETL script (e.g., s3://my-code-bucket/scripts/etl_job.py).
    Default: ''

  GlueWorkerType:
    Type: String
    Description: The type of predefined worker that is allocated when a job runs.
    AllowedValues:
      - G.025X
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X
    Default: G.1X

  NumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    Description: The number of workers allocated for the Glue ETL job.
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 299

  JobTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Description: Job timeout in minutes.
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 2880

  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum number of concurrent runs allowed for the Glue ETL job.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: CloudWatch log retention period in days for ETL job continuous logs.
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Default: 30

Conditions:
  IsCrawlerEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCrawler, 'true']
  IsJobEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableJob, 'true']
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, '']]
  AddTargetBucketPolicy: !And [!Condition IsJobEnabled, !Condition HasTargetBucket]

Resources:
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub ${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-db
        Description: !Sub Glue Catalog Database for ${NamingPrefix} in ${Environment} environment

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-glue-role
      Description: IAM service role shared by Glue Crawler and Glue ETL Job
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SourceBucketReadAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Ref SourceBucketArn
                  - !Sub ${SourceBucketArn}/*
        - !If
          - AddTargetBucketPolicy
          - PolicyName: TargetBucketWriteAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Ref TargetBucketArn
                    - !Sub ${TargetBucketArn}/*
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - IsJobEnabled
          - PolicyName: ScriptBucketReadAccess
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub
                      - arn:aws:s3:::${BucketName}/${ObjectKey}
                      - BucketName: !Select [0, !Split ['/', !Select [1, !Split ['s3://', !Ref ScriptLocation]]]]
                        ObjectKey: !Select [1, !Split ['s3://', !Ref ScriptLocation]]
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  GlueJobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: IsJobEnabled
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws-glue/jobs/${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: IsCrawlerEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-crawler
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Description: !Sub Glue Crawler for ${NamingPrefix} in ${Environment} environment
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub
              - s3://${BucketName}/${SourcePrefix}
              - BucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
      Configuration: '{"Version":1.0,"CrawlerOutput":{"Partitions":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"InheritFromTable"}}}'

  GlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: IsJobEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      Description: !Sub Spark ETL Job for ${NamingPrefix} in ${Environment} environment
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      WorkerType: !Ref GlueWorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref NumberOfWorkers
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeout
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref ScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      DefaultArguments:
        --job-bookmark-option: job-bookmark-enable
        --enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log: 'true'
        --continuous-log-logGroup: !Ref GlueJobLogGroup

Description: CloudFormation template that provisions the DatadogPolicy macro and backend serverless function to dynamically generate IAM policies for Datadog integration.

Resources:
  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
      Description: CloudFormation macro handler for generating Datadog integration IAM policies
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      InlineCode: |
        import json
        import logging

        logger = logging.getLogger()
        logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

        def handler(event, context):
            logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
            request_id = event.get("requestId", "")
            try:
                params = event.get("params", {}) or {}
                fragment = event.get("fragment", {})
                
                # Evaluate PolicyType from parameters or fragment
                policy_type = params.get("PolicyType")
                if not policy_type and isinstance(fragment, dict):
                    policy_type = fragment.get("PolicyType")
                
                # Check for optional target bucket specification
                bucket = params.get("BucketName") or params.get("Bucket")
                if not bucket and isinstance(fragment, dict):
                    bucket = fragment.get("BucketName") or fragment.get("Bucket")
                
                if bucket and bucket != "*":
                    bucket_arn = bucket if bucket.startswith("arn:aws:s3:::") else f"arn:aws:s3:::{bucket}"
                    obj_arn = f"{bucket_arn}/*" if not bucket_arn.endswith("/*") else bucket_arn
                    resources = [bucket_arn, obj_arn]
                else:
                    resources = "*"

                if policy_type == "LogArchive":
                    policy_name = "DatadogLogArchiveAndRehydratePolicy"
                    actions = [
                        "s3:GetObject",
                        "s3:PutObject",
                        "s3:ListBucket"
                    ]
                    policy_doc = {
                        "PolicyName": policy_name,
                        "PolicyDocument": {
                            "Version": "2012-10-17",
                            "Statement": [
                                {
                                    "Sid": "DatadogLogArchiveAndRehydrate",
                                    "Effect": "Allow",
                                    "Action": actions,
                                    "Resource": resources
                                }
                            ]
                        }
                    }
                    if isinstance(fragment, dict):
                        transformed_fragment = dict(fragment)
                        if "Properties" in transformed_fragment and isinstance(transformed_fragment["Properties"], dict):
                            transformed_fragment["Properties"]["PolicyName"] = policy_name
                            transformed_fragment["Properties"]["PolicyDocument"] = policy_doc["PolicyDocument"]
                        else:
                            transformed_fragment.update(policy_doc)
                    else:
                        transformed_fragment = policy_doc

                elif policy_type == "CloudTrail":
                    policy_name = "DatadogCloudTrailsPolicy"
                    actions = [
                        "s3:ListBucket",
                        "s3:GetObject",
                        "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                    ]
                    policy_doc = {
                        "PolicyName": policy_name,
                        "PolicyDocument": {
                            "Version": "2012-10-17",
                            "Statement": [
                                {
                                    "Sid": "DatadogCloudTrails",
                                    "Effect": "Allow",
                                    "Action": actions,
                                    "Resource": resources
                                }
                            ]
                        }
                    }
                    if isinstance(fragment, dict):
                        transformed_fragment = dict(fragment)
                        if "Properties" in transformed_fragment and isinstance(transformed_fragment["Properties"], dict):
                            transformed_fragment["Properties"]["PolicyName"] = policy_name
                            transformed_fragment["Properties"]["PolicyDocument"] = policy_doc["PolicyDocument"]
                        else:
                            transformed_fragment.update(policy_doc)
                    else:
                        transformed_fragment = policy_doc

                else:
                    # Pass through existing fragment for other types
                    transformed_fragment = fragment

                logger.info("Transformed fragment successfully processed")
                return {
                    "requestId": request_id,
                    "status": "success",
                    "fragment": transformed_fragment
                }

            except Exception as e:
                logger.error("Error evaluating policy macro: %s", str(e), exc_info=True)
                return {
                    "requestId": request_id,
                    "status": "failure",
                    "errorMessage": str(e)
                }

    Properties:

Description: Cognito authentication layer for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway using OAuth2 client credentials flow.

Resources:
  UserPool:

      UserPoolName: agentcore-gateway-pool

        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email

        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12

          RequireNumbers: true

  UserPoolDomain:

  UserPoolResourceServer:

        - ScopeName: write

        - ScopeName: admin

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:

      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true

  ClientSecretLambdaExecutionRole:

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoDescribeClientPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
        - PolicyName: SecretsManagerSyncPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${SecretName}*

  ClientSecretManagerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-cognito-secret-sync
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ClientSecretLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None, no_echo=False):
              response_url = event['ResponseURL']
              response_body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': response_status,
                  'Reason': f"See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_resource_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'NoEcho': no_echo,
                  'Data': response_data
              }).encode('utf-8')

              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  response_url,
                  data=response_body,
                  headers={'content-type': '', 'content-length': str(len(response_body))},
                  method='PUT'
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
                      logger.info(f"Response status: {response.status}")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed to send response: {e}")

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info(f"Event: {json.dumps(event)}")
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              user_pool_id = props.get('UserPoolId')
              client_id = props.get('ClientId')
              secret_name = props.get('SecretName')
              project_name = props.get('ProjectName', 'protein-engineering')

              cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
              physical_id = secret_name

              try:
                  if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      describe_resp = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          ClientId=client_id
                      )
                      client_info = describe_resp['UserPoolClient']
                      client_secret = client_info.get('ClientSecret', '')

                      secret_payload = json.dumps({
                          'clientId': client_id,
                          'clientSecret': client_secret,
                          'userPoolId': user_pool_id
                      })

                      try:
                          sm.create_secret(
                              Name=secret_name,
                              Description=f"Client credentials for {project_name} AgentCore Gateway",
                              SecretString=secret_payload,
                              Tags=[
                                  {'Key': 'Project', 'Value': project_name},
                                  {'Key': 'ManagedBy', 'Value': 'CloudFormation'}
                              ]
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Secret {secret_name} created successfully.")
                      except ClientError as e:
                          if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ResourceExistsException':
                              sm.put_secret_value(
                                  SecretId=secret_name,
                                  SecretString=secret_payload
                              )
                              logger.info(f"Secret {secret_name} updated successfully.")
                          else:
                              raise

                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'SecretName': secret_name}, physical_id)

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          sm.delete_secret(
                              SecretId=secret_name,
                              ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Secret {secret_name} force-deleted successfully.")
                      except ClientError as e:
                          if e.response['Error']['Code'] in ('ResourceNotFoundException', 'InvalidRequestException'):
                              logger.info(f"Secret {secret_name} already deleted or not found.")
                          else:
                              raise

                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, physical_id)

              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Error processing request: {e}", exc_info=True)
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)}, physical_id)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito identity bootstrap for multi-tenant SaaS operations application.

Parameters:
  TenantAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Tenant application callback and logout host URL (without protocol, or with protocol).
  AdminAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Admin application callback and logout host URL (without protocol, or with protocol).
  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: authenticated-siloed-user-role
    Description: Name of the authenticated IAM role for siloed tenants.

Resources:
  # =========================================================================
  # POOLED TENANT COGNITO USER POOL & CLIENT
  # =========================================================================
  PooledTenantUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Welcome to the SaaS Operations Application
          EmailMessage: !Sub |
            Welcome to the SaaS Operations Application!
            Please log in at https://${TenantAppCallbackHost} using your temporary credentials:
            Username: {username}
            Temporary Password: {####}
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true

  PooledTenantUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub pooledtenant-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool

  PooledTenantUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub https://${TenantAppCallbackHost}
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub https://${TenantAppCallbackHost}
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  # =========================================================================
  # OPERATIONS USER POOL, CLIENT & GROUP
  # =========================================================================
  OperationUsersUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: OperationUsers-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Welcome to the SaaS Operations Admin Portal
          EmailMessage: !Sub |
            Welcome to the SaaS Operations Admin Portal!
            Please log in at https://${AdminAppCallbackHost} using your temporary credentials:
            Username: {username}
            Temporary Password: {####}
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: apiKey
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true

  OperationUsersUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub operationsusers-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool

  OperationUsersUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsOperationUsersPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub https://${AdminAppCallbackHost}
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub https://${AdminAppCallbackHost}
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
        - custom:apiKey
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
        - custom:apiKey
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  OperationUsersSystemAdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdmins
      Description: Group for system administrator operations users
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool

  # =========================================================================
  # COGNITO IDENTITY POOLS
  # =========================================================================
  PooledTenantIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledTenantUserPool}
          ClientId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient

  OperationsUserIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: OperationsUser-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationUsersUserPool}
          ClientId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPoolClient

  # =========================================================================
  # IAM AUTHENTICATED ROLES
  # =========================================================================
  AuthenticatedPooledUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: authenticated-pooled-user-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OperationsUserIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TagBasedDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PooledTenantItemAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order/index/*
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys:
                      - ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}
              - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings/index/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  AuthenticatedSiloedUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SiloedTenantRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OperationsUserIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SiloedDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SiloedTenantTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/index/*
              - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings/index/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  # =========================================================================
  # IDENTITY POOL ROLE ATTACHMENTS & PRINCIPAL TAGS
  # =========================================================================
  PooledTenantIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn

  PooledTenantPrincipalTags:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
      IdentityProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledTenantUserPool}
      UseDefaults: false
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole

  OperationsUserIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn

  OperationsUserPrincipalTags:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationsUserIdentityPool
      IdentityProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationUsersUserPool}
      UseDefaults: false
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole
        apiKey: custom:apiKey

Outputs:
  PooledTenantUserPoolId:
    Description: Pooled Tenant Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool

  PooledTenantUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Pooled Tenant Cognito App Client ID
    Value: !Ref PooledTenantUserPoolClient

  PooledTenantIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Pooled Tenant Cognito Identity Pool ID
    Value: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool

  OperationsUserPoolId:
    Description: Operations Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool

  OperationsUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Operations Cognito App Client ID
    Value: !Ref OperationUsersUserPoolClient

  OperationsUserIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Operations Cognito Identity Pool ID
    Value: !Ref OperationsUserIdentityPool

  OperationsUserPoolProviderUrl:
    Description: Operations Cognito User Pool Provider URL
    Value: !GetAtt OperationUsersUserPool.ProviderURL

  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Description: Siloed Tenant Authenticated Role Name
    Value: !Ref SiloedTenantRoleName

  SiloedTenantRoleArn:
    Description: Siloed Tenant Authenticated Role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt AuthenticatedSiloedUserRole.Arn
